title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down

title: Working Student Brand Ambassador (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

As our Working Student Brand Ambassador, you bring Mushroots directly to the people. Our products sit in the premium segment, and first-time buyers need to taste them before they commit. You make that happen — at supermarkets, festivals, trade fairs, and on our sampling bike across Hamburg.

  • Plan and coordinate tastings with supermarkets, festivals, and trade fairs independently
  • Run tastings end-to-end: set up the stand, engage with customers, break down, and clean all equipment
  • Take the Mushroots sampling bike to high-traffic spots in Hamburg and create hands-on brand experiences
  • Track and share feedback from tastings to help the team understand what resonates with customers


Your profile

  • Currently enrolled at a university (any field of study)
  • German C1, English B2 or above
  • You enjoy approaching people you've never met and starting a conversation
  • Self-starter who plans, coordinates, and executes without needing step-by-step guidance
  • Valid driver's license (Class B)
  • Comfortable with a physical role: carrying equipment, standing for extended periods, cycling the sampling bike
  • Previous experience as a promoter or in event sampling is a plus, not a requirement
  • Genuine interest in Mushroots products and what Infinite Roots stands for


Our Benefits:

  • Dynamic and diverse mission-driven team from more than 20 different countries
  • A fast growing company with opportunities for personal development
  • Flexible working hours with entitled Home Office days in an innovative and agile working environment 
  • Gym Membership, language classes or an attractive alternative from our benefit program
  • Flat hierarchies and short decision paths
  • Great team events such as “lunch & learn”, “Demo Day”, cultural celebrations and food tastings

title: Praktikantin gesucht für Unternehmen Erwachsenenbereich! (ab 18 Jahre)
description:
Wir sind eine Castingagentur und Medienproduktion im Erwachsenenbereich und suchen wir Unterstützung im Bereich Online Marketing, Social Media und Organisation.

Die Tätigkeit ist abwechslungsreich und verbindet digitales Marketing mit organisatorischen Aufgaben rund um unsere Castings. Ein großer Teil der Arbeit kann digital erledigt werden. Je nach Aufgabe und Termin ist gelegentlich auch eine Tätigkeit vor Ort erforderlich.

Aufgaben

- Pflege und Aktualisierung unserer Webseiten
- Unterstützung bei Suchmaschinenoptimierung und Content Erstellung
- Mitarbeit bei Google Ads und weiteren Online Werbemaßnahmen
- Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Social Media Kanäle
- Erstellung und Planung von Beiträgen und Kampagnen
- Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Marketingmaßnahmen
- Kommunikation mit Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern für Castings
- Koordination und Planung von Castingterminen
- Vorauswahl und Organisation eingehender Bewerbungen
- Allgemeine organisatorische und digitale Aufgaben

Qualifikation

-Mindestalter 18 Jahre
-Interesse an Online Marketing und digitalen Medien
-Sicherer und freundlicher Umgang in der Kommunikation
-Zuverlässige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
-Diskretion und professioneller Umgang mit sensiblen Inhalten
-Grundkenntnisse in Social Media, Webseiten oder Online Marketing sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich
-Offenheit gegenüber einer Tätigkeit für ein Unternehmen aus der Erwachsenenunterhaltung

Benefits

-Ein vielseitiges Praktikum mit echten Einblicken in Online Marketing und Medienproduktion
-Flexible und überwiegend digitale Arbeitsmöglichkeiten
-Hybrides Arbeiten mit Homeoffice und einzelnen Terminen vor Ort
-Praktische Erfahrungen in SEO, SEA, Social Media und Webseitenpflege
-Eigenständige Aufgaben und kurze Entscheidungswege

title: Security Architect
description:
Our mission

At LOGEX, we help healthcare providers improve outcomes through data-driven insights. Every day, hospitals and healthcare organizations across Europe rely on our financial, operational, clinical, and patient pathway data to make better decisions.

With that responsibility comes a clear commitment: keeping sensitive healthcare data secure, protected, and trusted.

We are looking for a Security Architect who is not only able to design secure solutions but also enjoys implementing them. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to make a tangible impact on security across our platforms, cloud environment, and engineering practices.

Your impact and responsibilities

As Security Architect, you will report directly to the Head of Information Security & Compliance and play a key role in strengthening LOGEX's security maturity. This is not a traditional enterprise architecture role focused on creating frameworks and presentations. We are looking for a security practitioner who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, working closely with engineering teams, solving real security challenges, and driving measurable risk reduction. You will work alongside software engineers, data engineers, and platform teams across multiple countries to ensure security is built into everything we do.

Your team

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.

The future of AI computing is light, not electrons.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Energy Management Platform (all genders)
description:
How you can contribute to gridX

Distributed energy resources are transforming the global grid, and our cloud platform sits right at the center of it. Every day, our Cloud EMS and core APIs power tens of thousands of connected systems, serving as the foundational infrastructure that engineering teams rely on to build the future of clean energy. description:

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

  • Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

First 90 Days

Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

title: Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d)
description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d) to join our team and play a key role in developing software that connects and translates lab equipment hardware interfaces, automates machines, and powers our next-generation automation platform. As a core team member, you will be working on cutting-edge technology, building software that bridges the gap between software and hardware, enabling seamless integration across various vendors.

Connectors are how we do it. Every instrument we bring online gets one, and every connector is built on our shared Python libraries: Bus, our Connector Development Kit, and the stack underneath them.

Our mission is to empower researchers and engineers by bridging the gap between lab equipment and cloud-based automation. Our customers are solving critical challenges like curing diseases, developing sustainable materials, and addressing global food security. We provide them with the tools to connect their devices, automate workflows, and unlock new possibilities in R&D.

Your mandate has two halves. Own the libraries as a product with real users, our own engineers today and external contributors later. And stay close enough to customer connector work that what you build is grounded in problems that actually exist.


Why you'll love this role

Your users are engineers.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
⭐️ Your Impact:

The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software
penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour
productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings
on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.

There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't
last.

smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool
to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard
to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real
leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working.

These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging.

That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker.

That's what this role is for.

What you'll do

You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team -
and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the
thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day.

- Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know
  our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've
  stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed.
- Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter
  screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs.
- Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer
  real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability,
  evaluation, structured output, graceful failure.
- Decide what to build.

title: Summer Intern (Ecommerce Operations)

Our portfolio includes leading fashion marketplaces like Italist, HEWI and Verishop, affiliate marketing platforms like Stylight and MyBestBrands, B2B technology solutions like Bonsai, and niche Marketplaces in the Creator and Construction spaces like Everpress and DOZR.

About the Role

We’re looking for someone to join us as a Summer Intern (Ecommerce Operations) on our Italist luxury fashion marketplace.

This is a hands-on role - you will not be building decks and plans, you'll be taking project briefs and doing the actual work. title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

  • This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’v

Der Fachkräftemangel ist real, die Digitalisierung in diesem Bereich steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen, und die Lösungen, die es heute gibt, sind nicht für die Nutzer gebaut, die sie eigentlich brauchen.

title: Werkstudent:in (m/w/d) Internationales Recht

title: Senior Product Designer - Platform and Partner Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join the Partner and Platform Experience (PPX) team. You'll tackle problems where social dynamics, device ecosystems, and technical constraints intersect. It's work that demands systems thinking, deep comfort with technical complexity, and a drive to make complex interactions feel simple and engaging.


What You'll Do

  • Design experiences that help listeners share moments together and move effortlessly between the devices and platforms around them.

  • Own complex design problems from early exploration through execution, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and product opportunities.

  • Create thoughtful, polished user experiences with a strong focus on interaction design, visual craft, and the details that make an experience feel intuitive.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to understand the technology behind the experience and turn complex systems into simple experiences for listeners.

  • Explore how experiences scale across mobile, desktop, TVs, speakers, cars, and other surfaces in the Spotify ecosystem.

  • Use prototyping to explore, communicate, and test ideas, including AI-assisted and code-based approaches where they help us learn faster.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.

title: Staff AI Deployment Strategist - UK & Nordics
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

Pammys ist eine der am schnellsten gewachsenen D2C-Footwear-Brands Deutschlands – mit über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und über 4 Millionen Euro Paid-Social-Spend pro Monat. Bei dieser Größenordnung entscheidet Datenqualität nicht über Reports, sondern über Millionen. Genau dafür bauen wir die Rolle, die es bei uns so noch nicht gibt: Du machst Daten zu unserem schärfsten Steuerungsinstrument.
Du verantwortest den kompletten Datenbereich – von der Infrastruktur über Tracking und Attribution bis zu den Dashboards, mit denen Gründer und Führungsteam täglich entscheiden. Du baust den Bereich von Grund auf, mit direktem Draht zu den Gründern und der Freiheit, Stack und Team selbst zu gestalten.
Data-Infrastruktur. Du baust unser zentrales Data Warehouse auf und verbindest alle relevanten Quellen – Shop, Paid-Kanäle, ERP/Warenwirtschaft, Fulfillment, CRM – zu einer sauberen, verlässlichen Wahrheit. Schluss mit Zahlen, die je nach Tool anders aussehen.
Tracking & Attribution. Du verantwortest unser Tracking-Setup end-to-end: Server-Side-Tracking, Conversion-APIs, Datenqualität in den Ad-Plattformen. Bei unserem Spend-Niveau ist jeder Prozentpunkt Messgenauigkeit bares Geld – du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Signale besser sind als die der Konkurrenz.
Steuerungslogik. Du entwickelst die Kennzahlen, nach denen wir wirklich steuern: Deckungsbeitrag pro Produkt, Kanal und Kooperation – nah an Echtzeit statt Wochen später. Du übersetzt Geschäftsfragen in Datenmodelle und Datenmodelle in Entscheidungen.
Reporting & Self-Service. Du baust Dashboards, die benutzt werden – vom täglichen Steuerungsboard der Gründer bis zu Self-Service-Auswertungen für die Teams. Dein Anspruch: Jede wichtige Frage ist in Sekunden beantwortet, nicht in Meetings.

Du siehst eine Brand und weißt sofort, was ihr fehlt.

Du erkennst, ob ein Design außergewöhnlich oder einfach nur schön ist. Du verstehst, warum Content Reichweite bekommt, warum ein Creative verkauft und warum sich eine Website trotz perfekter Optik nicht richtig anfühlt.

Du kennst die Trends von morgen, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen.

Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Performance und schnelles Wachstum haben uns groß gemacht.

Jetzt wollen wir Pammys auch kreativ auf das nächste Level bringen.

title: Creative Director (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Good taste is not enough.

Du erkennst innerhalb von Sekunden, ob ein Creative funktioniert.

Du siehst ein Interface und weißt, warum es nicht konvertiert.

Du verstehst, warum eine Brand auf TikTok plötzlich kulturell relevant wird, während eine andere trotz Millionenbudget unsichtbar bleibt.

Du kannst über Typografie, Art Direction und UX genauso tief diskutieren wie über Hooks, Content Production, Social Trends und Reichweitenaufbau.

Und wenn drei starke kreative Teams drei unterschiedliche Richtungen verfolgen, bist du die Person, die eine klare Entscheidung trifft.

Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Unsere nächste Wachstumsphase braucht nicht einfach mehr Content.

Sie braucht eine klare kreative Handschrift.

Und jemanden, der dafür die Verantwortung übernimmt.


Deine Aufgaben

title: CMO - Chief Marketing Officer (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du verantwortest das gesamte Marketing als Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens – mit voller Budget- und Ergebnisverantwortung, direktem Draht zu den beiden Gründern und der Führung eines Teams von über 50 Menschen. Eine Rolle in dieser Größenordnung ist kein Ort zum Lernen: Wir suchen jemanden, der das alles schon einmal gemacht hat – und es jetzt größer machen will.
Performance Marketing. Du steuerst eines der größten Paid-Social-Setups im deutschen D2C – über 4 Millionen Euro Spend pro Monat auf Meta, TikTok und weiteren Kanälen – und skalierst es profitabel weiter. Deine Steuerungsgrößen sind Deckungsbeitrag und Neukunden-Ökonomie, nicht Klicks. Du entscheidest täglich auf Zahlenbasis, wo Budget hingeht und wo es rausgeht.
Influencer & Creator. Du führst und skalierst unser Influencer-Geschäft – eines der größten im Land, mit eigenem Team, klarer Erfolgsmessung pro Kooperation und Creator-Content als Treibstoff für Paid. Hier entsteht ein Großteil unseres Wachstums, und du machst daraus ein noch schärferes System.
Creative Engine. Du verantwortest unsere Content- und Creative-Produktion: hohe Schlagzahl, systematisches Testing, klare Erfolgsmuster. Du weißt, dass im D2C das Creative der größte Hebel im Account ist – und baust die Struktur, die jede Woche neue Gewinner liefert.
Internationalisierung. Du bringst unser Marketing-Playbook in neue Märkte – von der Lokalisierung der Creatives über den Aufbau lokaler Creator-Netzwerke bis zur profitablen Skalierung vor Ort. Gemeinsam mit unserem COO, der die operative Seite verantwortet.
Retention & Brand. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Käufern Wiederkäufer werden – CRM, E-Mail, Community – und entwickelst unsere Marke weiter, ohne dass sie ihre Herkunft verliert: nahbar, ehrlich, für Menschen, die den ganzen Tag auf den Beinen sind.

title: Chief Product Officer (CPO) – Footwear (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk.

Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (CPO) – Footwear (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt.

Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt.

Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator mit tiefem Footwear-Know-how, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet.

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert.

Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein.

Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team.

Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf.

Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam.

title: (Mandatory) Internship Technical Founder's Associate (m/w/d)
description:
About CyFract

We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. Founded in 2022, we develop a patented uniflow hydrocyclone that removes suspended solids without membranes, consumables or moving parts, at a fraction of the energy conventional systems require. Having completed the UnternehmerTUM Incubator and a €3M project financed by SPRIN-D (German Federal Agency for Disruptive Innovation), we successfully deployed two containerized pilot systems and are conducting validation projects with industrial partners. We are now building the team that will carry this from working prototype to industrial standard, and we are looking for the people who want to build it with us.

The Role

As Technical Founder's Associate, you will work directly with the founding team on our core technology. Over the coming months our separation geometry will be tested with pilot partners. You will be one of the people who builds the test setup, runs the measurements, and turns the results into something we can act on. This is not a role where you reproduce something that already works. Parts of what you build will be the first of their kind, and some of them will fail. We are looking for someone who finds that interesting rather than alarming. You will sit close to the founding team and see how an early stage company actually runs: how decisions get made, what gets prioritised and why, and what a founder's week really looks like. Your measurements and your judgement feed directly into those decisions.

Tasks

  • Build, modify and operate our Munich test rig; run and document test series
  • Design and iterate cyclone and guide-vane geometries in CAD and prepare print-ready files
  • 3D print, post-process, assemble and pressure-test prototypes
  • Build out the measurement chain: sensors, data acquisition, evaluation

title: Software Engineer, Platform - Stuttgart, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
The Verification squad sits at the heart of SumUp's ability to operate across 37 markets. We own the systems that determine whether a merchant's identity is verified, whether that verification meets the regulatory bar in every market we operate in, and whether the decisions made along the way are auditable and defensible. This isn't a coordination role — it's a high-ownership position where you'll set the product direction for a domain that is legally complex, strategically important, and actively transforming. If you want to own something that genuinely matters — where your decisions shape compliance outcomes, merchant experience, and platform capability simultaneously — this is that role.

What you'll do

  • Define and lead the product strategy for the verification platform, sequencing compliance obligations, platform modernisation, and merchant experience improvements with clear intent

  • Make the hard calls where UX and backend decisions conflict, holding coherence across the full product surface and owning the outcome when trade-offs are required

  • Run lean, autonomous discovery — synthesising user research, data signals, and regulatory guidance into decision-ready artefacts independently

  • Co-lead the squad alongside a strong Engineering Manager, driving platform modernisation and reducing technical debt deliberately

You'll be great for this role if

  • Proven experience as a product manager in a regulated fintech or financial services environment, with direct ownership of KYC, KYB, or identity verification products across multiple markets

  • Strong ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder environments — including Legal, AML, Complia

title: Partner Success Representative
description: We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!    As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.    Die Rolle   Als  Partner Success Representative  bist du Teil der Business Unit  Parking.  Du stellst eine nahtlose Implementierung der Arrive Produkte und Services sicher, indem du unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen konfigurierst, wartest und kontinuierlichen Support bereitstellst. Du berichtest direkt an den lokalen Teamleiter in Deutschland.  Als Partner Success Team spielen wir eine wesentliche Rolle beim Aufbau von Vertrauen und starken Beziehungen mit unseren Partnern, indem wir sie in ihrem Tagesgeschäft unterstützen und entscheidende Phasen in unserer Zusammenarbeit positiv gestalten.  Wir tragen zu unserer Vision bei, indem wir mit unseren Partnern in Kontakt treten, ihre Bedürfnisse identifizieren und Verbesserungsinitiativen vorantreiben.   So Nimmst Du Einfluss (How To Make An Impact)     Du bietest ausgezeichnete operative Unterstützung für neue und bestehende Partner.  Du koordinierst Projekte im Hinblick auf die Implementierung der Kernprodukte und Dienstleistungen des Unternehmens gemäß den Kundenspezifikationen.  Du verwaltest die Konfiguration, Freigabe und Wartung unserer zentralen Softwarelösungen.  Qualitätssicherung durch Testen unserer Produkte und Dienstleistungen, während du stets kontinuierliche Verbesserung vorantreibst.  Du übernimmst die Bestellung, Überprüfung und Roll-out von Beschilderung (Signage)  Du arbeitest eng über Teams und Geschäftsbereiche (Business Units) hinweg – deine Hauptansprechpartner (Stakeholder) sind der Vertrieb (Account Manager und Sales Admin), Operations, Marketing und F&E (Forschung & Entwicklung).  Du arbeitest aktiv innerhalb des CRM-Systems, um Bestellungen und Anfragen zu verwalten und die Datenqualität sicherzustellen.     Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen     Exzellente Fähigkeiten im Bereich Kundenbeziehungsmanagement (Customer Relationship Management) und großes Interesse daran, Kunden zu helfen.  Gute Planungs-Fähigkeiten und Selbstorganisation.  Hohes technisches Verständnis für Systemintegrationen.  Gute analytische Fähigkeiten, um Daten zu interpretieren und Muster zu erkennen.  Du zeigst Belastbarkeit (Resilienz) und eine positive Einstellung gegenüber Veränderungen.  XML- oder JSON-Kenntnisse sind wünschenswert.  Vertrautheit mit der Google Suite ist von Vorteil.  Grundkenntnisse in Adobe Illustrator sind von Vorteil.

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Schichtplanung im Gesundheitswesen   Du möchtest mit deiner Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegen? Das Beste aus zwei Welten   Bei uns erlebst du die Dynamik, Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurzen Entscheidungswege eines Start-ups – kombiniert mit der Sicherheit einer profitablen Muttergesellschaft aus den Niederlanden, die seit über 20 Jahren nachhaltig erfolgreich am Markt ist.  So können wir uns voll auf Innovation und nachhaltiges Wachstum konzentrieren – ohne Abhängigkeit von externen Investoren.      Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt einzusteigen   Wir befinden uns in einer starken Expansionsphase in Deutschland und der Schweiz. Bereits heute arbeiten renommierte Einrichtungen wie große Universitätskliniken und Krankenhausverbände mit uns – und das Wachstumspotenzial allein im DACH-Gesundheitsmarkt ist enorm.  Mittelfristig werden wir unsere bewährten Lösungen auch in andere Branchen bringen – in den Niederlanden setzen bereits Unternehmen wie  Mars ,  DHL , der  Holländische Staat  und  Tata Steel  auf unsere Technologie. Als Teil unseres Teams gestaltest du diese Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mit. Durch deine Expertise, dein Gespür für Kundenanforderungen und deine Begeisterung für moderne SaaS-Lösungen trägst du maßgeblich dazu bei, dass Organisationen ihre Planungsprozesse nachhaltig verbessern und das volle Potenzial von Swisio ausschöpfen.      Dein Impact     Kundenbeziehungen stärken:  Du bist erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen nach der Implementierung und begleitest sie langfristig in der Nutzung unserer Software.   Proaktive Unterstützung der Kund:innen bei neuen Software-Updates  – einschließlich Kommunikation neuer Features, Funktionsdemonstrationen und Change-Management.   Strategische Betreuung:  Analyse von Kundenkonfigurationen und Unterstützung bei optimaler Anpassung technischer Einstellungen. Around 80% of new product launches die within 12-18 months, mostly because brands are guessing. They have no real visibility into how people actually shop, and no system for turning that into better decisions.  We have spent four years collecting genuine behavioural shopping data, and we turn it into two things brands pay for. 📍 Remote oder Berlin | ⏱ 20 Stunden/Woche | Start: ab sofort | Dauer: mind. 6 Monate


Als Customer Care Expert Werkstudent*in (m/w/x) bist du ein wichtiger Teil unseres Care Teams und die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Patient*innen. Du unterstützt unsere Nutzer per Chat, E-Mail und Telefon und sorgst dafür, dass sie sich bei Cara Care jederzeit gut aufgehoben und verstanden fühlen.

Du erhältst spannende Einblicke darin, wie wir unsere Patient*innen begleiten, ihre Bedürfnisse verstehen und unsere digitalen Therapieprogramme kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Dabei verbindest du Empathie mit lösungsorientiertem Denken: Du beantwortest Fragen rund um unsere digitalen Therapieprogramme, unterstützt bei technischen und inhaltlichen Anliegen und gehst individuell auf die Rückmeldungen unserer Nutzer*innen ein. Gleichzeitig trägst du wertvolles Feedback in unser Team und hilfst dabei, unsere Produkte und Prozesse stetig zu verbessern.

Die Rolle ist bewusst sehr patient*innen und praxisnah gestaltet: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine eigenen Aufgaben, bringst deine Perspektive ein und kannst mit deiner Arbeit einen direkten Beitrag zu einer positiven Patient*innen Experience leisten.

🎯 Was du bei uns machen wirst:

Patient Care & Support

  • Betreuung über App-Chat, E-Mail und Telefon
  • Unterstützung bei inhaltlichen und technischen Fragen rund um unsere digitalen Therapieprogramme
  • Individuelle und empathische Beantwortung von Anliegen und Rückmeldungen unserer Nutzer*innene
  • Aufbau eines detaillierten Verständnisses für die Inhalte unserer Therapieprogramme, um Patient*innen bestmöglich unterstützen zu können
  • Sicherstellung einer positiven und wertschätzenden Patient*innen Experience über alle Kommunikationskanäle hinweg

Patient Experience & Feedback

title: AI Engineering & Automation Specialist (on-site)
description:
Your role

Every internal team at Cloover, Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, Finance, has work that AI agents can do faster and better. You'll build the systems that make that real: agentic pipelines, MCP servers, and internal tools that change how we operate day-to-day, not in some future roadmap. Success in this role means colleagues stop doing the work you've automated, and start doing the work only they can do.

You'll report to Florent (Head of Operations & Energy) and work within a team of amazing people alongside.


Your mission

  • Design, build, and ship end-to-end agentic systems, RAG pipelines, embeddings, retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation, that automate Cloover's highest-volume internal workflows.
  • Build and deploy custom MCP servers and integrations connecting HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Aircall, and other tools, so data flows where it needs to without manual work in between.
  • Write production-grade Python and TypeScript with sound schema design, security, and authorization, code that ships and runs, not prototypes that sit.
  • Own internal tooling end-to-end: spot the gap, build the tool, and deploy it on Firebase, Vercel, or GCP with proper version control and CI/CD.
  • Build custom Claude Code skills, plugins, and connectors, then onboard colleagues into AI-native workflows that they actually keep using.
  • Partner with Ops, Energy, Sales, CS, and Finance to identify the highest-leverage automation use cases, then personally implement them.

The Hardware Tribe designs and builds the point-of-sale devices and accessories that let millions of small businesses take payments every day, spanning industrial design, embedded systems, mobile apps and backend services. title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

title: Mitarbeiter im Bereich HR & Payroll (m/w/d) in Teilzeit.
description:
Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Mitarbeiter im Bereich HR & Payroll (m/w/d) in Teilzeit.

Die Position eignet sich ausdrücklich auch für Berufseinsteiger, die bereits erste Grundkenntnisse in Personio und Personio Payroll mitbringen und sich im Bereich Personaladministration und Entgeltabrechnung weiterentwickeln möchten.

Aufgaben

Du unterstützt uns bei der laufenden Personaladministration und insbesondere bei allen Prozessen rund um Personio und Personio Payroll. Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Pflege und Aktualisierung der Mitarbeiterstammdaten in Personio
  • Unterstützung bei der monatlichen Entgeltabrechnung mit Personio Payroll
  • Vorbereitung, Prüfung und Nachbereitung der monatlichen Payroll

Du musst noch kein Payroll-Profi sein. Wichtig ist uns, dass du erste praktische Kenntnisse und ein gutes Grundverständnis mitbringst und Lust hast, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Idealerweise hast du:

  • Grundkenntnisse in Personio
  • erste Kenntnisse bzw. Erfahrungen mit Personio Payroll

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Hjälp våra kunder att gå från information till handling   Tycker du om att se andra lyckas? Är du bra på att skapa förtroende, se nästa steg och få saker att hända? Kan du rekommendera en väg framåt – och samtidigt vara prestigelös nog att lyssna och tänka om?      Då kan du vara den Customer Success Manager vi söker till Spintr.       Spintr  är ett modernt intranät för verksamheter där många medarbetare inte sitter vid en dator – butiken, depån eller anläggningen. Vi samlar nyheter, kunskap och utbildning i en mobil medarbetarupplevelse som knyter ihop huvudkontor, arbetsställen och bolag.     dag används vi av bland andra Gekås Ullared, OKQ8 och Panduro.  Som Customer Success Manager ansvarar du för att våra kunder får verklig och långsiktig nytta av Spintr – från onboarding och etablering till adoption, förnyelse och expansion.      I rollen är relationen grunden och kundvärdet visar vägen      Du ansvarar för en egen kundportfölj och blir en nära rådgivare till både beslutsfattare och de personer som arbetar praktiskt i plattformen. Du är nyfiken på hur kundens organisation fungerar, vad den vill åstadkomma och vad som kan stå i vägen – och utifrån det skapar du struktur, rekommenderar nästa steg och ser till att arbetet fortsätter framåt.     En dag leder du en workshop inför en lansering. Nästa dag analyserar du användningen hos en kund, hjälper en administratör med en konfiguration eller för viktiga kundinsikter vidare till produktteamet.  Du arbetar självständigt och tar egna initiativ, men samarbetar nära Amanda, VP Customer Experience, och kollegor inom CS teamet men även försäljning, produkt och utveckling.      Det här kommer du att göra    leda onboarding, implementationer, lanseringar och andra kundprojekt  ta fram kundplaner med mål, aktiviteter, ansvar och uppföljning utifrån kundens verksamhet och utmaningar  följa användning och kundutveckling för att tidigt se behov, risker och möjligheter  hålla utbildningar, workshops, presentationer och webbinarier  hjälpa kunderna att utveckla sin kommunikation, kunskapsdelning, utbildning och sina arbetssätt  förbereda och driva förnyelser samt identifiera relevanta möjligheter till vidareutveckling  föra in kundernas perspektiv i vårt arbete med produkt, erbjudande och arbetssätt      Starkt kundägarskap betyder inte att du gör allt själv – det betyder att du håller ihop helheten, involverar rätt personer och tar ansvar för att kunden kommer vidare.      I rollen som Customer Success Manager hos oss   Du är relationsskapande och förtroendeingivande, men vågar utmana när kunden behöver prioritera annorlunda. Du lyssnar innan du rekommenderar, är personlig, prestigelös och har nära till skratt. Samtidigt är du självgående: när du ser ett behov, en risk eller en möjlighet tar du initiativ och driver arbetet framåt. Du uppskattar ordning men kan hantera att alla processer ännu inte är färdigbyggda.      För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har    flerårig erfarenhet av Customer Success

title: Customer Service Manager Scandinavia - Kiilto
description: A hands-on Customer Service role for you who enjoy daily operations, teamwork and continuous improvement.   At Kiilto, Customer Service plays an important role in creating a smooth and reliable customer experience. We are now looking for an experienced Customer Service or Supply Chain professional who enjoys working close to the daily business, leading the Scandinavian Customer Service team and helping improve common ways of working across the region.   Role Overview   In this role, you will lead Customer Service operations for the Scandinavian region, covering Kiilto’s markets in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. The position combines coordination, daily operational work and continuous improvement. You will help set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support the team in meeting agreed service levels. You will also be involved in improving processes, systems and ways of working.  You will be part of an international Logistics and Warehousing team and collaborate with colleagues in Logistics, Supply Chain, Finance and the Business Areas. The role is focused on the Scandinavian region, while also contributing to selected regional and global improvement initiatives where relevant. Set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support agreed service levels.   Improve and harmonize Customer Service processes and ways of working across the Scandinavian markets.   Support organizational and cultural change initiatives to enable effective cross-border collaboration.   Analyze Customer Service performance and implement corrective actions and improvements where needed.   Collaborate closely with Logistics, Warehousing, other parts of the supply chain function, Finance and Business Area teams to strengthen the overall order-to-cash process.   Contribute to regional and selected global improvement projects.     What We Expect      Relevant academic degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, higher vocational education (KY/YH), or equivalent experience   Several years of experience in Customer Service operations, Supply Chain or a similar area. Good understanding of ERP systems, Office tools and BI solutions.   Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international, cross-functional environment.   Fluency in English and Swedish.     Why Kiilto?

title: Seksjonsleder Kunde
description: Vi leter etter deg!  Har du lyst til å utgjøre en forskjell? For folk rundt deg og for klima og miljø? Da vil vi høre fra deg!  Det er fint om du er:  En trygg leder som får folk til å trives og jobbe godt sammen  God til å lytte, forstå ulike perspektiver og samle folk om felles mål  God til å kommunisere og skape gode relasjoner på tvers av fagområder    Vi tilbyr  En fleksibel og travel arbeidshverdag  Bra folk og et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø  Læring, utvikling og nye muligheter  Lønn som møter kompetansen din   Trygghet gjennom gode pensjon – og forsikringsordninger  Trivselstilbud og sosiale aktiviteter     Om å jobbe sammen med oss  I Linea jobber vi hver dag for at alle våre kunder skal ha en stabil og sikker strømforsyning, og levere strøm til over 47 000 kunder.   Hos oss finner du en mangfoldig gjeng med flinke kollegaer som brenner for å gjøre en forskjell. Vi jobber hardt for å sikre at folk har strøm i stikkontaktene sine, og for at strømmen overføres på en bærekraftig måte. Vi bygger ut mest mulig skånsomt i forhold til natur og miljø.  Vi jobber like hardt for å skape en god arbeidsplass, bygget på samarbeid og fellesskap. I Linea har vi lave skuldre, vi tar sikkerhet på største alvor og det er alltid noen som stiller opp når du trenger hjelp.  Det er viktig for hele organisasjonen å kunne forbedre seg, og hos oss har du mulighet til å utvikle deg personlig og faglig.  Om stillingen  I dag får 47 000 kunder tilført strøm fra Linea. Vi forvalter hele 8000 kilometer med strømlinjer; det tilsvarer Norge på langs – 3,5 ganger! Her gjør de flinke folka i seksjon Kunde en viktig jobb: 41 engasjerte medarbeidere med ansvar for kundehåndtering i Linea. Gjennom kundeseksjonen skal vi arbeide hver eneste dag for å optimalisere kundereisen i Linea, håndtere saker og forespørsler fra kunden, og følge opp våre anlegg i de tusen hjem og bedrifter på Helgeland.  Som leder av seksjon Kunde vil et være ditt oppdrag å sette mål, drifte og utvikle for seksjonen i samhandling med egen ledergruppe. I stillingen skal du inspirere medarbeidere, bygge gode team, og drive endringer der det er behov. I tillegg vil du være del av ledergruppen i Linea, og gjennom den rollen bidra til å videreutvikle selskapet på en god måte.  Som synlig leder i Linea er dine ansatte dine viktigste kunder, og du deler uoppfordret all din kunnskap og skaper trygghet ved å være åpen om egne feil og mangler. Du arbeider aktivt for å utvikle talenter i ditt eget team, og skaper resultater gjennom dine medarbeidere. Du vurderer og prioriterer Helgeland Kraft og Lineas omdømme høyt i alle sammenheng.  Dine arbeidsoppgaver  Personal-, resultat- og HMS ansvar for seksjonen  Som en av tre seksjonsledere i Linea bidra til utvikling og gjennomføring av strategi og mål for Linea  Utvikle ledergruppen i Kunde, samt sette mål for seksjonen og følge opp disse  Utvikle og forbedre systemer og rutiner i seksjoner i henhold til KF-krafta (vårt forretningssystem)  Organisere seksjone

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Coretura is building the software backbone for the next generation of commercial vehicles - a joint venture between two of the industry's biggest players, moving at scaleup speed. As Customer Success Manager, you'll sit at the center of that relationship, turning shareholder alignment into product momentum.    Our Vision & Mission   Coretura exists to build a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platform that redefines how commercial vehicles are engineered, updated, and monetized - jointly owned by Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, two competitors who are betting that shared infrastructure beats separate roads. Our mission is to deliver a common platform robust enough to serve multiple OEMs, while still giving each shareholder room to differentiate and win in their own markets. We are building the platform and bringing the customers along for the ride at the same time, which makes for a different kind of relationship than you'd have with an established product. This calls for someone who can stay close to the customer commercially and relationally, build a genuine business case for why and how they engage with the platform, set and manage realistic expectations continuously, and be comfortable challenging the customer with integrity and assertiveness, all while never losing sight of the platform's value in the eyes of the customer.  This is where the Customer Success Manager comes in. You are the person who holds the customer relationship end-to-end, deeply representing your customer's interests, building the commercial and business rationale for their engagement with the platform, and making sure that rationale is heard by the people who shape the platform. The Customer Success Manager keeps their ears & eyes close to the customer organization, actively owning and driving the customer relationship to ensure a successful SDV platform in its rollout and operation.   The Value You Bring     You turn a structural relationship into a working partnership, so the customer feels heard, represented, and commercially engaged, not just serviced.  You manage expectations proactively around a product that's still being built, keeping the customer aligned and confident even as scope and timelines evolve.  You uncover customer needs early and turn them into concrete business opportunit

title: Field Support Manager, Nordics
description: As a Field Support Manager, you will lead and support our Field Support Representatives (FSR) across the Nordics, helping them deliver an excellent experience for our Companion Animal Group (CAG) customers. This is a field-based role, ideally located in the Nordics (Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark), with around 50% travel to visit teams and customers.  The Companion Animal Group (CAG) is responsible for installing and supporting our best-in-class premium instruments, including ProCyte, Catalyst One and SediVue, alongside the wider IDEXX analyzer portfolio. Our FSR team trains customers to get the most from their newly acquired instruments and provides onsite technical support when things don't go to plan. As a Field Support Manager, you'll build and develop this team so they can keep delivering excellent service across the region.   In This Role     You will lead and support the FSR team across the UK, contributing to FSR strategy, operating policies and process improvements.  You'll coach and develop individuals to deliver excellent customer experience, spotting opportunities and assigning the right resources.  You'll partner with field partners to identify opportunities and coordinate resources across the region.  You will guide territory management, helping the team prioritise and allocate their time so internal and external customers stay satisfied.  You'll join ride-alongs with field reps to provide hands-on training and individual development.  You will use data, metrics and system tools to drive efficiency and maximise customer experience.  You'll act as a change champion, supporting the team through periods of change.  You will evaluate performance and provide ongoing coaching and development opportunities.  You'll help representatives organise travel to customers, resolve issues, and keep site-visit reporting timely and accurate.  You've worked cross-functionally with other departments to coordinate work, resolve issues, and share customer feedback into product and process improvements.     Why This Role Matters   Our Field Support Representatives are often the face of IDEXX for our customers — the people who install, train and troubleshoot the instruments that help vets diagnose and treat companion animals every day. As Field Support Manager, you'll be at the heart of ensuring that team performs at its best, directly shaping the experience our customers have with IDEXX and supporting the continued growth of our European operations.   What You Need To Succeed     5-7+ years of related work experience, with in-depth experience in a supervised field or business support environment.  3+ years of supervisory experience, or a combination of supervisory and relevant product knowledge.  Experience supervising remote, multi-site teams.  Strong project management and change management experience.  Big-picture thinking, with strong reasoning and analytical skills to resolve issues.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: IT Service Delivery Manager (m/w/d) IT-Infrastrukturprojekte
description: Gestalte die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens   Möchtest du komplexe IT-Infrastrukturprojekte verantworten und gleichzeitig in einer Branche arbeiten, die einen echten gesellschaftlichen Beitrag leistet? Als zentrale Ansprechperson begleitest du Kund:innen über den gesamten Projekt- und Service-Lifecycle und führst regelmäßige Service- und Statusgespräche durch. Erfahrung bei einem IT-Dienstleister, Managed-Service-Provider, Systemhaus oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten IT-Organisation. Aider les assurés en déployant des solutions adaptées pour leur permettre de faire face aux aléas de la vie (dépannage, rapatriement, indemnisation, mise en place de service divers…) – 7j/7 et 24h/24 !  Nous recrutons notre nouveau  manager de proximité  ! Au sein du pôle Assistance Voyage, composée de 5 managers de proximité, vous encadrez une équipe d'une dizaine de collaborateurs. Vous contribuez au bon déroulement et au succès des missions qui sont confiées à votre équipe, vous êtes acteur de sa réussite.  Vos missions seront :    Définir, décliner et suivre les objectifs individuels et collectifs afin d’atteindre les objectifs de performance de l’équipe  Élaborer, analyser et piloter les indicateurs de suivi d’activité  Planifier, organiser et coordonner les activités quotidiennes dans une logique d’optimisation de la performance  Motiver, animer et accompagner les collaborateurs dans la réalisation de leurs missions  Identifier les besoins en information, accompagnement et formation, et contribuer au développement des compétences  Recruter, intégrer et fidéliser les collaborateurs en veillant au maintien d’un climat social positif et constructif     Informations complémentaires  :    Organisation du travail sur 4 jours par semaine, du lundi au dimanche. Les journées sont d’une durée de 9h38, incluant 1 heure de pause déjeuner.  1 jour de télétravail/semaine.  Processus de recrutement : un entretien en binôme avec une Chargée de recrutement et le/la Responsable de pôle ou son/sa adjoint.e. Une seconde étape d’échange avec les autres managers du pôle, afin d’évaluer la cohésion et l’adéquation au collectif.    Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil ?   Compétences et qualités requises :    Leadership et communication     Capacité à communiquer efficacement afin de fédérer l’équipe autour des objectifs du service  Aptitude à argumenter et expliquer les décisions pour susciter l’adhésion  Aisance relationnelle, bonne communication orale et écrite, écoute active     Management et travail collectif     Capacité à développer et animer le travail d’équipe  Aptitude à mobiliser l’intelligence collective  Esprit d’équipe, empathie, patience et sens du relationnel  Une expérience en management est un plus     Organisation et résolution de problèmes     Capacité à analyser les situations et à résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles  Organisation, gestion des priorités et adaptabilité     Compétences techniques     Maîtrise du français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit  Bonne maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit  Maîtrise avancée d’Excel

title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description: Our Product, Engineering and Design teams are evolving how they work as we grow, bring our products closer together and make greater use of AI and automation.     As part of that, we’re moving closer to the “product operating model”, giving teams better customer and product insights, enabling decisions closer to the work and creating stronger connections between strategy, discovery and delivery, etc.  That’s why we’re hiring our first Product Operations Manager. You’ll build the function and shape how it develops over time.     You’ll work closely with Henrik, our VP of Product, and partner with leaders and teams across Product, Engineering, Design and the wider business. You won’t inherit a finished Product Operations setup. You’ll identify where dedicated support can create the greatest leverage, build on what already works, and establish an approach that fits Zensai. This is an enablement role: you’ll improve the information, systems and operating rhythm around product work without taking craft or product decisions away from the teams that own them.      What You’ll Be Doing    Create clarity and alignment across Product, Engineering and Design.  Bring customer feedback, product usage and business data together so teams can identify the right problems, test ideas earlier and make informed product decisions.  Improve how teams prioritise, plan roadmaps, run discovery and coordinate work across Product, Engineering and Design  Take ownership of the tools and shared practices that support product discovery, feedback, insights and delivery  Connect product initiatives to business and financial impact, including supporting CAPEX/OPEX reporting  Find practical ways to use AI, agents and automation across discovery and delivery, reducing recurring operational work and helping reshape how product work gets done.       What Success Looks Like    Teams can easily find and use the customer, product and business information they need  Product decisions have a clear rationale, and teams can see how customers respond to what we build  Prioritisation, roadmapping and cross-functional work become more consistent and easier to navigate  AI and automation deliver improvements that teams can see and measure        What You Bring    You have strong experience in Product Operations, Product Management or a related role, including building or improving how product teams work.  You’ve worked in a mature product organisation and can use that experience to build an approach that fits Zensai  You’re comfortable working with customer, product and business data, including how data is captured and moves between systems  You have practical experience using AI, agents or automation to improve product work  You can bring people with different priorities together and influence decisions without formal authority.  You work confidently and independently in an international organisation and communicate clearly in English.       If you enjoy improving how good teams work toget

description: Viimeinen hakupäivä: 20. syyskuuta 2026    Hybridi     Työn kuvaus   Yhdistä ihmisten, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtaminen.   Me Aspialla olemme talous- ja palkkahallinnon edelläkävijöitä. Uteliaisuus, kasvu ja jatkuva kehittyminen ohjaavat tekemistämme – haluamme olla askeleen edellä niin osaamisessa kuin asiakaskokemuksessa. Avoin ja joustava työympäristömme tarjoaa sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa asiantuntijana.   Sytytkö ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä ja kasvun rakentamisesta?    Me Aspialla olemme asiantuntijayhteisö, joka seisoo rohkeiden kasvajien rinnalla. Teemme palkkahallinnosta selkeää, jotta asiakkaamme voivat keskittyä kasvuun. Meille kasvu tarkoittaa ennen kaikkea ihmisten, osaamisen ja vastuun kehittymistä.  Haemme kahta dynaamista palvelupäällikköä liittymään palkkaliiketoiminnan asiantuntijatiimeihimme Espoon ja Vaasan toimistoille/ Pohjanmaan seudulle vahvistamaan asiantuntijavetoista ja asiakaslähtöistä toimintamalliamme. Roolissa yhdistyvät palkkahallinnon ymmärrys, asiakkuusvastuu, myynnillinen ajattelu ja oman asiantuntijatiimin johtaminen. Vaasan/ Pohjanmaan seudun työsuhde on määräaikainen, perhevapaan sijainen vuoden 2027 loppuun.  Huolehdit asiakaskokonaisuuksien sujuvasta toteutuksesta, palvelun laadusta sekä tiimisi toimituskyvystä ja kannattavuudesta. Johdat kokonaisuuttasi tavoitteellisesti, mutta et yksin: tukenasi ovat kollegat ja laaja asiantuntijaverkosto. Arjessasi yhdistyvät operatiivinen johtaminen ja pidemmän aikavälin kehittäminen. Olet lähellä tiimiä ja asiakkaita, tunnistat kehitys- ja kasvumahdollisuuksia sekä viet asioita käytäntöön yhdessä muiden kanssa.   Myynti ja kasvu    Roolissa on myynnillinen vastuu osana asiakkuuksien kehittämistä ja liiketoiminnan kasvua. Myynti muodostuu sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä että uusien mahdollisuuksien edistämisestä. Osallistut aktiivisesti asiakastilanteisiin ja liiketoiminnan kasvattamiseen. Olet mukana ratkaisujen rakentamisessa ja tarjousten valmistelussa yhdessä myyjien ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa.   Tiimin johtaminen    Johdat palkka-asiantuntijoita valmentavasti ja tuet heidän ammatillista kasvuaan, priorisoit tekemistä ja rakennat arkea, jossa tavoitteet ovat ymmärrettäviä ja onnistuminen mahdollista. Osaat tehdä päätöksiä, tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin ja samalla vahvistaa luottamusta sekä yhdessä tekemistä.   Aspian arvot, yhteistyö, uteliaisuus ja välittävä neuvonantajuus, näkyvät tavassasi toimia niin tiimin kuin asiakkaiden kanssa. description: Overview   This role is responsible for building and institutionalizing  World-Class Customer Engagement (WCCE)  across all B&M key accounts within SodaStream, driving a step-change in how the organization engages with retailers globally. It leads the development and execution of the WCCE vision and roadmap, embedding a structured, insight-driven approach to Key Account Management (KAM) across markets. Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software and data infrastructure, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

title: Solutions Architect, Lead
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location: Remote

The impact you will have:

Notabene is moving up-market. Our growth now comes from financial institutions and fintechs launching digital asset products. These are bigger customers with longer implementation cycles, more stakeholders and higher contract values than the crypto-native exchanges we grew up with.

You will own a small number of these customers. Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them.

Growth is the part of this role that matters most. One signed contract is a way into the rest of the organisation. You will map it, find the other teams, entities and regions that need us, and work with Sales to open them.

title: Kundenservice & Community Manager:in (m/w/d) - Teilzeit, Werkstudent:in oder Minijob · Start: ab sofort · Office oder Hybrid, Remote möglich
description:
Naschen klingt für viele nach schlechtem Gewissen. Bei uns nicht. NaschNatur macht Schokolade, Riegel und Aufstriche, die ausschließlich mit Datteln gesüßt sind statt mit Industriezucker oder anderen Süßungsmitteln – bio, vegan, ohne Zusatzstoffe, mit Zutaten, die man aussprechen kann.

Ob das funktioniert, sagen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden besser als jede Anzeige: 4,94 von 5 Sternen bei über 3.500 Bewertungen. Und auffällig oft geht es in diesen Bewertungen gar nicht ums Produkt, sondern um den Service. Dazu kommen die Nachrichten — seitenlang, mit Fragen zur Umstellung, mit Erfolgsgeschichten, manchmal mit Ärger über ein Paket, das zu spät kam.

Genau da setzt diese Rolle an. Jede dieser Nachrichten ist ein Moment, in dem wir jemanden für gesunden Genuss begeistern können — auch die, die mit Ärger anfängt. Wir wollen, dass am Ende jedes Gesprächs ein erledigtes Anliegen steht und ein Mensch, der gern wiederkommt — nicht eine höfliche Antwort ohne Lösung. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme von NaschNatur gegenüber unseren Kundinnen und unserer Community. Du beantwortest Anfragen per Mail, Telefon und Social Media, betreust unsere Brand-Kanäle und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Anliegen erledigt wird — zugunsten der Kundin, nicht nur beantwortet. Deine Nordstern-Metriken: Lösungszeit und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Ausgangslage

Es gibt bei NaschNatur bisher kein Kundenservice-Team. Der Service hängt aktuell an einer Person, die ihn neben Auftragsbearbeitung und Verwaltung mitmacht.

Das heißt für dich: Du wirst eingearbeitet, aber du bist nach wenigen Wochen die Person, die den Posteingang verantwortet. Und du verantwortest mehr als das Beantworten - du entwickelst unseren Kundenservice weiter: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, unser internes Wiki und das Help Center. Wer eine Frage zum fünften Mal beantwortet, ohne sich zu fragen warum, ist in dieser Rolle falsch.

title: Account Executive - UK
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition

description:

 Senior Tax Preparer/Reviewer – Full-Time, Fully Remote 
 Join Our Team 
 Are you an experienced tax professional who enjoys solving complex tax issues, reviewing high-level tax work, and helping other preparers grow? 
 Join Profitable Painter CPA PLLC, a fast-growing, tech-enabled, remote-first CPA firm that exclusively serves painting contractors across the U.S. and Canada. Our mission is simple: guide painting contractors to financial prosperity.
