 What You’ll Do 
 
 
 Prepare and review complex federal and state individual and business tax returns, including: 
 
 
 
 Complex individual returns involving Schedules C, E, and D/Form 8949 
 
 
 Passive activity loss rules and Form 8582 
 
 
 At-risk limitations and rental real estate professional status 
 
 
 Section 199A/QBI calculations, including aggregation elections and SSTB limitations 
 
 
 K-1 reporting and basis tracking for partnerships, S corporations, and trusts 
 
 
 Alternative Minimum Tax and Net Investment Income Tax 
 
 
 Multi-state individual taxation, including residency, domicile, part-year and nonresident allocation, reciprocity agreements, and credits for taxes paid to other states 
 
 
 Estimated tax and safe harbor calculations, including underpayment penalty analysis 
 
 
 Partnership taxation, including inside and outside basis, capital accounts, guaranteed payments, and special allocations 
 
 
 S corporation taxation, including shareholder basis limitations, reasonable compensation, built-in gains tax, and distribution ordering rules 
 
 
 Depreciation strategy involving MACRS, Section 179, bonus depreciation, and Section 1031 like-kind exchanges 
 
 
 Multi-state business taxation, including nexus, apportionment, combined or consolidated filings, and state-specific adjustments 
 
 
 Book-to-tax reconciliations, including Schedule M-1 and M-2 
 
 
 Consolidated and multi-entity return structures 
 
 
 
 Perform technical reviews of tax returns prepared by other team members, identifying substantive issues related to tax treatment, entity structure, basis, multi-state taxation, and overall accuracy. 
 
 
 Research complex tax questions using primary authority, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, revenue rulings, case law, and professional tax research platforms. 
 
 
 Respond to IRS and state notices, including CP2000 and underreporter no

title: Customer Success Associate
description: Enerzyz  is an AI-powered asset orchestration platform that helps industrial facilities, commercial buildings, and data centers run more efficiently. Our work involves developing real-time intelligent systems for any facility's asset management through agentic automation. This role is designed for building a high-performance customer organization capable of bridging AI, engineering operations, and long-term client value. We are looking for engineers who can hold a technical conversation and a commercial one in the same meeting.      About the Role:   Deploying an AI system into a live facility is only the beginning. The value shows up months later, in energy saved, equipment protected, and operators who trust the system enough to leave it running. Making that happen is the work of Customer Success. In physical AI, customer success is a technical discipline. You are dealing with real assets, real energy bills, and operations teams who are professionally skeptical of anything that promises to run their plant better than they do. Winning that trust and keeping it is the job. The role suits an engineer who enjoys people as much as systems.       In this role, you will:     Own the pre and post-deployment relationship for a portfolio of industrial and commercial customers, serving as their primary point of contact and trusted advisor.  Drive onboarding and adoption by training facility teams, operators, and management on the platform, and by establishing the routines that turn a new system into a daily habit.  Track and report value realization energy savings, operational performance, asset health, system uptime and present results clearly to both engineering and executive stakeholders.  Monitor account health proactively, identifying declining usage, unresolved issues, or unrealized value before the customer has to raise them.  Systematically collect customer feedback, feature requests, pain points, and field observations, and relay them to the product and engineering teams with the context needed to act on them. Conduct regular business reviews with customers, translating platform performance into operational and financial outcomes that matter to their leadership.  Identify opportunities for expansion across additional sites, assets, or capabilities, and support renewal and growth conversations.  Build the playbooks, documentation, training material, and repor

description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of KD Pharma, GT is looking for a Senior Azure Data Engineer with architecture exposure, interested in assessing, designing, and potentially building a modern data platform to support Finance, Operations/Supply Chain, and Quality/Manufacturing functions.

**Expected Involvement: The engagement is expected to begin with a 6-week discovery phase of approximately 30 hours per week (180 hours total). Following successful completion of the discovery phase and client approval, there is potential to transition into a long-term, full-time implementation role.

About the Client

Founded in 1988, KD Pharma is a technology-driven CDMO (Contract Development & Manufacturing Organization) specializing in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical production, including ultra-pure Omega-3 concentrates.

The company operates internationally, with locations across Germany, Norway, the UK, the USA, Canada and Peru, and provides end-to-end solutions from development and custom synthesis through to finished dosage forms.

About the Project

KD Pharma is looking to modernize its current data and reporting environment and establish a scalable, maintainable Microsoft-based data platform supporting multiple business systems and reporting needs. The current landscape spans roughly nine source systems across Business Central, legacy NAV, QuickBooks and other integrations, with reporting currently relying on a mix of direct ERP/SQL connections and Power BI.

The engagement will initially start with a 6-week Discovery Phase, focused on understanding the existing data estate and defining the target architecture, platform approach and implementation roadmap.

During Discovery, the team will:

  • Assess the existing data landscape, integrations and data flows

  • Identify key architectural, data-quality and integration gaps

  • Design the target lakehouse / medallion architecture

  • Evaluate Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory and Databricks and recommend the most suitable approach

  • Define the first implementation / PoC scope and the roadmap for the subsequent build phase

If Discovery is successful and the client approves the implementation, the project is expected to continue into a longer-term build phase, starting with the agreed PoC and expanding into implementation of the wider data platform.

This is a hands-on Senior Data Engineer

description: Paired is an overseas staffing agency that connects top talent to remote opportunities with employers in the U.S. and beyond. We believe great jobs shouldn't be limited by location, and we're here to help you find remote roles that match your skills and career goals.   About Our Clients    Our client is a fast-growing DTC supplement brand known for its Cocktail, a daily powder drink featuring ashwagandha, magnesium, L-theanine, and vitamin D3, alongside its Cortisol Cocktail line.  With an 8-figure run rate, a team of approximately 30 people, and a fully remote setup, they are now building its subscription business as a dedicated P&L.  They are looking for a Subscription Manager to own subscription growth and profitability end to end. Your goal is simple: convert as many customers as possible into subscribers at maximum profit, and retain those subscribers for as long and as profitably as possible.  This is a hands-on ownership role reporting directly to the founder/CEO. The strongest candidates will have personally built or scaled a DTC subscription program and can demonstrate measurable results through metrics such as subscription take rate, churn, retention, and offer-test performance.   Responsibilities     Own and optimize the brand subscription offer, including pricing structure, discount logic, subscription take-rate tests, post-purchase subscription upsells, and retention incentives.  Design and continuously improve the subscription journey to increase conversion while protecting long-term profitability.  Own the customer-side subscription experience, including the subscription portal, cancellation flow, save offers, onboarding, billing reminders, dunning, and winback initiatives.  Own the subscription technology setup, including the subscription app, checkout, payment provider, app costs, and potential platform migrations.  Work with developers, vendors, agencies, and advisors to implement technical and operational improvements without needing to build everything yourself.  Own subscription economics, including discount guardrails, LTV break-even points, and actual cohort performance versus the financial model.  Analyze subscription performance and run structured tests to identify opportunities to improve take rate, retention, churn, and profitability.  Build and scale the subscription function as its own P&L, taking responsibility for outcomes across the entire subscriber lifecycle.  Make decisions based on measurable business impact, with success ultimately measured by 90-day subscription profit per new customer.     What Success Looks Like   Your primary success metric is 90-day subscription profit per new customer.  You will be expected to increase the number of customers who become subscribers, improve the profitability of the subscription offer, and keep subscribers active for longer.  This is a role for someone who can show evidence of having done this before—not someone looking to learn subscription growth on the job.

title: Implementation Manager BELUX– Remote-First
description: 🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays   In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.  The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.  Wero is live in Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands and launching very soon in Luxembourg and Austria. Through regular engagement with individual members and the wider ecosystem, you will foster collaboration, share best practices, and build momentum. You will be the go-to person for aligning efforts, resolving challenges, and maintaining a 360-degree view of progress, serving as the internal champion for EPI members and making a vital contribution to bringing EPI's vision to life.  At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country they are based in, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.   🐝 About The Team   You will report directly to our Chief Implementation Officer, who brings extensive project management experience in the payments sector. You will also be part of a team of experienced Implementation Managers. In your day-to-day work, you will interact regularly with members of EPI's Product, Scheme, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations teams.    💥  Your impact    Onboarding of new members      Support new members through onboarding, co-design their EPI implementation plan, and set up appropriate project governance  Oversee the end-to-end delivery of the plan   Act as the central liaison between the EPI member and the EPI organization, ensuring    timely deployment by guiding the member's project manager    Manage all dimensions of the implementation (tech, legal, branding, marketing,    product) and facilitate sessions to resolve product, rules, and technical challenges     Lead and prepare the steerco's together with the member's project manager     Monitor and Report on Implementation Progress      Track and report KPIs, identify risks and mitigation strategies, and provide clear, actionable reporting to stakeholders  Contribute to the further fine-tuning of the EPI implementation approach   Together with your fellow implementation managers, continuously refine the roll-out    and onboar

title: Onboarding Specialist
description: Creëer dè 100% onboarding ervaring voor onze nieuwe collega's.      Bij Schuberg Philis zeggen we vaak: it's the people, actually. Uiteindelijk maken mensen het verschil, in ons werk en in hoe we elkaar welkom heten. De eerste weken bij een nieuw bedrijf zijn spannend. Daarom zorgen we dat nieuwe collega's zich vanaf dag één thuis voelen. Daar zoeken we jou voor.      Wat je gaat doen   Je begeleidt nieuwe collega's vanaf het moment dat ze tekenen tot ver na hun eerste werkweek. Schuberg Philis groeit hard: we verwelkomen 15 tot 50 nieuwe collega's per maand. Jij zorgt dat dat voor ieder van hen persoonlijk en vlekkeloos verloopt.     Concreet betekent dat:   Je stelt arbeidsovereenkomsten op en zorgt dat ze rond komen.  Je activeert en bewaakt de pre-employment screening en volgt de rapportages op.  Je plant het onboardingprogramma en alles eromheen: rondetafelgesprekken, de Founders lunch, afspraken met de onafhankelijk financieel adviseur.  Je begeleidt nieuwe collega's die uit het buitenland komen en schakelt met onze externe partners voor relocation, visa, werkvergunningen en de 30%-regeling.  Je draait mee tijdens ons maandelijkse onboardingprogramma als begeleider van de nieuwe collega's op die dag.  Je stemt af met ons restaurant- en hospitalityteam en zorgt dat presentatoren van onboardingsessies op tijd klaarstaan.  Je werkt in AFAS, Greenhouse en Slack en houdt de administratie kloppend.      Dit is een baan met veel context switching. Je bent de hele dag in gesprek: met nieuwe collega's, met het team, met partners. Geen dag is hetzelfde en dat vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt en rustig blijft als er veel tegelijk speelt.      Het team   Je wordt onderdeel van ons Recruiting & Onboarding team van 18 collega's, en we groeien door. Binnen het team bouwen we aan een coördinatieteam van vier: twee collega's richten zich op het inplannen van interviews, twee op onboarding. Jullie zijn elkaars backup, dus je staat er nooit alleen voor.      Wat je meebrengt    Ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol, bijvoorbeeld als onboarding coordinator, recruitment coordinator, HR operations medewerker of executive assistant.  Je werkt secuur en hebt oog voor detail, ook bij hoge volumes.  Je denkt in oplossingen en krijgt mensen mee, of het nu gaat om een volle agenda of een presentator die nog moet bevestigen  Je vindt het leuk om processen slimmer te maken.  Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels.  Ervaring met AFAS of Greenhouse is mooi meegenomen, geen vereiste.      Herken je jezelf niet in elk punt, maar denk je dat deze rol bij je past? Solliciteer gerust. We kijken naar de hele persoon, niet naar een afvinklijst.

description: Job Description    Who we are and what we do   Biology is the most powerful technology on the planet. It cures disease, feeds civilizations, and decarbonizes entire industries. And yet the scientists and labs producing the breakthroughs that will define the next century still run on pen and paper, pipettes, and spreadsheets.  We're fixing that. Reshape is building the operating system for biological research – robotics and AI that automate data capture and turn raw experiments into decisions. Our customers are the largest R&D and FMCG organizations on Earth. The work they do with us shows up as faster cures, better food, and cleaner industry.  We're hiring a Strategic Account Manager in Copenhagen to own our most important customer relationships and turn them into our biggest ones.   The role   Landing a global biotech or FMCG giant is hard. Turning one lab into forty, and into an enterprise wide implementation is harder, and that's where the real revenue is for us.  You'll own a portfolio of our largest accounts, and you'll be measured on what happens after the first contract is signed. Net revenue retention, expansion ARR, renewals, multi-year commitments. This is not a farming role where you check in once a quarter and hope. These accounts have hundreds of sites, competing budget holders, and internal politics you have to navigate before you can grow anything.  One day you're on site watching a lab actually use the system, spotting the workflow next door that nobody has automated yet. The next you're building the business case that takes a single-team pilot to a global rollout, then defending it against a procurement manager who's decided renewal season is a good moment to grind you down on terms. You're equally at home in all of it.  You run the expansion cycle end to end. Map the account, find the decision makers, build the case for the org, negotiate it, close it. You own the renewal too, so you're protecting the base while you grow it. There is no inherited corporate playbook. You build the account strategy and you own the number.   What We're Looking For   A track record of growing complex enterprise accounts in SaaS, biotech, deeptech, hardware, or life sciences. You've taken a beachhead deal and multiplied it, and you can explain exactly how you did it. A scientific background isn't a must, but you need to soak up knowledge like a sponge and carry yourself with confidence. You can hold your own with a Principal Scientist, then translate operational value into strategic value a CFO will sign.  You generate expansion pipeline rather than wait for it. New sites, new teams, new use cases, exec relationships built. Whatever it takes. You spot churn risk a quarter before it shows up in a dashboard, and you deal with it then. You move fast, decide with incomplete information, and don't need a manager to tell you what matters this week.  What you getThe chance to put real points on the board at a company building something genuinely hard

title: Key Account Manager
description: F&B Account Manager     General Scope:  The F&B Account Manager is responsible for managing one or more assigned Food & Beverage (F&B) customer accounts. The primary objective is to create customer value through expert technical service, ensure revenue retention, maintain profit margins, and identify opportunities for product growth within existing accounts. While acquiring new business may occur, this is not the core focus of the role.     Key Responsibilities:  Manage and grow assigned F&B customer accounts.  Deliver technical service and application support to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.  Identify opportunities for up-selling and cross-selling products within assigned accounts.  Maintain pricing discipline and gross profit targets.  Analyze customer needs and usage trends to recommend tailored solutions.  Prepare account reviews and performance reports as required.  Coordinate with internal teams (technical, supply chain, marketing) to fulfill customer needs.  Ensure full compliance with company safety and ethical standards.     Knowledge & Expertise:  Deep understanding of F&B industry processes and challenges.  Applied technical knowledge of chemical solutions and sanitation processes used in F&B production environments.  Familiarity with HACCP, ISO, and local food safety regulations.  Strong relationship management and communication skills.  Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office suite.     Job Complexity:  Works independently on moderately complex service and account management tasks.  Conducts root cause analysis, prepares service recommendations, and implements corrective actions.  Interprets technical data and performance metrics to drive customer success.  May mentor or guide junior team members.     Impact:  Direct impact on customer retention, sales revenue, and gross margin.  Plays a key role in maintaining client satisfaction and long-term partnerships.  Errors could affect contract renewal or customer perception.

title: Customer Operations Manager
description: Tapster is a Swedish fintech company building payment wearables such as rings, bracelets, watch straps and keyrings. We work with banks, fintechs and payment partners across Europe, while also selling directly to consumers through gotapster.com.     We are now looking for a  Customer Operations Manager  who can take ownership of our day-to-day customer operations and help us build a more scalable setup as we grow. This is a hands-on role. You will lead and support our customer service team, but also work closely with logistics, fulfillment, returns, Shopify, B2B campaigns and internal operations.       The role      You will be responsible for making sure our customer operations run smoothly and that customers get fast, clear and high-quality support.     Your responsibilities will include:      Leading and supporting our day-to-day customer service team  Handling more complex customer cases and escalations  Improving routines, templates, FAQs and internal processes  Monitoring response times, backlog and service quality  Managing returns, replacements and order exceptions  Coordinating with warehouses and fulfilment partners  Working in Shopify and other customer service and operational systems  Supporting B2B campaigns and larger partner launches from an operational perspective  Identifying recurring customer issues and working with Product, Operations and Tech to solve the root cause  Helping us build a customer operations function that can scale as Tapster grows      You will report to the COO and work closely with Sales, Product, Tech and our external logistics partners.      Who we are looking for      We think you have 2–3 years of experience from customer service, e-commerce, customer operations or a similar operational role. You do not need to have been a manager before, but you should be comfortable taking responsibility, making decisions and helping more junior colleagues develop.     We think you will be a good fit if you:      Have 2–3 years of relevant experience  Have worked in e-commerce, retail, fintech or another consumer-facing business  Are comfortable working in Shopify or similar platforms  Understand how customer service, logistics and fulfilment fit together  Are structured and good at keeping track of several things at once  Communicate clearly and professionally in both Swedish and English  Are comfortable solving problems without always having a finished playbook  Enjoy working in a small company where roles are broad and things move quickly

JD is available in Japanese only.   カスタマサポートスペシャリスト/ Customer Support Specialist - Mercari      雇用形態：正社員  勤務地：六本木  働き方：フレックスタイム制（コアタイムなし）  カスタマーサービス部門勤務体制：   標準労働時間：10:00～19:00（※顧客管理業務のため10:00開始）  オンコール対応：土日祝 10:00～19:00  緊急時迅速対応のため当番制 / 手当は社内規定により支給   ※配属チームにより異なります。      詳細はキャリアサイトの募集要項よりご確認ください   メルカリグループについて    あらゆる価値を循環させ、あらゆる人の可能性を広げる   「地球資源が限られているなか、より豊かな社会をつくるために何ができるか」。2013年、創業者の山田進太郎が世界一周の旅で抱いた課題意識から、フリマアプリ「メルカリ」は生まれました。私たちは、物理的なモノやお金に限らずあらゆる価値を循環させることで、誰もがやりたいことを実現し、人や社会に貢献するための選択肢を増やすことができると信じています。  テクノロジーの力で世界中の人々をつなぎ、あらゆる人の可能性が発揮される世界を実現していきます。メルカリグループの目指すべき方針については Mercari Culture Doc をご覧ください。   組織・チームのミッション   メルカリグループのカスタマーサービス組織は、株式会社メルカリおよび株式会社メルペイにおいて、個人のお客さま向けのカスタマーサポートと、より良いカスタマーエクスペリエンス（CX）の設計・運営を担う組織です。  私たちのミッションは、「お問い合わせを減らす」ことだけではなく、お客さまが困ることなくサービスをご利用いただける体験を実現することです。オペレーションプロセスの最適化、オペレーターのパフォーマンス向上、プロダクト改善への提案、自動化の推進などを通じて、お客さまの課題を迅速に解決し、より良い顧客体験の実現に貢献します。  また、AIをはじめとするテクノロジーを活用したCS変革（CS-AX）の企画・実行と、ナレッジ・コンテンツ管理・育成を通じて、オペレーションの効率化と体験品質の向上を同時に実現することも実行していきます。2029年までにお問い合わせの大部分をAIにより解決させることを目指し、ユーザーにとってのエフォートレスな体験を追求していくこともミッションとしています。    メルカリのミッション・バリューについての詳細はこちらをご覧ください      各チームのご紹介     Customer Support Specialist - title: Palvelupäällikkö
description: Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Jyväskylä   Haluatko johtaa omaa palvelualueettasi ja vastata asiakkuuksien, henkilöstön ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.  Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.  Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.  Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.  Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.   Odotamme sinulta    Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto sekä kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja palveluliiketoiminnasta. Sinulla on valmiuksia johtaa muutosta ja viedä kehitystä käytäntöön. Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista.Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.  Työskentelemme hybridimallilla, ja päätoimipaikkasi sijaitsee Jyväskylän toimistollamme. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat Keski-Suomi ja Etelä-Savo, joten liikut työssäsi säännöllisesti eri paikkakunnilla alueen sisällä. Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.  Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää lisäksi sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa, sillä työskentelet kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja kommunikoit säännöllisesti englanniksi.   Tarjoamme sinulle    Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.  Lisäksi tarjoamme:     kilpailukykyisen palkan (n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen)   kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen   mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa   kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön   turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön

title: Senior Project Manager
description: Oletko kokenut projektijohtaja, joka on vienyt läpi laajoja käyttöönottoprojekteja, transformaatioita tai organisaatiotason muutoksia? Hae osaksi Solitan Cloud Platformsin asiantuntevaa ja rentoa projektipäällikköyhteisöä!       Projektijohtamista ihmiset keskiössä       Solitan projektipäällikköyhteisö on kasvava, yli sadasta asiantuntijasta muodostuva aktiivinen ja toisiaan tukeva yhteisö, jonka osaajat johtavat erilaisia digitalisaatiohankkeita asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnan kehittämiseksi.      Vaikka projektimme ovat monipuolisia ja projektipäällikön rooli sekä työn sisältö voivat vaihdella asiakkuuksittain, olemme tunnistaneet keskeiset teemat, jotka ohjaavat jokaisen solitalaisen projektipäällikön työtä. Näiden pohjalta olemme luoneet yhteisen Project Lead Manifeston.       Johtamaan laajaa digitaalisen työympäristön muutoshanketta       Haemme kokenutta Senior Project Manageria johtamaan asiakkaamme laajaa digitaalisen työympäristön muutoshanketta. Projektin keskiössä on siirtyminen Microsoft 365 -ympäristöstä Google Workspaceen sekä siihen liittyvien käyttöönottojen, koulutusten, viestinnän ja muutoksenhallinnan koordinointi.      Kyseessä ei ole perinteinen IT-projekti, vaan koko organisaation toimintatapoihin vaikuttava muutos. Projektissa yhdistyvät teknologia, käyttöönotot, koulutukset, viestintä, muutosjohtaminen sekä erittäin suuren käyttäjäjoukon vaiheittainen siirtymä uuteen työympäristöön.      Roolissa toimit asiakkaan ensisijaisena projektijohdon kumppanina ja vastaat hankkeen etenemisestä yhdessä asiakkaan, Solitan asiantuntijoiden sekä muiden toimittajien kanssa. Onnistuminen edellyttää kykyä hallita useista työvirroista muodostuvaa kokonaisuutta, johtaa eri sidosryhmiä yhteisen tavoitteen suuntaan sekä pitää fokuksen siinä, mikä on käyttäjien ja asiakkaan näkökulmasta olennaista.       Mitä työ käytännössä sisältää?       Vastaat hankkeen kokonaisjohtamisesta sekä projektin onnistumisesta yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa.     Tyypillisiä vastuitasi ovat:       projektin suunnittelu, ohjaus ja seuranta   asiakkaan projektiorganisaation tukeminen päätöksenteossa   useiden rinnakkaisten työvirtojen koordinointi   toimittaja- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyö   riskien, riippuvuuksien ja muutosten hallinta   käyttöönottojen suunnittelu ja koordinointi   koulutus- ja viestintäkokonaisuuksien ohjaaminen   projektin etenemisen raportointi johdolle ja ohjausryhmille       Työssäsi teet tiivistä yhteistyötä Workspace-asiantuntijoiden, muutosjohtamisen osaajien, kouluttajien sekä asiakkaan edustajien kanssa.      Millaiseen ympäristöön tulet?       Solitalla projektipäälliköt eivät jää yksin. Projektijohtamisen yhteisömme koostuu kokeneista asiantuntijoista, jotka työskentelevät erilaisissa transformaatio-, data-, ohjelmistokehitys-, pilvi- ja liiketoiminnan kehitysprojekteissa.      Osaamista jaetaan aktiivisesti, sparrausapua löytyy matalalla kynnyksellä ja yhteisön kehittäminen tehdään yhdessä. Työssä yhdistyvät projektijohtamisen parhaat puolet:

年以上の経験   優れたコミュニケーションスキルとファシリテーションスキル   ビジネスレベルの日本語（簡潔かつ明確に表現する文書作成能力、会話）   中級レベルの英語力（CEFR B2レベル相当、ビジネスコミュニケーションや職場での業務に対応できる）   並行して複数のプロジェクトを管理した経験   変化の多い環境下でプロセス、優先事項に迅速に適応する能力   プロセススタンダードに関するトレーニングの経験   適切なメカニズムを活用して計画通りにプロジェクトを推進する管理能力     Preferred Qualifications      2 年以上のアマゾンでのオペレーション管理経験   上級レベルの英語力（CEFR C1レベル相当、複雑な英語要件に対応できる）   オペレーション、またはそれに関連する技術分野の学位 title: Senior CRO Specialist
description:
About Entyre

Caregiving is broken. We’re fixing it with technology. Entyre is the holding behind Pflegewegweiser (Switzerland), Entyre Care (United States), and the Pflegewegweiser Shop. We operate as one system across our offices in Berlin, Boston, and Zurich: 450+ people developing the technology, products, and growth strategies that power all three brands. Our platform connects family caregivers with compensation programs through selfonboarding funnels, automated eligibility engines, and digital care management. In the US, families discover Entyre Care through paid and organic channels, land on our landing pages, and move through a multi-step journey in the Hub, our self-service platform, until they are fully enrolled. Hub processes differ by state, and every screen along the journey is a potential drop-off point. Your job is to find those points and fix them.

The Role

You will join the Marketing team in our Berlin office and own testing and optimization across the entire funnel, from the first landing page impression to a won customer. Your initial focus is the US market and the Entyre Care funnels, with the technology and learnings you build serving the whole group. This is a senior, high-ownership role with direct impact on how many families we can help and how fast. The Hub is our proprietary self-onboarding app that guides a family caregiver from the first eligibility check through document collection and third-party sign-offs to a completed Medicaid enrollment. Requirements differ by state, so the Hub runs a different flow in every market and there is no single funnel to optimize. You will work across multiple state-specific flows, prioritize the biggest leaks, and choose the right method for each situation. Where traffic supports it, you run clean A/B tests. description: Serviceleder til Netto – ledelse med fokus på kundeservice og trivsel    Er du passioneret omkring ledelse, kundeservice og et stærkt team? Som serviceleder i Netto bliver du den synlige frontfigur, der sikrer, at vores kunder altid møder en indbydende butik og et engageret personale. Du spiller en central rolle i at skabe gode kundeoplevelser, der får folk til at komme igen.  Du er tæt på dit team, går forrest og bygger en kultur, hvor samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus. Du planlægger bemanding, oplærer nye kolleger og sikrer, at alle arbejder med kunden i centrum.   Dine ansvarsområder:      Daglig ledelse og motivation af medarbejdere  Sikre høj kundeservice og en butik, der altid fremstår indbydende  Udarbejde vagtplaner og følge op på lønbudget  Oplæring og træning af nye kolleger  Være stedfortræder for butikschefen ved behov     Vi søger dig, der:      Har erfaring med personaleledelse  Er struktureret og tydelig i din kommunikation  Brænder for at skabe trivsel og gode kundeoplevelser     Vi tilbyder: En lederrolle med fokus på medarbejderudvikling og kultur, grundig oplæring og løbende lederudvikling – samt mulighed for karriere i Danmarks største detailkæde.   Alle de gode grunde til at blive serviceleder i Netto    Stillingen er en super mulighed for at være med i et dagligvareeventyr. Du bliver en del af et stærkt team og engagerede kollegaer. Og du har med dit engagement mulighed for at sætte retningen for dit helt eget serviceteam.   Du kan også glæde dig til:      Mulighed for fx akademiuddannelse og lederuddannelse  Konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og bonusordning  Sundhedsforsikring  Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks  Mulighed for leje af vores feriehuse og lejligheder i ind- og udland  Adgang til Salling online personaleshop med 35% rabat  Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat     Bliv en del af Netto-ånden :  Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok.  Hos Netto skal alle medarbejdere opleve, at de er en del af et stærkt team, hvor de føler sig respekteret, og deres indsats er højt værdsat. Vi tilbyder varierende opgaver, der motiverer og udvikler dig – både til gavn for din fremtid hos os eller andre steder. Vi tager et stort ansvar for at gøre hverdagen bedre for medarbejdere, kunder og det samfund, vi er en del af.   Er du vores nye kollega?    Send din ansøgning online til os via knappen nedenfor. Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så søg allerede i dag.   Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Payment Operations Lead
description:
Payment Operations Lead

Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for a Payment Operations hire to own the part of Outpost where the money actually moves.

When we become the legal reseller in a market, we take the payment. Every merchant we onboard gets its own merchant ID and its own merchant category code, never pooled into one shared code, which is exactly why our approval rates beat the alternatives. Keeping that true across every market, every processor and every merchant is the job.

title: Medical Secretary - 12 Month Fixed Term
description:
What is the job?

Great patient care doesn't just happen in the consultation room, it starts with a well-organised, supported and connected team behind the scenes.

We are looking for a Medical Secretary to join Montu UK on a 12-month fixed-term maternity cover contract. In this fast-paced role, you'll be the organisational backbone of our clinical team, helping to keep everything running smoothly so our clinicians can focus on what they do best — delivering exceptional care to patients.

From coordinating clinician schedules and managing clinical administration to supporting meetings and keeping important documentation up to date, you'll play a key role in making sure our day-to-day operations run seamlessly. You'll be juggling priorities, solving problems and keeping things moving, no two days are the same.

If you're highly organised, naturally proactive, enjoy supporting others and get satisfaction from making sure everything is exactly where it needs to be, you'll fit right in.

This is a full-time, fixed-term maternity cover contract for 12 months, working 40 hours per week.

What will you be doing?

As our Medical Secretary, you will be at the heart of keeping the clinical team organised and supported by:

  • Preparing, maintaining and updating clinician rotas to ensure excellent clinical coverage.

  • Resolving rota conflicts and communicating schedule changes quickly and effectively.

  • Providing day-to-day administrative support to clinicians and the wider medical team.

This is a hands-on, people-first role where you’ll partner closely with our rapidly growing Patient Experience function, supporting managers and teams through a period of significant growth and transformation. You’ll play a key role in shaping the employee experience, building management capability, and helping teams perform at their best in a fast-paced operational environment.

This role is not for a HR generalist. It is for a true subject matter expert, that specialises in employee relations, performance, coaching managers through complex situations and driving people initiatives. You’ll be right at the heart of the action and a trusted partner to the business, spending time at both our London (Kings Cross) and Winnersh (Reading) offices every week.

title: Ecommerce Brand Manager
description:
Entropy sells survival, power and preparedness gear in the US. Around $525k a year, currently at contribution margin neutral. Almost all of it is other people's product resold at 9-12% margin, which caps what the business can earn.

Own-brand product and better acquisition economics are the fix. That's the job.

You'd own the P&L and report to Jack and Lasse weekly. Nobody else is doing this.

Tasks

  • Own blended gross margin, moving it from 12% to 25%, and take the business through breakeven.
  • Source and launch own-brand SKUs. Suppliers, MOQ negotiation, samples, freight, duty, 3PL, listings, launch.
  • Run paid acquisition yourself. Google Shopping, PMax and Search. There's no agency and there won't be one.
  • Site and conversion work. Product pages, imagery, copy, checkout, cart abandonment.
  • Build attach and post-purchase revenue. Checkout upsells, replenishment, email flows.
  • Restart the content engine. Video cadence, TikTok, YouTube, UGC and reviews.
  • Manage the existing dropship catalogue on margin, cutting what doesn't pay.
  • First 90 days: paid spend cut on every SKU below 15% margin, even where that drops revenue. Google Ads moved in-house. First own-brand order placed. Attach offers live at checkout. Blended gross margin at 16%.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Launched a physical product end to end. Sourced it, negotiated MOQ, approved samples, managed freight, priced it, listed it, sold it
  • Run Google Ads yourself on a Shopping-led store. In the account, not briefing an agency
  • Owned a gross margin or P&L number, not a revenue or ROAS number
  • Operated at $500k-5m, where you wrote the product page and answered the customer emails
  • Comfortable cutting revenue to fix margin
  • Work independently. No team, no budget approver, nobody checking your work between weekly calls

Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

title: Sales Engineer (w/m/x) DACH
description:
Nuventura ist ein in Berlin ansässiges Climate-Tech-Unternehmen, das eine neue Generation von Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen entwickelt – hochinnovativ und gleichzeitig nachhaltig. Mit unserer patentierten gasisolierten Technologie ersetzen wir SF₆ – eines der klimaschädlichsten Treibhausgase – durch saubere, trockene Luft und erreichen dabei die gleiche Zuverlässigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit wie konventionelle Systeme.

Unsere Mission ist es, den globalen Übergang zu einer nachhaltigen elektrischen Infrastruktur zu beschleunigen. Dafür arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle von tiefgehender Engineering-Expertise, industriellen Partnerschaften und schneller Produktentwicklung. Unser Produktportfolio wächst dynamisch durch neue Entwicklungsprojekte und internationale Skalierungsaktivitäten. Als interdisziplinäres und engineering-getriebenes Unternehmen ermöglichen wir Energieversorgern und Herstellern weltweit, SF₆-freie Technologie zu etablieren und Stromnetze zukunftssicher zu machen.

Deine Rolle

Als Sales Engineer (w/m/x) DACH treibst du den technischen und kaufmännischen Vertrieb unserer SF₆-freien Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen in der DACH-Region voran. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen zu Verteilnetzbetreibern (DSOs), EPC-Unternehmen und anderen Marktteilnehmern. Du übersetzt Kundenanforderungen in überzeugende technische Angebote und trägst so direkt zum Umsatzwachstum und langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen bei.

Aufgaben

  • Analyse und Erstellung technischer Angebote und Kalkulationen auf Basis von Kundenspezifikationen.
  • Unterstützung von Kundenterminen, technischen Klärungen und Aktivitäten zur Kundenentwicklung.
  • Ansprechpartner:in für DSOs, EPCs und Partner bei technischen Anfragen.
  • Erstellung und Einreichung von Angeboten für Ausschreibungen, RFIs und RFQs.
  • Teilnahme an technischen und kaufmännischen Meetings mit Kunden, DSOs und Partnern.

title: Sales Engineer (f/m/x) DACH
description:
Nuventura is a Berlin-based climate tech company developing a new generation of medium-voltage switchgear that is both highly innovative and environmentally sustainable. With our patented gas-insulated technology, we replace SF₆ — one of the most harmful greenhouse gases — with clean, dry air, while maintaining the same reliability and performance as conventional systems.

Our mission is to accelerate the global transition toward sustainable electrical infrastructure. To achieve this, we work at the intersection of deep engineering expertise, industrial partnerships, and rapid product development. Our product portfolio is expanding quickly through new development projects and international scaling activities. As an interdisciplinary and engineering-driven company, we enable utilities and manufacturers worldwide to adopt SF₆-free technology and make power grids future-proof.

Your Role

As a Sales Engineer (f/m/x) DACH, you will drive the technical and commercial sales of Nuventura’s SF₆-free medium-voltage switchgear across the DACH region. You will play a key role in developing and growing accounts with DSOs, EPCs, and other market players, turning customer requirements into compelling technical offers. Your work will directly contribute to revenue growth and long-term account relationships.

  • Support customer meetings, technical clarifications, and account development activities.

  • Prepare and submit responses to tenders, RFIs, and RFQs.
  • Join technical and commercial meetings with customers, DSOs, and partners.
  • Develop and grow assigned accounts in the DACH region.
  • Coordinate with engineering teams on non-standard requirements.

title: Teamleder Onboarding
description: Vi søker en fremoverlent og handlekraftig Teamleder for Onboarding som vil få en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle hvordan vi tar imot og får nye kunder godt i gang med Duetts løsninger.  Som Teamleder får du det overordnede ansvaret for onboarding av kunder på tvers av våre produkter – Duett Økonomi, Duett Prosjekt, Duett Eiendom og Taskline. I løpet av høsten lanserer vi også Duett Lager og Duett Landbruk, og en viktig del av rollen blir å etablere gode, effektive og skalerbare onboardingsprogrammer for disse produktene.  Dette er en operativ teamlederrolle. Du skal lede og utvikle teamet, men samtidig være tett på kundene og selv delta aktivt i onboardinger og andre leveranser. Vi ser derfor etter deg som trives like godt med å få ting gjort som med å skape struktur, retning og utvikling for teamet.   Ditt ansvar     Ha det overordnede ansvaret for kundeonboarding på tvers av Duetts produktportefølje.  Videreutvikle og standardisere onboardingsløp for Duett Økonomi, Duett Prosjekt, Duett Eiendom og Taskline.  Etablere gode og skalerbare onboardingsprogrammer for nye produkter, herunder Duett Lager og Duett Landbruk.  Delta aktivt og operativt i kundeonboardinger og konsulentleveranser.  Lede og utvikle teamet, inkludert personalansvar, oppfølging og kompetanseutvikling.  Ha ansvar for et team som bistår kunder med konvertering og import av data fra andre systemer, samt integrasjoner og offboardinger.  Jobbe systematisk med å forbedre, forenkle og effektivisere arbeidsprosesser sammen med teamet.  Følge opp teamets mål, nøkkeltall og leveranser, samt identifisere og gjennomføre forbedringstiltak.  Samarbeide tett med Produkt, Utvikling og øvrige team for å løfte innspill fra kunder og support inn i videre produktutvikling.  Bidra aktivt i ledergruppen i Customer Operations og støtte opp under selskapets mål, strategi og verdier.     Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av å skape forbedringer og som ikke nødvendigvis tenker at «slik har vi alltid gjort det» er den beste måten å løse en oppgave på.  Du er fremoverlent, strukturert og løsningsorientert, og du liker å gå fra idé til handling. Du evner å se både helheten og detaljene og trives med å skape struktur i områder hvor det finnes muligheter for forbedring.   Vi Tror Du     Har erfaring innen regnskap og god forståelse for regnskapsprosesser.  Har erfaring med ledelse, eller et sterkt ønske om å utvikle deg som leder.  Trives med å kombinere operativt arbeid og personalledelse.  Er strukturert, løsningsorientert og god til å prioritere.  Motiveres av å utvikle mennesker, bygge team og skape gode resultater sammen med andre.  Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner.     Hvorfor denne rollen?   Onboarding er en viktig del av kundens første møte med Duett etter at de har valgt løsningene våre. Ambisjonen vår er å gjøre denne reisen stadig enklere, raskere og mer forutsigbar – både for kunden og for oss.  Som Teamleder for Onboarding får du muligheten til å påvirke

Je bent niet zomaar een accountmanager; je bent de onmisbare schakel die ervoor zorgt dat de festivalorganisatie stressvrij kan knallen.   Wie zoeken wij?  De festivalwereld kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je spreekt de taal van organisatoren, snapt de dynamiek van een productieweek en raakt niet in de stress van een naderende deadline.    De festival-insider:  Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met en ervaring in de festival- en eventindustrie. Je kent de wetten van het terrein.   Tech-savvy & adviserend:  Je begrijpt hoe software en hardware (ticketing, apps, payment) de backend van een event versterken en kunt dit helder overbrengen op de klant.   Communicatief ijzersterk:  Je bent een natuurlijke relatiebouwer, kunt snel schakelen en bent organisatorisch een talent.   Flexibel:  Festivals houden zich niet aan kantoortijden. Jij vindt het geen probleem om flexibel te werken als het seizoen daarom vraagt.      Wat bieden wij jou?   Een sleutelrol binnen een snelgroeiend en innovatief techbedrijf in de vetste branche van Nederland.  Een marktconform salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.  Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden (inclusief laptop, reiskostenregeling en kantoorlunch).  Een dynamische werkomgeving met een gezellig, ambitieus team.  Uiteraard: toegang tot de events waar we met trots voor werken.      Solliciteren?   Heb jij de energie van een festival en de scherpte van een top-acco

description: Smile.io is the world’s largest loyalty platform, providing easy-to-use reward programs that help scaling ecommerce brands transform one-time sales into repeat purchases from loyal customers. Over 100,000 brands use Smile to turn transactional purchases into passionate repeat shoppers. We currently power over 100,000 rewards programs, reaching more than 500 million customers, and serving 1 million API requests per hour.   Smile is a remote-first company built on trust, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, challenged, and empowered to do their best work.    This is a full-time remote role working in Canada, Monday to Friday, with significant overlap with 9 AM - 3 PM EST.         🎯 About the Role   Some of the most ambitious loyalty brands on Shopify run their programs on Smile, and the relationships we build with them are one of the strongest growth levers we have. We’re hiring a Key Accounts Manager to own those relationships end to end.   You’ll be the accountable owner of net retention and top-account health across our key accounts book. You’ll carry the relationships personally, shape the motion behind them, and put a clear owner on every renewal, save, and expansion conversation.   This is a  player/builder/peer-coach  role:      Player.  You carry the relationships yourself: business reviews, renewal conversations, save calls, and expansion conversations with the merchants who matter most. You’re in the accounts weekly.    Builder.  The key-accounts motion is yours to shape: how we segment, when we engage, what a save play looks like, what triggers an expansion conversation, and how we spot risk early. You’ll help shape our 1-many success strategy too, so the whole base benefits.    Peer-coach.  You’ve levelled people up before, direct reports or peers, and you’ll do it here as a supportive peer-leader who brings commercial skills and perspective to a growing team.     You’ll work closely with our Sr Lead, Support, who runs the escalated-support front line for these same merchants. They support the number from the technical side. You own it.      📈 The Bar   We evaluate every candidate for this role against three things. If reading them makes you lean in rather than back, keep going.   1 · Autonomy: Owns the Ambiguity   This role comes with real ownership of the key accounts.     You own  retention outcomes and account health  for our top merchants, including saves and expansion, along with the decisions that come with them: which accounts get your time, which plays get run, and when to escalate versus hold.   You build your own operating system: account plans, risk signals, engagement cadences, and save plays. You’ll have the room to design it the way you think it should work.   When a top merchant is at risk, you get on the call and run the save, then tell us what you did.     2 · Craft: Elite at the Execution step, with Taste   Renewed and expanded revenue matters more here

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, je communiceert direct, en je laat geen ballen vallen.  Wat we bieden  Salaris: €5.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van wat je meeneemt.  Bonus per onboarding.  Aandelen: je wordt deels eigenaar van Aivory. We zoeken iemand die dit voor de lange termijn bouwt.  MacBook Pro.  Reiskostenvergoeding. In overleg een leaseauto.  Remote werken, met veel dagen op locatie bij praktijken.  Klein team, korte lijnen, directe impact. Geen lagen, geen theater.  Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk.  Solliciteren Stuur je CV en een korte motivatie naar  ties@aivory.nl  of stuur Ties Verberne een bericht via LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/tiesverberne.  Geen lange brief nodig. Vertel kort waarom jij dit wilt doen en waar je eerder klanten live hebt gezet.      Geen recruitmentbureaus, alstublieft.

title: Information Technology service delivery manager
description: Information Technology service delivery manager (level III) | 36 uur      Jij hebt de regie over onze IT-keten. Wij geven je de verantwoordelijkheid om continuïteit te garanderen.    Als  IT service delivery manager  bij Geldmaat ben jij de professional die zorgt dat onze IT-omgeving voorspelbaar, veilig en toekomstbestendig blijft. Je hebt een brede rol: je stuurt leveranciers aan, bewaakt de keten, pakt verstoringen op met inhoudelijk inzicht en zorgt dat wijzigingen, releases en integraties onder controle en volgens governance verlopen.  Je hebt het overzicht, begrijpt de samenhang tussen systemen én durft eigenaarschap te nemen. Je brengt rust in escalaties, duidelijkheid in keuzes en richting in verbeteringen.   Dit ga je doen   In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het draaiend houden én verbeteren van onze totale IT-operatie. Je werkt intensief samen met leveranciers, architectuur, security, operations en de business. Je stuurt op stabiliteit, stuurt op kwaliteit en stuurt op voorspelbaarheid.  In jouw rol:    Bewaak je de end-to-end continuïteit van onze IT-diensten en breng je structuur en prioriteit aan in een complexe ketenomgeving.  Coördineer je incident-, change- en releaseprocessen in ServiceNow op een manier die stabiliteit en kwaliteit borgt, inclusief CAB-voorbereiding en regressierisico’s.  Voer je inhoudelijke rootcause analyses uit, koppel je bevindingen terug naar leveranciers en stuur je op structurele oplossingen en blijvende verbeteringen.  Stuur je leveranciers dagelijks aan, challenge je performance en zorg je dat zij leveren wat is afgesproken, ook bij druk of escalaties.  Beheer je kritieke integraties en ketenkoppelingen en overleg je met architectuur en leveranciers over wijzigingen, afhankelijkheden en risico’s.  Voer je IAM-processen uit en borg je de juiste autorisaties, inclusief afwijkingssignalen richting security.  Pas je securitykaders, IT-controls en compliance-eisen toe en ben je gesprekspartner in audits en risico-reviews.  Signaleer je risico’s in keten, platform of processes en initieer je acties om continuïteit en beheersbaarheid te versterken.  Lever je inhoudelijke input bij ontwerpen, implementaties en acceptaties van nieuwe IT-oplossingen, waarbij je let op beheerbaarheid, stabiliteit en life cycle.  Professionaliseer je ITIL-processen, ServiceNow-flows en operationele werkwijzen door actief verbeteringen te ontwerpen en door te voeren.      Waarom Geldmaat?    Geldmaat heeft een cruciale maatschappelijke taak: wij zorgen dat contant geld voor iedereen bereikbaar en veilig blijft. Onze IT-keten is daarbij essentieel, 24/7, foutloos en veilig.  Dat betekent dat jouw rol direct impact heeft op:    Systeemstabiliteit en ketenbetrouwbaarheid.  Beschikbaarheid van onze dienstverlening.  Security en compliance.   Klanttevredenheid en operationele performance.  Je werkt in een professionele IT-omgeving met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid, betrokken collega’s en kritieke technologie.

title: Customer Engagement Manager, AI Adoption
description: Intric works with public sector organisations, including local governments, and public institutions, to help them get real value from AI, not just adopt it in name.  Most customers are at the beginning of that journey, and our work is hands-on: showing up, building alongside their teams, and staying involved until it's part of how they actually work. You'd own the customer engagement and platform usage across a portfolio of organisations, from the first workshop onwards.   What You'll Do     Own a set of existing accounts. You'd get up to speed quickly and take over each relationship fully: running the regular meetings, knowing who the right people are, and understanding what each customer needs to move forward.  Get new customers to their first real result. You run the opening sessions, help each organisation set up the right foundations, and get their first people actively building and using AI tools.  Own the numbers that show whether adoption is actually happening. You'd track how many licensed users have activated, how frequently they're coming back, how deeply they're using the platform day to day, and whether that picture is improving over time. When the trend shows an account is plateauing, you're the one who acts on it.  Build a network inside each account, at every level. The customers who grow are the ones where you know people across the organisation, not just the project lead. You'd cultivate contacts from operational staff up to senior stakeholders, and keep those relationships active.  Run hands-on sessions directly with teams. Some of this work is strategic. A lot of it is sitting with a social services team or a planning department and building something useful with them. That's where the real adoption happens, and it's a core part of how this role works.     Who you are     You've managed relationships with multiple stakeholders and know how to find the right people and dynamics in an unfamiliar organisation.  You're comfortable working directly with operational staff who are new to AI, and you can make the work feel relevant and useful to them.  You can tell when friendly check-ins are masking a lack of real progress, and you know how to have that conversation constructively.  You're patient and persistent in complex environments, and you find ways to move things forward without pushing people away.  You use data to manage your own work, not just to report upward.  You are fluent in Swedish and English; that is a hard requirement for this role since you'll need to communicate with customers in Swedish, and our internal company language is in English.     Why join   Most public sector organisations buy AI and hope for the best. Helping them actually get there is where the real work is. Intric has been doing this with 70+ customers across Europe and has developed a methodology that works.  You'd be joining at the point where the model is credible enough to scale but early enough that how it gets delivered is still bei

title: Account Manager
description: Job Description    Who we are and what we do   Biology is the most powerful technology on the planet. It cures disease, feeds civilizations, and decarbonizes entire industries. And yet the scientists and labs producing the breakthroughs that will define the next century still run on pen and paper, pipettes, and spreadsheets.  We're fixing that. Reshape is building the operating system for biological research – robotics and AI that automate data capture and turn raw experiments into decisions. Our customers are the largest R&D and FMCG organizations on Earth. The work they do with us shows up as faster cures, better food, and cleaner industry.  We're hiring a Strategic Account Manager in Copenhagen to own our most important customer relationships and turn them into our biggest ones.   The role   Landing a global biotech or FMCG giant is hard. Turning one lab into forty, and into an enterprise wide implementation is harder, and that's where the real revenue is for us.  You'll own a portfolio of our largest accounts, and you'll be measured on what happens after the first contract is signed. Net revenue retention, expansion ARR, renewals, multi-year commitments. This is not a farming role where you check in once a quarter and hope. These accounts have hundreds of sites, competing budget holders, and internal politics you have to navigate before you can grow anything.  One day you're on site watching a lab actually use the system, spotting the workflow next door that nobody has automated yet. The next you're building the business case that takes a single-team pilot to a global rollout, then defending it against a procurement manager who's decided renewal season is a good moment to grind you down on terms. You're equally at home in all of it.  You run the expansion cycle end to end. Map the account, find the decision makers, build the case for the org, negotiate it, close it. You own the renewal too, so you're protecting the base while you grow it. There is no inherited corporate playbook. You build the account strategy and you own the number.   What We're Looking For   A track record of growing complex enterprise accounts in SaaS, biotech, deeptech, hardware, or life sciences. You've taken a beachhead deal and multiplied it, and you can explain exactly how you did it. A scientific background isn't a must, but you need to soak up knowledge like a sponge and carry yourself with confidence. You can hold your own with a Principal Scientist, then translate operational value into strategic value a CFO will sign.  You generate expansion pipeline rather than wait for it. New sites, new teams, new use cases, exec relationships built. Whatever it takes. You spot churn risk a quarter before it shows up in a dashboard, and you deal with it then. You move fast, decide with incomplete information, and don't need a manager to tell you what matters this week.  What you getThe chance to put real points on the board at a company building something genuinely hard

title: Enhetschef Användarstöd till avdelning Nätteknologi
description: Vill du kombinera ett nära ledarskap med att driva hur användarstödet arbetar, prioriterar och levererar? Då kan det vara dig vi söker i rollen som Enhetschef Användarstöd till Teracom.    Teracom bidrar till demokrati och ett tryggare samhälle genom att säkerställa att information och kommunikation fungerar för de mest samhällskritiska funktionerna, även i kris och krig. Kort sagt – vi hjälper dem som hjälper andra.    Om tjänsten   Som Enhetschef är ditt huvudsakliga uppdrag att leda och inspirera medarbetarna inom enheten, där du arbetar verksamhetsnära och operativt. I ansvaret ingår att säkerställa en god arbetsmiljö som främjar öppenhet och ger medarbetare förutsättningar att prestera och utvecklas, där tydliga mål och arbetsglädje går hand i hand. Enheten består av flera olika roller, från servicedesk och kundstöd till tekniska specialister.  Rollen innebär att leda, styra och utveckla användarstödets samlade leverans inom Teracom och säkerställa att den är behovsanpassad, effektiv och tydligt prioriterad. Du driver förbättrings- och förändringsarbete i nära samverkan med IT, verksamhet och uppdragsorganisation, och har arbetsmiljö-, budget- och personalansvar för ca 15 tillsvidareanställda medarbetare samt några visstidsanställda.  Som Enhetschef rapporterar du till Avdelningschef för Nätteknologi och sitter på huvudkontoret på Lindhagen i Stockholm.   Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med     Etablera, förtydliga och vidareutveckla roller, ansvar och arbetssätt inom enheten.  Säkerställa effektiv samverkan mellan servicedesk, kundstöd, IT och uppdragsstöd.  Leda utvecklingen och implementeringen av systemlösningar som stöttar verksamhetens mål.  Leda och facilitera möten, workshoppar och avstämningar inom enheten och med angränsande funktioner.  Ansvara för resursplanering, prioritering och uppföljning av kapacitet och leveransförmåga.  Leda och motivera enligt Teracoms värderingar: Ansvar, Innovation och Mod.  Ingå i avdelningens ledningsgrupp och bidra till avdelningens övergripande utveckling.     Mer om dig   För att trivas i rollen är du en närvarande ledare som skapar struktur och riktning utan att tappa det operativa greppet. Mod att utmana, komma med nya idéer och driva dem även när du möter motstånd är något vi värdesätter högt.  Kommunikationen är tydlig, du skapar samsyn och trivs i en roll där du rör dig mellan helhetsperspektiv och vardagliga prioriteringar. Du samarbetar naturligt med många olika funktioner och intressenter, och har ett resultatorienterad fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet och långsiktig hållbarhet.   Vi tror att du har:     Flera års erfarenhet av chefs- eller ledaruppdrag inom IT-nära eller verksamhetskritisk verksamhet.  God förståelse för IT-stöd, servicedesk, kundstöd och användarnära tjänster.  Erfarenhet av att driva operativ verksamhet med fokus på prioritering, uppföljning och resursstyrning.  Erfarenhet av förändringsledning och utveckling av arbetssätt och organisation.  Mycket goda kunskaper i sv

title: Key Account Manager
description: Vi søger en Key Account Manager   Har du erfaring med teknisk salg af støbte emner i plast, letmetal og EPS/EPP – og en naturlig drivkraft for at skabe vækst og god service hos danske kunder?     Vi søger en erfaren sælger til at styrke vores tilstedeværelse på det danske marked. Du kommer til at stå i spidsen for dine egne kunderelationer, øge servicen over for eksisterende kunder, rådgive teknisk på konkrete emner og aktivt åbne døre til nye danske kunder.     Som Key Account Manager hos Idé-Pro bliver du en del af vores danske salgsteam på 3 sælgere med base på hovedkontoret i Skive. Dit fokus bliver det danske marked, hvor du får ansvaret for at øge service og salg hos både eksisterende og nye kunder.      Primære arbejdsopgaver:          Opdyrke nye kunder med behov for tekniske emner  Vedligeholde og pleje tætte relationer med eksisterende kunder  Behandle forespørgsler, tilbudsgivning og få opgave løst for kunden  Teknisk feedback til kunder på konkrete produkter  Kundebesøg på det danske marked  Deltage i messer og styrke relationer til både nuværende og nye potentielle kunder  Sikre et godt samarbejde på tværs i virksomheden       Hvem er du?          Du har erfaring med støbte emner i plast, letmetal og EPS/EPP og forstår kundens behov  Du befinder dig godt i en virksomhed, hvor tingene ofte går stærkt  Du er en dygtig sælger, der trives med at opsøge nye kunder og udvikle eksisterende relationer  Du behersker engelsk i både skrift og tale  Du har et højt drive, er nysgerrig og har en proaktiv tilgang til udvikling og forbedring       Vi tilbyder:          Et spændende job med reel indflydelse på udviklingen af det danske marked  Udfordringer i samarbejde med kompetente kollegaer  Gode arbejds- og ansættelsesforhold inkl. sundhedssikring  En lækker frokost- og morgenmadsordning  Rabatordning hos optiker og lokalt fitnesscenter og badeland       Arbejdssted:  Skyttevej 15, 7800 Skive      Sådan søger du   Send venligst din ansøgning, mrk. “Key Account Manager” til ansoegning@ide-pro.dk.     For flere oplysninger angående stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Salgsdirektør Morten Frandsen på         +45 96 15 32 16. Vi vurderer løbende de indkomne ansøgninger og opfordrer derfor interesserede til at sende en ansøgning hurtigst muligt.      Idé-Pro er en af Europas førende producenter af prototyper og serier i plast, letmetal og EPS/EPP og har 300 medarbejdere fordelt i Skive, Glyngøre, Sverige og Bangalore, Indien, herunder et internationalt salgsteam på 13 medarbejdere i Sverige, Tyskland, Østrig og Holland.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Growth
description: TL;DR -  Lovable's product-led growth motion has been core to its success, and messaging is one of the biggest levers we have to move users from signup to activation to expansion. This role owns that lever: the messaging and positioning strategy for the self serve journey.  You'll own how we talk to self serve users at every stage, from the words in an onboarding email to the framing of an upgrade prompt. You'll partner closely with the Growth PM, who owns the growth roadmap and the product/experimentation strategy behind it, and with our Lifecycle team, who execute lifecycle campaigns day to day. Your job is to bring the messaging point of view: what story we should be telling at each stage, which positioning will land best with which segment, and what new content or messaging should be created to support the roadmap the Growth PM has set.   Why Lovable?   Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.  We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.  Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.   Who You Are     A clear, sharp writer, able to explain a complex feature in an email subject line or an in app tooltip.   Strong at positioning: you can look at a user segment and a product moment and know what story will resonate.   Comfortable partnering closely with a Growth PM and a Lifecycle team without needing to own their roadmap or tooling.   Able to build cross functional trust and alignment without formal authority.   Curious about data and results, even if you're not the one running the experiments; you want to know what messaging is working and why.   Biased toward shipping and iterating on messaging quickly over lengthy planning cycles.      What We’re Looking For     6+ years of experience in product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or content/messaging roles.   Experience at a high tech company.   Direct experience writing messaging and positioning for a PLG or self serve product, ideally across the signup to pa

title: Technical Success Manager- Nordics
description: Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.  Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.  At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.  We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.  Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast   Job Description:   The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.  In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes.  You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals, bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness.  This is remote position from Copenhagen or Stockholm.   What will I be doing:     Build trusted relationships with customer security and IT teams, understanding their priorities, workflows, and success outcomes.   Create practical technical success plans that help customers adopt the platform, reduce risk, and realise measurable value.   Identify high-value use cases that make the platform part of everyday security operations.   Use product usage, engagement, and health indicators to spot adoption gaps, underutilisation, and retention risks early.   Guide customers through the transition from deployment to active use, accelerating Time-to-Value and reducing handover friction.   Lead mitigation planning for technical blockers, integration challenges, operational gaps, and customer health risks.   Bring clear technical health insights into renewal readiness, QBRs, growth discussions, and account strategy.   Surface technical opportunities that support expansion, upsell, and cross-sell activity in partnership with the Account Executive.   Champion the voice of technical users by ensuring product feedback, risks, and success requirements are visible internally.     What Success Looks Like    Customers are healthier, mor

DEFA  on norjalainen teknologiayritys, joka on perustettu vuonna 1946. Meillä on yli 400 työntekijää kolmella mantereella, ja tuotteitamme ja palveluitamme on saatavilla yli 30 maassa. About the role

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

  • Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

  • Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

  • Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys

The ERP System Administrator is an individual contributor role within Alimentiv’s Corporate Digital Enablement function, serving as the primary functional and technical owner of the Acumatica ERP platform that powers our Finance, Procurement, Logistics and Project accounting operations. This is a hands-on administration role — the successful candidate will configure, operate, and continuously improve Acumatica.

Another significant focus of the role is supporting the buildout of Acumatica’s procurement functionality — supporting Corporate and Clinical operations as Alimentiv’s procurement function matures. The role also owns the operational health of the SAP Concur–Acumatica integration via Celigo middleware and will play a central operational role in the planned annual Acumatica upgrades.

Positions available: 1, cross-posted in multiple countries. Please only apply to one posting.

About the Role

Acumatica Administration & Finance Operations (~40%)

• Serve as the primary Acumatica administrator across the Alimentiv instance: configuration, user access, security, workflows, and module settings.

• Design and implement Finance solutions using native Acumatica functionality — Generic Inquiries, Business Events, push notifications, custom reports, and approval workflows.

• Support and optimize core Finance workflows: accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, project accounting, billing, financial reporting, and month-end close.

• Partner with Finance to define requirements, document processes, and deliver Acumatica enhancements that improve data quality and operational efficiency.

• Troubleshoot and resolve Acumatica issues; coordinate with the Acumatica implementation partner while building internal capability over time and reducing vendor dependency.

• Maintain rigorous test environment discipline — validate all configurations in test before promoting to Production; ensure changes touching shared multi-tenant surfaces receive appropriate cross-domain approval.

Procurement & Projects Enablement (~25%)

• Partner with the Procurement function to continuously improve Acumatica’s procurement functionality— vendor management, requisitions, purchase orders, Concur-Acumatica integrations.

• Configure and test procurement workflows aligned with Alimentiv’s project-governed, goods & services-based procurement model.

• Maximize native Acumatica capabilities over customizations or third-party procurement platforms

• Support Procurement through discovery, requirements, configuration, testing, training, and operational rollout.

• Coordinate cross-domain approval and impact assessment for procurement-related changes given the shared instance and the downstream impact on Finance, Projects, and FP&A.

Integration Operational Ownership (~20%)
