title: Freelance Clinicians
description:
About League

League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

Position Summary:

We're building a network of experienced clinicians and experts to support a range of digital health projects. The through-line is clinical and expert judgment: the situational, real-world reasoning that shapes the reasoning of League’s products being safe and trustworthy. We are building a pipeline of clinicians to be pulled from our roster into project-centric engagements.

This is a great fit for clinicians who are looking for flexible, remote work — and who want their expertise to shape health-centric products that are built.

The kind of work that you might do:

Engagements vary, but could include:

  • AI agent evaluation — supporting the development and validation of rubrics, reviewing AI-generated health responses against structured rubrics, flagging where guidance. oversteps scope or crosses into unsafe territory, providing written feedback on how agent responses can be improved for safety and utility.
  • Subject-matter input — providing an expert perspective to the design of care pathways and other clinically-focused solutions that League is building.
  • Clinical review — validating that League’s capabilities, programs, and content reflect current evidence and standards of care.
  • Other projects as needed — from time to time, additional projects may come up that require subject-matter input and/or clinical review such as patient guides and other related medical information.

Who we're looking for:

Required

  • Active clinical license in good standing (e.g., RN, NP, MD, PharmD, or other licensed health professional)
  • Based in and licensed to practice in Canada or the United States
  • Meaningful hands-on patient care or applied clinical experience
  • Strong command of scope-of-practice boundaries
  • Reliable, detail-oriented, and dependable on deadline-driven async work
  • Ability to access and operate within

We're building a small, focused execution pod inside Growth Marketing to ship visibility experiments across AI answer engines, community platforms, and third-party listicles. This role is one of three on the pod. You'll work directly with our growth director and our GEO/AEO lead, alongside an ABM/Paid specialist and an SEO specialist.

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the work of getting a brand surfaced in AI-generated answers — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and others — and in the community conversations and listicles those engines pull from. It's a new, fast-moving discipline that combines SEO instincts, content creation, and community work.

Build presence in AI answer engines

Track and report what's working

  • Log every experiment in the team tracker.

  • Monitor AI visibility weekly across the tools we use to measure it.

title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

  • Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

  • You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. title: Engineering Manager - UK
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

  • Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-dat

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

The Role

This is not your typical Customer Success role.

RevenueCat prices based on how much money a customer makes. That creates an unusually clear alignment of incentives: when our customers grow, we grow.

That means Customer Success at RevenueCat should be more than relationship management, implementation check-ins, and polite QBRs.

Our best CSMs understand a customer’s app, audience, business model, growth goals, internal constraints, RevenueCat usage, and decision-making dynamics well enough to help that customer make better decisions.

Sometimes that means helping them adopt the right RevenueCat feature.

Sometimes it means spotting that their paywall, pricing, lifecycle, onboarding, or retention motion deserves a closer look.

Sometimes it means bringing in a technical partner to make sure an implementation question gets answered correctly.

Sometimes it means bringing in one of our growth specialists — people with deep expertise in areas like paywall conversion, lifecycle messaging, paid user acquisition, pricing, or gaming monetization — when a customer has a specific high-impact growth problem worth digging into.

And often, it means doing the unglamorous but critical work of keeping everyone aligned on context, priorities, next steps, owners, and follow-through.

That’s this role.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you’ll own a portfolio of managed RevenueCat customers and help them get more value from RevenueCat. You’ll become the person who understands where each customer is trying to go, what is getting in their way, how RevenueCat can plausibly help, and what needs to happen next.

You are not expected to be the best technical expert, paywall expert, lifecycle expert, paid acquisition expert, or pricing expert in the company.

You are expected to be a strong growth generalist: curious, commercially aware, product-fluent, organized, and credible enough to diagnose the right problem, bring in the right person, and own the follow-through.

Why we’re hiring for this role now

RevenueCat has grown quickly, and our customer base now spans everything from tiny indie apps to some of the largest mobile businesses in the world.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

title: Data Analyst - Routing & Sortation
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

title: Senior Go Developer (f/m/d) – Focus on gRPC & Enterprise Applications
description:
You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

title: Store Lead - Copenhagen (m/f/d)

At Arc’teryx we believe there’s always a better way and that guides how we develop our teams, and our “Leave It Better” spirit shapes the way we work.   Our Leads grow through hands-on learning, steady coaching and opportunities across stores, regions and teams.  As a key member of the store leadership team, you will be working alongside the Assistant and Store Manager, leading a talented group of Product Guides. You bring energy and purpose to every part of the store - guest experience, product, people, and operations. Passionate about the outdoors, you live the lifestyle and share it authentically. Leadership Experience : You bring 1+ years of leadership and retail experience, with a natural ability to coach, motivate, and unlock potential in others. title: Front office Manager
description: Er du klar for å skape uforglemmelig gjesteopplevelser?  På Quality Hotel™ Entry er ingen dag lik - takk og lov! I det ene øyeblikket sjekker du inn stamgjesten på forretningsreise, mens du i neste sier farvel til hockeylaget med gullmedaljen i kofferten. Eller kanskje du har fikset en overraskelse til barna som bor på hotellet for aller første gang?  Vi søker en Front Office Manager som kan spre glede og sørge for at våre gjester føler seg velkommen! Som en del av vårt Service Crew kommer du til å møte våre gjester med et varmt smil og håndtere oppgaver fortløpende i resepsjonen. Det er en jobb som krever en sterk sans for service og effektivitet, men det er også en jobb som gir deg mulighet til å utgjøre forskjellen for våre gjester. Som “Front Office Manager” sørger du for at du og teamet får våre gjester til å forlate hotellet med et stort smil! Stillingen innebærer varierende arbeidstider, inkludert kvelder og helger.      Nysgjerrig på hva stillingen innebærer?    Daglige Front Office-oppgaver fra innsjekk til utsjekk.  Du håndterer alt fra bookinger, betalinger og forespørsler - alt som sikrer en smidig gjesteopplevelse.  Ivareta vårt gjesteløfte ved å levere en imøtekommende atmosfære og pålitelig service.  Du jobber med mål om å nå gjeste- og merarbeidertilfredsheten på din avdeling.  Du har ansvar for timeforbruk, planlegging og optimalisering på din avdeling.  Du streber etter å nå oppsatte mål og ser på mersalg som en service til gjesten.        Høres dette ut som deg?    Du elsker virkelig å møte nye mennesker og skape positive opplevelser for gjestene.  Du trives i et travelt og dynamisk miljø og kan håndtere nesten alt som dagen byr på.  Du har et spesielt talent når det gjelder å finne riktig vei fremover.  Du er en lagspiller og dine kollegaer ser på deg som tilgjengelig og støttende.  Erfaring innen hotellbransjen, kundeservice eller resepsjon er et pluss   Du liker å se at dine medarbeidere utvikles.   Du behersker et skandinavisk språk

title: Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö Gigantti Tammistoon
description: Gigantti syntyi halusta tarjota asiakkaille huippuluokan teknologiaa järkevään hintaan. Menestyksemme salaisuus on aina ollut osaava asiakaspalvelu, laadukkaat tuotteet ja kunnianhimo. Meillä on aidosti hauskaa töissä, ja se näkyy! Olemme uteliaita ja kiinnostuneita sekä tuotteistamme että asiakkaidemme tarpeista. Arvomme ohjaavat kaikkea mitä teemme: voitamme yhdessä, pelaamme yhdessä, kasvamme yhdessä ja olemme erilaisia yhdessä. Tervetuloa hakemaan Giganttiin! Haluatko johtaa asiakaskokemusta Suomen suurimmassa Gigantissa? Etsimme nyt kehityshaluista asiakaskokemuspäällikköä (Customer Experience Manager) Vantaan Tammiston myymälään johtamaan asiakaskokemusta, kehittämään palvelukulttuuria ja valmentamaan tiimiä kohti yhteistä tavoitetta: tarjota asiakkaillemme alan paras asiakaskokemus joka päivä. 💙💚   Tässä roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä asiakkaan matka Gigantissa tuntuu aina ensimmäisestä kohtaamisesta viimeiseen palvelutilanteeseen. Johdat laajaa ja monipuolista tiimiä ja työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tavaratalopäällikön ja muiden osastopäälliköiden kanssa. Johdat toimintaa tavoitteellisesti, kehität tiimisi osaamista ja viet käytäntöön Gigantin asiakas ensin -strategiaa. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen johtoryhmän sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kehittää uraasi Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti osana Elkjøp-konsernia.    Mitä Asiakaskokemuspäällikkö tekee?    Vastaat myymälän asiakaskokemuksen kannalta keskeisten toimintojen johtamisesta ja vastuualueesi tuloksesta sekä henkilöstöstä. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat muun muassa asiakaspalvelu, kassatoiminnot, maksuliikenne, palvelupisteen toiminta, tekninen tuki sekä asiakkaan sujuvan asioinnin varmistaminen kaikissa kohtaamispisteissä.   Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:    Asiakaskokemuksen johtaminen      Johdat ja kehität asiakaskokemusta Gigantin strategian mukaan.   Kehität palvelua ja toimintatapoja yhdessä tiimisi kanssa.   Varmistat, että asiakkaamme saavat sujuvaa, asiantuntevaa ja ystävällistä palvelua.      Liiketoiminnan johtaminen      Vastaat oman vastuualueesi tuloksista ja tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta.   Huolehdit myymälän sujuvasta arjesta ja toimivista prosesseista.   Kehität toimintaa aktiivisesti osana myymälän johtoryhmää.      Ihmisten johtaminen      Valmennat, koulutat ja kehität tiimiäsi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita.   Luot ympäristön, jossa ihmiset viihtyvät, kehittyvät ja uskaltavat onnistua.   Johdat esimerkilläsi, olet aktiivisesti läsnä arjessa ja saat ympärilläsi olevat loistamaan.      Odotamme sinulta      Vähintään kolmen vuoden kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä ja soveltuvaa koulutusta.   Näyttöjä tavoitteellisesta ihmisten johtamisesta, luottamuksen luomisesta ja vastuun jakamisesta.   Kokemusta vähittäiskaupasta, palveluliiketoiminnasta tai muusta asiakaslähtöisestä ympäristöstä.   Sujuvia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja suomeksi ja käytännön englannin kielen taitoa.   Sosiaalista tilannetajua sekä kykyä keskittyä ja kuunnella myös kiireisissä

title: Customer service manager
description: Chez Nexans Suisse, nous ne faisons pas que produire des câbles. Nous contribuons chaque jour à accélérer la transition énergétique.  En rejoignant notre site de Cortaillod, vous intégrez une entreprise solide, avec une vision long terme, où l’humain et l’innovation sont au coeur de chaque projet.  Vous évoluerez dans :    Un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où la modernisation et la recherche de performance sont des défis quotidiens.  Un cadre unique entre lac et nature, avec plage privée, sentiers pour le sport à midi, fitness à proximité et transports publics accessibles.  Un site à taille humaine qui offre autonomie, responsabilités et esprit d’équipe.  La stabilité d’un grand groupe et de vraies perspectives d’évolution, soutenues par la formation continue.     Pour notre département "Ventes", nous recherchons un/une :   Customer Service Manager    Contexte :   Le Customer Service est une équipe complémentaire au service de la clientèle afin de notamment répondre aux appels d'offres, aux commandes ainsi qu'aux autres besoins de ces derniers. Département central qui fait le lien entre la Production et le marché, l'amélioration continue des processus et de l'expérience client sont au centre des priorités.   Missions :     Participation active aux activités quotidiennes du service (contacts avec la clientèle, création d'offres et de commandes, etc) en collaboration étroite avec les Market Managers ;  Coordination du département afin d'assurer un service optimal pour la clientèle ;  Monitoring d'indicateurs de performance ;  Gestion et point d'entrée du Quality management lié aux potentielles réclamations de la clientèle ;  Amélioration continue du service et de ses processus, avec les formations nécessaires internes et externes pour le développement du personnel ;      Profil recherché :     Expérience confirmée dans un poste similaire (idéalement dans un domaine industriel)  Formation commerciale  Bonnes connaissances du logiciel SAP et la suite Office  Aisance relationnelle et bonne faculté d'intégration dans l'équipe  Capacité à encadrer une équipe d'environ 10 personnes  Excellente maîtrise du français, de l'anglais et de l'allemand (oral/écrit), suisse-allemand (un plus)      Ce que nous offrons :     Un poste dynamique et varié au sein d'un grand groupe  Projets concrets dans la transition énergétique  Environnement stimulant et bienveillant  Rémunération et prestations sociales attractives      Date d’entrée :  à convenir   Taux d’activité :  80-100%

title: Teamleitung Customer Service B2B (m/w/d)
description: Unsere Mission lautet protecting people. Mit innovativen Produkten schützt die uvex group seit 100 Jahren Menschen in Beruf, Sport und Freizeit. Weltweit. Bei uns in der  uvex   safety group  dreht sich alles um den Arbeitsschutz: Wir produzieren persönliche Schutzausrüstung von Kopf bis Fuß – vom Schutzhelm bis zum Sicherheitsschuh. Dabei hat sich uvex safety als Markensystemanbieter mit internationaler Herstellerkompetenz in zahlreichen Branchen einen Namen gemacht.  Um zu den Besten zu gehören, gibt unser Team alles! Wir entwickeln brandneue Technologien rund um Persönliche Schutzausrüstung. Wir vermarkten unsere preisgekrönten Produkte mit Kreativität und Begeisterung. Wir setzen auf die Fertigung unserer Innovationen in eigenen Produktionsstätten. Wir versehen unsere Produkte mit digitalen Features – für noch mehr Sicherheit im Alltag. Und in Zukunft wollen wir sie auch ein bisschen „grüner“ machen.  Für unsere Gesellschaft  UVEX SAFETY AUSTRIA GMBH  suchen wir genau SIE!    Die operative Betreuung definierter Kunden und Kundengruppen gehört zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich. Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team sorgen Sie für eine verlässliche Betreuung rund um unser Arbeitsschutzportfolio und tragen dazu bei, Menschen von Kopf bis Fuß bestmöglich zu schützen.   Mit Ihrem hohen Anspruch an Kundenorientierung gewährleisten Sie eine erstklassige Servicequalität über alle Kommunikationskanäle hinweg und schaffen langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen.   Sie steuern das Kundenservice-Team unter Einhaltung der definierten Prozesse und Regelwerke und stellen eine effiziente Bearbeitung aller kundenrelevanten Themen sicher.   Sie übernehmen die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Kundenservice-Teams der uvex Safety Austria und arbeiten eng mit dem Außendienst sowie weiteren internen Schnittstellen zusammen, um pragmatische und kundenorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.  Sie verfügen über mindestens vier Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb und in der Kundenbetreuung und haben dabei ein gutes Verständnis für Kundenbedürfnisse und serviceorientierte Lösungen entwickelt.   Darüber hinaus bringen Sie mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung mit und verstehen es, Ihr Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft erfolgreich zu begleiten.   Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Kenntnisse in SAP und CRM auf Key User-Niveau sind wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung.   Eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität, eine professionelle und pragmatische Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an operativen Themen zeichnen Sie aus. Kundenorientierung ist für Sie gelebter Bestandteil Ihres Arbeitsalltags.

title: Technical Customer Support Manager L1
description: Role purpose  The Support Center Manager is responsible for the day-to-day performance and management of a team of support agents, ensuring high-quality, timely and efficient handling of customer requests. The role combines people leadership, operational control & metrics continuous monitoring, and continuous improvement to deliver excellent customer experience while meeting SLOs, SLAs and productivity targets.  Key responsibilities     Team leadership & people management-Lead, motivate and organize a team of support agents, Support recruitment & onboarding  Coach & develop team members (objective definitions, feedback, development, training needs & plans   Operational supervision  Monitor real-time activity across all channels (phone, email, chat, portal) and adjust resources accordingly.   Ensure cases/tickets are properly triaged, routed, and prioritized according to defined rules.   Act as the first point of operational escalation for complex or sensitive customer issues.   Coordinate with Level 2 and Level 3 support and other internal teams to resolve escalated cases.   Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures, scripts, and knowledge base.    Customer experience & quality  Supervise the quality of customer interactions through regular call and ticket monitoring. Implement corrective actions when quality or customer satisfaction targets are not met. Propose and help implement improvements to workflows, scripts, and knowledge base content.   Participate in projects related to new tools, processes, or organizational changes affecting the support center.   Contribute to UAT and pilots for new features and support tools.    Compliance & governance  Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations (e.g. data protection, quality, regulations).   Guarantee accurate documentation of cases and proper use of CRM/ticketing systems.   Represent the support center in cross-functional meetings when required. description: Company Description   Ibis Wellington is one of Wellington's largest economy hotels, conveniently located within walking distance of the city's major venues, including Tākina, Te Papa, TSB Arena and Sky Stadium.  Our hotel offers consistency and efficiency for business and leisure travellers, as well as large groups and events, with our vibrant Vivant! Restaurant & Bar offering a generous buffet breakfast, lunch, dinner and a selection of beverages.  We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Team Leader for our Front Office/Food & Beverage Department, to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity for a hospitality professional who enjoys working across multiple departments, leading by example and creating memorable guest experiences. Alongside supporting our Front Office and Food & Beverage teams, you'll help maintain a safe and welcoming environment for guests and team members throughout your shift.  This is a full-time position (40 hours per week) operating on a rotating 7-day roster, including mornings, evenings, weekends and occasional overnight shifts. Ensure hotel standards and procedures are consistently followed.     Food & Beverage    Support the smooth operation of Vivant! Restaurant & Bar. Assist team members with product knowledge and service delivery.   Support training and onboarding of new team members.   Promote food and beverage offerings through confident upselling. description: Job Description   We are currently seeking for passionate and dynamic guest focused Front Office professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.  As a Front Desk Manager you are responsible for the operations of Front Office with a primary focus on overall operation at Reception, ensuring end of the day procedures and subsequent reports are completed in an accurate and efficient manner whereby your role will include key responsibilities such as-     Actively elicit guest feedback and preferences, regarding hotel services and ensure action is initiated on the same to maximize guest satisfaction   Ensure maximum room revenue through up-selling within stipulated guidelines, therefore optimizing the sale of room inventory, while controlling room availability in high occupancy periods   Actively involve in promoting and selling companies loyalty program, Food & Beverage events / in house facilities and hotel / company partners   Ensure that all accounting and auditing practices are in line with company policies, governmental requirements and check audits and registration cards before sending them to accounts   Lead and coach the team towards achieving highest level of exceptional guest service and colleague satisfaction results through the application of all corporate and property standards and policies     Skills    Education, Qualifications & Experiences   You must ideally have a degree in the hospitality field with previous experiences in the Front Office Department within a hotel. title: Customer Service Manager
description: Customer Services Manager    This position sits at the heart of our growing global organisation, you will be responsible for all aspects of your centre’s performance. We’ll give you the autonomy and resource to manage your centre as though it’s your own business. You will have a wide range of responsibilities including:    Being responsible for managing anything and everything on site.  Rising to every challenge and solving problems.  Giving tours to prospective customers.  Upselling to existing customers.  Above all, looking after our customers so well that each becomes a brand ambassador - for you, your team and IWG. description: Job ID: 5330   Vill du vara med och forma framtidens företagsbank? Som Relationship Manager på Business Banking Kalmar, Kronoberg och Blekinge län blir du en viktig affärspartner som hjälper företag att växa genom smarta finansiella lösningar. Vi söker dig som drivs av att göra affärer, träffa kunder i vårt marknadsområde, är målinriktad och gillar att jobba i team.   Tjänsten kan placeras i Växjö, Kalmar eller Karlshamn/Karlskrona beroende på var du bor. Rollen omfattar ansvar för både befintliga kunder och nykundsbearbetning inom hela marknadsområdet    Om vårt team   Välkommen till Business Banking Kalmar – Kronoberg och Blekinge län – ett erfaret team präglat av starkt engagemang och kundfokus. Som Relationship Manager blir du en central del i att ge våra företagskunder strategiska råd och skräddarsydda finansiella lösningar som driver deras affärer framåt.  Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. Detta är värderingar som vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar och hur vi fattar beslut – och som vi tror att du delar.   Vad du kommer att göra    Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:     Kundportföljsansvar – Hantera och utveckla relationer med befintliga företagskunder genom proaktivt arbetssätt.  Affärsutveckling – Identifiera och realisera affärsmöjligheter för att skapa värde för både kunder och bank.  Nykundsbearbetning – Aktivt arbeta med att attrahera nya kunder i ett tillväxtstarkt marknadsområde.  Branschexpertis – Använda din kunskap för att förstå kunders verksamhet och identifiera affärsmöjligheter.  Samarbete – Arbeta tvärfunktionellt med kollegor och specialister för att leverera helhetslösningar.  Kundnöjdhet – Säkerställa hög kundnöjdhet och lönsamhet genom att maximera värdet i varje kundmöte.      Vem du är    Du har:     Affärssinne – Genuint intresse för företagsaffärer och förmåga att analysera företags behov.  Relationskompetens – Naturlig fallenhet för att bygga starka relationer med kunder och kollegor.  Drivkraft – Motivation att ta stort ansvar, inklusive strukturerad nykundsbearbetning och kalla samtal.  Utvecklingsfokus – Ambition att kontinuerligt utveckla din kompetens som finansiell partner.  Självständighet – Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat i högt tempo inom ramen för våra riktlinjer och guidelines.  Teamanda – Vilja att dela kunskap, ge feedback och bidra till teamets utveckling.      Din bakgrund och kompetens innefattar:     Swedsec-licens.  Akademisk examen eller motsvarande erfarenhet.  Professionella kunskaper i svenska och engelska (i både tal och skrift).  Erfarenhet att jobba med företagskunder.      Vad vi erbjuder    Människor  kommer hit när de vill komma någonstans. För somliga är det att ta sin karriär till nästa nivå. För andra är det att bryta ny mark inom sitt kompetensområde – med andra ord, du kommer alltid framåt hos oss. title: Client Leader – Corporate Segment
description: At Aon, we help organisations make better decisions. As a Client Leader within our Corporate segment, you will play a central role in developing relationships with established corporate clients and creating new business opportunities across the Swedish market.  This is an opportunity for someone who combines commercial drive, curiosity and a genuine interest in building long-term client relationships. You enjoy taking initiative, bringing people together and turning an understanding of a client’s business into relevant advice and practical solutions.   The Role   As a Client Leader, you will own and develop a portfolio of corporate clients and prospects. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers, building a strong understanding of their business, priorities and risk landscape.  The role combines client leadership, business development and team coordination. You will drive client retention and growth, identify new business opportunities, and bring together the right expertise from across Aon to deliver value to clients.   Key Responsibilities   You will build and strengthen long-term relationships with clients and prospects while identifying opportunities for growth and value creation. You will be responsible for developing your portfolio through a combination of account development, prospecting and new business generation.  Working closely with colleagues across Aon, you will coordinate client teams, ensure effective execution of client plans and deliver a seamless client experience. You will also maintain an active pipeline, drive structured follow-up and contribute to the profitability and continued growth of the Corporate segment.   Who We Are Looking For   We are looking for someone who is commercially driven, relationship-oriented and comfortable taking responsibility. Your mindset, initiative and ability to create progress are as important as the number of years you have worked.   Experience     Proven experience, preferably from insurance and risk management, alternatively from consulting, sales, finance, or another client-facing corporate environment.  Experience of developing professional client relationships and driving initiatives forward.  An understanding of corporate clients and an interest in their business challenges, risks and opportunities.  Experience of coordinating stakeholders, projects or client teams is an advantage.  Experience of new business development, account development or complex B2B sales is beneficial.     Profile     Proactive and commercially minded, with a genuine interest in clients and business development.  Skilled at building trust and maintaining relationships over time.  Curious and quick to understand different businesses and industries.  Structured and comfortable managing several parallel priorities.  Able to take ownership, create momentum and follow activities through to completion.  Collaborative and confident in involving colleagues with different areas of expertise.

title: Lead Account Manager- Clinical Services
description: Work Schedule   Standard (Mon-Fri)   Environmental Conditions   Office  As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Masters Degree preferred plus sales experience in pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with demonstrated success in meeting/exceeding targets   Preferred Fields of Study: life sciences, business, or related field   Additional relevant certifications beneficial   Valid driver's license and ability to travel 50-75% of the time.   Strong scientific and technical knowledge of drug development, clinical trials, and laboratory services.   Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain executive-level relationships with key decision makers.   Excellence in consultative selling, proposal development, and contract negotiations.   Strong presentation and communication skills for engaging diverse stakeholders.   Fluent English required; additional language skills valuable     What's in it for you?     Excellent salary plus performance bonus.  Fully remote working opportunity.  Company car, laptop, mobile phone.  25 days holiday plus bank holidays.  Life assurance, employee assistance programme and many other benefits.  Progression and development opportunities with a market-leading, forward-thinking organisation.

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.  You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Good news, there is.   About First Focus   First Focus has spent the last  nine years  being recognised by Cloudtango as  Australia's #1 mid-market Managed Service Provider . If you've ever wanted to have a bigger impact, this is where you stop saying it and start doing it. We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.   Summary:   We are currently seeking a  Voice of Customer Manager  to join our  Customer Success  team in  Toronto ,  Vancouver , or  Calgary  on a 12-18 month fixed term contract.   What your team does:    As the Voice of Customer Manager, you’ll be a key partner in a team that values excellence and initiative, and is passionate about testing and improving the customer experience. Adapt suitable best practices to the government environment.  Provide recommendations for improving government innovation capabilities. Evaluate the effectiveness and impact of innovation initiatives.  Prepare updates and recommendations for stakeholders and management.

title: Sales Manager, talotekniikka ja LVI-ratkaisut
description: Haemme aktiivista ja yhteistyökykyistä myynnin ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisen ammattilaista taloteknisten ja LVI -ratkaisujen pariin!    Mitä toimenkuvaasi kuuluu?    Vastuullasi on rakennushankkeiden toimijoiden – erityisesti rakennusliikkeiden sekä muiden sidosryhmien – laaja-alainen kontaktointi ja yhteistyön kehittäminen. Johdat asiakkuuksiin liittyviä toimenpiteitä liiketoimintayksikkötasolla ja edistät ratkaisujemme tunnettuutta markkinoilla.  Työhösi kuuluu myös tarjottavien palveluiden ja asiakasratkaisujen jatkuva kehittäminen sekä aktiivinen yhteistyö myynnin, markkinoinnin, suunnittelun ja tuotehallinnan kanssa. Roolissasi pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten asiakkaamme näkevät ja kokevat tarjoamamme ratkaisut – olet siis keskeinen linkki asiakkaiden tarpeiden ja yrityksemme tarjonnan välillä.      Mitä odotamme sinulta?      Ymmärrät LVI-järjestelmien toimintaperiaatteita sekä osaat huomioida rakentamisen vaatimukset – esimerkiksi energiatehokkuuden, hiilijalanjäljen ja älykkäät talotekniset ratkaisut – ja reagoida niihin asiakastyössä.  Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva insinöörikoulutus ja näyttöä myynnin, liiketoiminnan kehittämisen tai asiakkuuksien hallinnan parista – erityisesti B2B-ympäristössä.  Ymmärrät rakennusalan toimintaympäristöä ja liiketoimintaprosessien eri vaiheita.  Hallitset nykyaikaiset myynnin ja asiakkuudenhallinnan järjestelmät ja näet digitalisaation mahdollisuutena työn tehostamisessa.     Lisäksi     Olet oma-aloitteinen ja pitkäjänteinen tekijä, joka viihtyy asiakkaiden parissa ja osaa edistää yhteistyötä tavoitteellisesti.  Olet tulostavoitteellinen, tartut rohkeasti toimeen ja viet asiat käytännössä maaliin.  Kykenet itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, mutta arvostat myös tiimityötä ja yhteisiä tavoitteita.  Sinulla on matkustusvalmiutta ja hyvä suomen sekä englannin kielen taito.    Eduksi katsotaan kokemus rakennuttaja- ja LVI-suunnittelijayhteistyöstä sekä kyky esiintyä vakuuttavasti erilaisissa asiakastilanteissa.   Mitä tarjoamme sinulle   Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän osana asiantuntevaa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä. Pääset työskentelemään markkinoiden johtavien ratkaisujen parissa ja vaikuttamaan aidosti siihen, miten rakennusalan tulevaisuutta kehitetään. Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työvälineet, hyvät kehittymismahdollisuudet ja organisaation tuen tehtävässäsi menestymiseen.   Tehtävän toimipaikka on Helsingissä.   Lisätietoja  tehtävästä antaa myyntijohtaja Mika Tarvainen p. 050 540 9841 tai mika.tarvainen@georgfischer.com.   Hakuaika on 30.09.2026 asti, mutta paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.  Huomioithan että käsittelemme vain järjestelmäämme tulleet hakemukset.   Contact Person   Enna Cano Bernal Senior Specialist, HR enna.canobernal@georgfischer.com  Please submit your application via the ‘Apply’ button. The recruiter’s email is for enquiries only.

title: High End VIP Manager
description: MAIN OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE   （ジョブサマリー）   ハイエンドビジネスチームの一員としてVIP顧客との関係性強化、ブランドロイヤリティ向上によりハイエンドビジネスの持続的成長に貢献する。チーム戦略に連動したVIPリレーション施策の実行、ハイエンドビジネスを担っていく人材育成・開発を推進する。またカルティエアンバサダーとしてビジネスパートナー、各界著名人とCartierを繋ぎ、Cartier Japanのネットワーク拡大に寄与する。   Scope Of Responsibilities （役割責務）   ビジネスへの貢献範囲    VIPリレーションズシニアマネージャーと連携し、日本のVIP顧客戦略の立案・実行に貢献する。  海外VIPツアーまたは国内開催ディナーはリーダーとしてEvent Sales Promotionチーム(略称ESP)と連携し、ブランドの世界観、高品質で特別な体験の継続的な提供によりエンゲージメントを深める。  ハイエンドビジネスディベロップメントシニアマネージャーと連携をし、チーム管轄のVIP顧客向けA&Pの最大化を図る。    売上・組織規模    ハイエンドセールス, ハイエンド/VIP顧客基盤強化, ハイエンドコミュニティーを中心にコーチングにより人材育成に貢献する。    その他期待される成果    ブティックマネジメント、L&Dチームなどとも連携しコーチングによりハイエンドビジネスにとって重要となるブティックメンバーの顧客関係構築スキルの向上を図る。ビジネスパートナー・各界著名人とのネットワーク強化拡大。      KEY RESPOINSIBILITIES   （職務内容）   BUSINESS PERFORMANCES  【戦略的影響範囲】 Arbeta aktivt för att främja kundrelationer, identifiera möjligheter till merförsäljning och affärsutveckling.  Ta fram prognoser för avtalsförnyelser och ekonomiska rapporter.  Samarbeta i kundteam med order, sälj och service delivery managers  Etablera och upprätthålla en nära relation till våra leverantörer (främst Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Rubrik och Everpure Storage) och deras specialister inom området.  Bidra till utveckling och effektivisering av processer, arbetsflöden och initiativ inom olika kundprojekt  Säkerställa hög datakvalitet och korrekt hantering av kund- och avtalsinformation i våra interna system.  Flera års erfarenhet inom Renewals Management, främst med fokus på Cisco, men även Palo Alto, Rubrik och Everpure Storage är meriterande.  God förståelse för återkommande intäktsmodeller (Recurring Revenue), ARR och avtalsförnyelser.  Erfarenhet av kundförhandlingar, avtalsdialoger och kommersiella dialoger.  God analytisk förmåga och god numerisk kompetens.  Goda kunskaper i Excel och andra affärssystem.  Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska, både i tal och skrift.      Kvalifikationer  Vi tror att du är en proaktiv, strukturerad och affärsdriven person som uppskattar kombinationen av att arbeta i team med kundkontakt och operativt arbete.  Du trivs i en dynamisk miljö där prioriteringar snabbt kan förändras och känner dig bekväm med att ta ett självständigt ansvar för ditt arbete.     Du arbetar noggrant, kommunicerar tydligt och har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med både kunder och kollegor. Samtidigt är du nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att utveckla processer, lära dig nya arbetssätt och bidra till en positiv och samarbetsinriktad företagskultur.

title: Junior Player Support Representative
description: Job Description   We're looking for a player-first, analytically curious  Junior Support Representative  who sees customer interactions as signals to understand, not just tickets to close. You'll be the internal voice of our players by spotting trends, anticipating issues early, and helping build a more empathetic, scalable support experience through automation, AI, and process optimisation.   What will you be doing at Miniclip?    Player Support & Communication     Handle player inquiries across accounts, purchases, gameplay, and technical issues with empathy, clarity, and efficiency  Adapt your communication style to players from diverse cultural backgrounds  Share information that's accurate, current, and genuinely useful - not just protocol-compliant     Trend Analysis & Critical Thinking     Go beyond resolution - spot recurring patterns, surface root causes, and turn player feedback into actionable insights for Product, QA, and Marketing  Anticipate emerging issues and trends from early signals (release notes, sentiment shifts, ticket spikes) and raise them proactively  Challenge response templates and protocols that no longer serve players, using data and feedback to propose better alternatives  Own a feedback loop between frontline support and internal teams, narrowing the gap between player reality and product decisions     AI & Process Experimentation     Use and evaluate AI-assisted tools (response suggestions, auto-tagging, sentiment analysis) to improve your workflow and player outcomes  Identify, prototype, and pitch automation or AI opportunities that reduce friction for players and agents alike  Run pilots for new support tools, giving structured feedback on what works and what doesn't     Agile Collaboration     Contribute to team retrospectives with player-facing observations and improvement suggestions  Work in an iterative, self-directed loop — test, measure, adjust, and share what you learn  Work with Support Operations to turn frontline observations into practical tooling and workflow improvements     What are we looking for?    Essential     1+ years of customer-facing experience, ideally in a tech or digital environment  Hands-on experience with automations, triggers, macros, or workflow rules in a support, CRM, or no-code tool.  Practical experience using AI-assisted tools in your work.  Analytical curiosity — you ask why players are contacting us, not just how to close the ticket  Comfort using data and observation to back up suggestions and ideas  Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and critical judgment, and the confidence to challenge a process or a team when the evidence calls for it  Strong written and spoken English, with excellent communication across cultures  Familiarity with ticketing systems     Desirable     Experience in the gaming industry or passion for mobile games  Experience prompting, fine-tuning workflows around, or self-hosting AI customer-service tool

title: Customer Success Specialist – FreightOpt Oy
description: Customer Success Specialist – FreightOpt Oy     Haluatko työskennellä asiakkaiden kanssa ja olla mukana rakentamassa nopeasti kasvavaa suomalaista teknologiayritystä?      FreightOpt on B2B-yrityksille suunnattu digitaalinen kuljetuspalvelu, jonka avulla yritykset voivat vertailla, tilata ja seurata kuljetuksia helposti yhdestä paikasta. Kasvumme jatkuessa etsimme nyt tiimiimme  Customer Success Specialistia , joka auttaa uusia ja nykyisiä asiakkaitamme saamaan FreightOptista mahdollisimman paljon hyötyä.    Mitä työ pitää sisällään?    Customer Success Specialistina vastaat erityisesti uusien asiakkaiden onnistuneesta käyttöönotosta sekä nykyisten asiakkaiden aktivoinnista ja käytön kehittämisestä.     Työskentelet asiakkaidemme kanssa aktiivisesti  puhelimitse, etätapaamisissa ja sähköpostitse . Tavoitteesi on varmistaa, että asiakkaat pääsevät nopeasti alkuun, löytävät FreightOptista heille sopivat palvelut ja ottavat palvelun osaksi päivittäistä toimintaansa.     Tyypillisiä tehtäviäsi ovat esimerkiksi:      uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja käyttöönoton tukeminen  FreightOptin esittely ja asiakkaiden opastaminen etätapaamisissa  nykyisten asiakkaiden aktiivinen yhteydenpito ja käytön kasvattaminen  asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen ja ratkaisujen löytäminen yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa  tiivis yhteistyö myynnin, asiakaspalvelun ja muun FreightOpt-tiimin kanssa  asiakaspalautteen välittäminen eteenpäin palvelumme kehittämiseksi     Mitä odotamme sinulta?    Etsimme ennen kaikkea aktiivista, oma-aloitteista ja asiakaslähtöistä henkilöä, joka viihtyy ihmisten kanssa ja uskaltaa tarttua puhelimeen.     Aikaisempi kokemus  asiakastyöstä, Customer Success -tehtävistä tai myynnistä  on eduksi, mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Arvostamme erityisesti hyvää asennetta, kommunikointitaitoja ja halua oppia.     Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Ruotsin, englannin ja viron kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.    Mitä tarjoamme?    Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin vahvasti kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi ja toimintatapojemme kehittämiseen.  Meillä saat:      mukavan ja rennon työilmapiirin  pienen ja ketterän tiimin ilman turhaa byrokratiaa  mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä yrityksen mukana  vastuuta ja vapautta oman työn tekemiseen  modernit työvälineet ja viihtyisän toimiston Espoossa  mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöskentelyyn      Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla, mutta toivomme sinun olevan myös  viikoittain mukana Espoon toimistollamme , sillä tiivis yhteistyö muun tiimin kanssa on meille tärkeää.    Kiinnostuitko?    Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus ja CV sekä kerro, miksi juuri tämä tehtävä voisi sopia sinulle.   Tule mukaan rakentamaan FreightOptin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta!

title: Customer Service & Product Specialist (m/w/d) 60-80%
description: Jobbeschreibung  Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.   Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. Mit dieser Mission sind wir heute die führende Anbieterin für webbasierte Business-Software in der Schweiz.   Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Um diese Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel!  Stellenanforderungen Was du bei uns bewegst    Du führst täglich Service-Gespräche sowie Produkt-Coachings durch und überzeugst unsere KMU-Kunden und Treuhänder mit deiner Fachkompetenz.   In regelmässigen Webinaren und im direkten Online-Austausch vermittelst du dein Wissen und kommunizierst stets adressatengerecht und stilsicher.   Du unterstützt Projekte auf fachlicher Ebene und bringst Input zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Services ein.   Du planst und organisierst deinen Arbeitsalltag selbstständig, erledigst administrative Aufgaben und bearbeitest Kundenreklamationen.   Du begleitest die Treuhand-Partner aktiv im täglichen Austausch, die deine Expertise im Arbeitsalltag schätzen.   Du übernimmst das Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender und gibst dein methodisches Know-how strukturiert weiter.   Du konsolidierst Kunden- und Markterkenntnisse und lieferst dem Produktmanagement strukturiertes Feedback zur gezielten Software-Optimierung.    Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle    Du bringst eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Grundausbildung sowie eine relevante Fachweiterbildung mit.   Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Rollen mit intensivem Kundenkontakt (z. B. Customer Training, Consulting oder Success) – idealerweise im Schweizer SaaS- oder Treuhand-Umfeld.   Du besitzt eine hohe Affinität für Softwareprodukte (von Vorteil bereits bexio-Kenntnisse) sowie fundierte Buchhaltungskenntnisse.   Du verfügst über starke Methodenkompetenz für die strukturierte Wissensvermittlung im direkten Online-Austausch.   Ein ganzheitliches Verständnis für komplexe KMU- und Treuhand-Prozesse hilft dir, diese technologisch optimal abzubilden.   Du denkst lösungsorientiert, packst Aufgaben mit einer Can-Do-Mentalität eigeninitiativ an und bringst die Motivation für eine regelmässige Präsenz vor Ort im Office mit.   Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (Muttersprache) und besitzt gute Englischkenntnisse; Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.    Darauf kannst du dich freuen    Hybrid-Modell und Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen.   5 Wochen Ferien plus Option auf unbezahlten Urlaub.   Yoga, Bootcamps, Massagen und legendäre Grill-Sessions.   16 Wochen Mutterschafts- und 3 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub.

title: Host Manager
description: Drifter is built for curious travellers, free spirits, and people who care about great spaces and great experiences. We run hostels and hybrid stays across Australia and New Zealand, alongside food and beverage venues that bring people together and give our properties their edge. The kind of places people remember, not just pass through.      We're opening our newest property in Wellington in December 2026, and we're building the entire leadership team from the ground up.      We're looking for a Host Manager to join that team and help bring the property to life. This is a rare chance to join before opening, help bring a new property to life, build your own team, and help create the culture, standards and ways of working from day one.          The opportunity         The Host team is often the first and last interaction guests have with Drifter, so this role matters. A lot.     As our Host Manager, you'll lead a team that sets the tone for the entire guest experience. From seamless arrivals and departures to solving problems, building connections and creating a welcoming atmosphere, you'll make sure every guest feels looked after from the moment they walk through the door.     You'll also be a key member of the leadership team, working closely with the General Manager and other Heads of Department to make sure the whole operation runs smoothly.     Starting in early November 2026, you'll have the opportunity to come in before opening, recruit and develop your team, and help set the standards for the guest experience from day one.      What it looks like day to day:      Leading, coaching and supporting the Host team   Creating a welcoming, high-energy environment for guests and team members   Managing front office and night operations   Handling escalated guest issues and finding practical solutions   Recruiting, onboarding and training new team members   Building rosters that work for both the business and the team   Monitoring labour costs, revenue opportunities and departmental performance   Looking for ways to improve the guest experience and operational efficiency   Working closely with Housekeeping, F&B and Maintenance to keep the property running seamlessly   Helping establish processes, standards and ways of working as part of the pre-opening journey          You’ll be a good fit if…      You're a hospitality leader who loves being part of the action. You know how to lead a team without standing on the sidelines, and you're just as comfortable jumping on reception during a busy check-in as you are coaching performance or reviewing labour costs.     You build strong teams, create great guest experiences, and know how to keep things running smoothly when the pace picks up.      You’ll likely bring:      Experience leading a guest services, reception or host team within a hostel, lifestyle accommodation, tourism or experience-led hospitality environment  Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, recruitment and performance

title: Client Services Manager
description: Introduction   At Gallagher Bassett, we're there when it matters most because helping people through challenging moments is more than just our job, it’s our purpose. Every day, we help clients navigate complexity, support recovery, and deliver outcomes that make a real difference in people’s lives. It takes empathy, precision, and a strong sense of partnership—and that’s exactly what you’ll find here. We’re a team of fast-paced fixers, empathetic experts, and outcomes drivers — people who care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it well. Whether you're managing claims, supporting clients, or improving processes, you’ll play a vital role in helping businesses and individuals move forward with confidence. Here, you’ll be supported by a culture that values teamwork, encourages curiosity, and celebrates the impact of your work. Because when you’re here, you’re part of something bigger. You’re part of a team that shows up, stands together, and leads with purpose.   Overview    Drive Client Success and Strategic Growth   Gallagher Bassett is Australia's leading claims management provider and part of the global Arthur J. Gallagher group. We're seeking a Client Services Manager to join our growing General Insurance business in a newly created role. Reporting to the Client Services Director, you'll be responsible for managing key client relationships, driving service excellence, enhancing reporting and insights, and supporting client retention and growth.  As the strategic relationship lead for a portfolio of General Insurance clients, you'll partner closely with operational leaders and stakeholders to deliver exceptional outcomes, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure our clients receive maximum value from their partnership with Gallagher Bassett. This role combines client relationship management, performance reporting, business improvement, and commercial account management in a highly visible and impactful position.   How You'll Make An Impact     Develop and maintain strong relationships with key General Insurance clients  Act as a trusted advisor, understanding client strategies, objectives, and evolving business needs  Lead client service reviews, governance meetings, and performance discussions  Monitor and report on service delivery, claims performance, SLA outcomes, and operational trends  Partner with internal claims and operational teams to identify and implement service improvements  Advocate for client reporting requirements and support reporting enhancements through Power BI and other business intelligence tools  Respond to client enquiries, issues, and escalations with professionalism and urgency  Support revenue retention and identify opportunities to expand Gallagher Bassett's service offering  Collaborate with sales, marketing, operational and executive stakeholders to deliver exceptional customer outcomes  Contribute to strategic projects and initiatives that enhance the client experience and drive business grow

title: Senior Product Manager
Talent Acquisition Manager - German&English speaker (w/m/d)
Product Manager, Search
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.

The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.

What you'll work on

  • Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain 
  • Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
  • Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.

description:
Your Role

We’re looking for a Lead Revenue Operations (f/m/d) to take ownership of our commercial operations and help drive our revenue engine. You’ll work at the intersection of Sales, Relationship Management, Marketing, Finance, Tech and Product with a clear mission: to build a scalable, data-driven commercial infrastructure that fuels growth and efficiency at LIQID.

What Will Keep You Challenged?

  • Design, implement and continuously improve sales & relationship management processes, funnels, KPIs and reports and own data governance for the revenue organization: a single authoritative definition for every commercial KPI, data quality standards and their enforcement.

  • Act as functional owner of the commercial toolkit incl. CRM (data model, object structure, field logic, workflows, permissions and AI-integration)

  • Drive operational excellence and change through automation and system optimization (CRM, automation, VOIP, BI etc.).

  • Assess funnel performance and attribution jointly with Marketing, including each channel's contribution to closed business, and enable growth initiatives with the data and infrastructure they require.

title: Media Buyer / Meta Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Wer sind wir?

Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.

Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.

Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Media Buyer entscheidest du mit darüber, ob Menschen Finanzklar überhaupt kennenlernen. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Anzeigen schaltet, sondern versteht warum manche Kampagnen Menschen bewegen und andere nicht.

Aufgaben

Du planst, schaltest und optimierst unsere Meta-Ads-Kampagnen – von der Zielgruppe über das Budget bis zur täglichen Auswertung der Zahlen. Parallel entwickelst du die Creatives dazu: Anzeigenbilder, Videos und Texte, die unsere Botschaft transportieren. At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. description: BAZZAAL 소개  BAZZAAL은 브랜드의 미국 시장 진입과 성장을 돕는 🇰🇷 최고의 인플루언서 마케팅 전문 에이전시입니다.  서울 성수와 Los Angeles 오피스를 기반으로 K-beauty 브랜드의 크리에이터 시딩, Paid Influencer Campaign, TikTok Shop 등을 운영하고 있으며, 앞으로는 Beauty를 넘어 Lifestyle, Wellness 등 다양한 소비재 카테고리로 사업 영역을 확장하고 있습니다. 미국 현지 실행력과 한국 브랜드에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 캠페인 실행뿐 아니라 브랜드의 미국 시장 성장을 함께 고민합니다.     포지션 소개  Client Growth Manager는 담당 클라이언트의 첫 문의부터 제안, 계약, 캠페인 실행, 재계약 및 추가 성장까지 전 과정을 책임지는 역할입니다. CBO에게 직접 리포트하며, 단순히 클라이언트 요청을 전달하고 프로젝트를 관리하는 일반적인 Account Manager 역할과는 다릅니다.     클라이언트의 비즈니스를 이해하고 성장 기회를 찾으며, 시장과 데이터를 기반으로 필요한 전략을 먼저 제안할 수 있어야 합니다. 필요하다면 클라이언트의 기존 가정에도 다른 관점을 제시할 수 있는 분을 찾습니다. 전략과 디테일을 동시에 볼 수 있는 사람을 중요하게 생각합니다.     큰 방향을 설계하면서도 견적, 계약 조건, 일정, 클라이언트 요청사항, 캠페인 진행 상황과 후속 액션까지 놓치지 않아야 합니다. 여러 프로젝트가 동시에 진행되더라도 작은 오류가 쌓이지 않도록 끝까지 확인하고 결과에 책임지는 분을 선호합니다.     주요 업무  Account Growth  담당 클라이언트의 유지, 재계약 및 추가 매출을 책임집니다. 기존 Account 안에서 새로운 협업 기회를 발굴하고 매출 Pipeline과 Forecast를 관리합니다.     Client Strategy  브랜드의 비즈니스, 카테고리와 미국 시장 진출 단계를 이해하고 목적에 맞는 Influencer Marketing 및 Social Commerce 전략을 설계합니다. 시장, Creator, 경쟁사에 대한 인사이트를 실제 실행 가능한 제안으로 연결합니다. A cela s’ajoute un manque structurel de médecins sur tout le territoire, nécessitant la montée en compétence de chaque strate des métiers de la santé : le médecin généraliste doit mener des consultations de pédiatrie ou de gynéco pour combler le manque de spécialistes, l’infirmier.ère suit des patients diabétiques pour désengorger le cabinet du médecin, etc.  Alors comment former en continu 2 millions de soignant.e.s pour répondre à ces défis, en tenant compte de leurs contraintes ? Comment favoriser le transfert de compétences à grande échelle : de l’hôpital vers la ville, du spécialiste vers le généraliste, du médecin vers d’autres professionnels de santé (infirmier.ère, pharmacien.ne, sage-femme…) ?  Santé Académie a imaginé la solution d’apprentissage de demain, en digital learning : des formations vidéo de qualité cinématographique – avec une équipe de prod’ directement intégrée en interne - accessible via web ou application mobile. Chacune des formations est réalisée avec les meilleurs expert.e.s de la thématique, venant d’institutions de référence en recherche clinique.  La mission de Santé Académie ? Offrir aux soignant.e.s une formation continue à la hauteur de leur engagement, à la pointe de la connaissance et directement accessible via leur smartphone ! Pour améliorer la prévention, le diagnostic, la prise en charge et l’orientation des patients et ainsi construire la santé de demain !  Santé Académie a déjà formé plus de 20 000 professionnels de santé et noué des partenariats avec des établissements de santé de renom tels que le GHU Paris ou l'Hôpital des Armées. title: Palvelupäällikkö yrityssiivoukseen
description: Tule rakentamaan kanssamme kasvavaa, laadukasta yrityssiivousliiketoimintaa!       Kotimainen Onni siivouspalvelut  kasvaa vahvasti, ja vahvistamme yrityssiivouksen johtamisrakennetta uudella palvelupäällikön roolilla. Tehtävässä vastaat nimetyn aluekokonaisuuden toiminnasta ja olet samalla  kuluttaja- ja yrityspalveluiden ohjausryhmän jäsen.       Pääset vaikuttamaan oman alueesi lisäksi siihen, miten rakennamme asiakaslähtöistä, kannattavaa ja vastuullista kasvua valtakunnallisesti. Työskentelypaikkasi voi sijaita Helsingissä, Tampereella, Turussa tai Lahdessa. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen.      Voit olla jo kokenut palvelupäällikkö tai vahva siivousalan esihenkilö, joka on valmis ottamaan seuraavan askeleen . Tärkeintä on vahva siivousalan ammattiosaaminen, kyky johtaa ihmisiä, laatua ja kannattavuutta sekä taito suunnitella toimivia palveluratkaisuja suuriinkin asiakaskohteisiin.      Palvelupäällikkönä  vastaat oman alueesi yrityssiivouspalveluiden sujuvasta arjesta, laadusta, asiakaskokemuksesta, henkilöstöstä ja kannattavuudesta. Johdat alueen esihenkilöitä, varmistat palvelutuotannon onnistumisen ja viet sovitut tavoitteet käytäntöön.     Olet yrityssiivouksen vahva substanssiosaaja. Osaat kartoittaa asiakkaan tarpeet, mitoittaa suuriakin siivouskohteita ja rakentaa toimivan, laadukkaan ja kannattavan palvelukokonaisuuden. Tuet myyntitiimiämme kohdekartoituksissa, työmäärämitoituksissa, menetelmävalinnoissa ja tarjouslaskennassa.      💼 Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:    alueen yrityssiivouspalveluiden operatiivinen ja taloudellinen johtaminen  esihenkilöiden, henkilöstöresurssien, työkyvyn ja työturvallisuuden johtaminen  laadun, asiakaskokemuksen ja asiakaspysyvyyden suunnitelmallinen kehittäminen  asiakas- ja henkilöstöpalautteen sekä tunnuslukujen hyödyntäminen toiminnan parantamisessa  kohteiden kartoittaminen ja mitoittaminen sekä myynnin tukeminen tarjouslaskennassa ja palveluiden käynnistämisessä  laadukkaiden, vastuullisten ja skaalautuvien toimintatapojen ja palveluratkaisujen kehittäminen.       ✔️ Mitä odotamme sinulta?    soveltuvaa siivousalan koulutusta, kuten puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan perus-, ammatti- tai erikoisammattitutkintoa  kokemusta yritys-, toimitila-, rappu- tai rakennussiivouksesta  kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä, työnjohdosta ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta  käytännön osaamista siivouskohteiden kartoittamisesta ja mitoittamisesta  ymmärrystä siivousmenetelmistä, kustannusrakenteesta ja kannattavasta hinnoittelusta ja valmiutta osallistua tarjouslaskentaan yhdessä myyntitiimin kanssa  kykyä johtaa henkilöstöä, laatua ja kannattavuutta tiedon avulla  tavoitteellista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja toimeen tarttuvaa työotetta  kykyä yhdistää asiakasymmärrys, henkilöstön onnistuminen, laatu ja taloudellinen tulos kestäväksi kasvuksi  kokemusta muutosten ja uusien toimintatapojen käytäntöön viemisestä  sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa  suostumus asiakaskohteen vaatimusten mukaisen ja turvallisuusselvityslain perus

description: 회사 소개   쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.  쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.  분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.      팀/직무 소개   AM(Account Management)팀은 Coupang Eats내 파트너사의 GMV 스케일업을 최우선으로 이끄는 성장 전담 조직입니다.  상품 라인업 확장과 스토어 활성화, 우수 스토어 획득(Store Tiering), Order 수량 증대, CX (고객 경험) 품질 개선에 이르기까지 종합적인 비즈니스 컨설팅을 제공하여 파트너사의 쿠팡 내 성공을 가속화합니다.      업무 내용    파트너사 세그먼트별 차등화된 액션 플랜 실행을 통한 Account GMV 성장 및 이탈 방지  입점 후 온보딩, 운영, 해지에 이르는 셀러 라이프사이클 전반의 포트폴리오 관리  출고 및 CS 지표 개선을 통한 스토어 CX(고객 경험) 품질 및 거래 건전성 제고  GMV 가속화를 위한 프로젝트성 이니셔티브 기획 및 밀도 높은 커뮤니케이션 실행       자격   요건    5년 이상 이커머스 또는 리테일 환경에서 Account Management 및 매출(GMV) 성장을 주도한 분  전화 및 비대면 채널을 활용한 밀도 높은 커뮤니케이션으로 상대방 (대표, 고객 등)의 실질적인 실행을 이끌어낼 수 있는 분  고객 경험 (CX), 출고/CS 등 스토어 운영 품질 지표를 진단하고 개선해 본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반으로 파트너사 세그먼트를 분류하고 우선순위에 따른 비즈니스 리텐션 전략을 실행해 본 분  입점부터 운영, 해지 방지까지 셀러 라이프사이클 전반에 대한 이해도를 갖춘 분       우대   사항    쿠팡 셀러 생태계, 주요 스토어 운영 지표 및 CX 관리 프로세스에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유한 분  대면 미팅 및 Call 기반의 세일즈 및 포트폴리오 케어 경험이 있는 분  세그먼트별 차등화된 프로모션, Pricing, 마케팅 연계 프로젝트를 주도해 본 경험이 있는 분  Excel, SQL, Tableau 등 데이터 분석 도구를 활용해 성장 기회를 도출할 수 있는 분  주요 파트너사/C-Level 대상의 비즈니스 서밋, 프랜차이즈 얼라이언스 행사 등 파트너십 강화를 위한 얼라이언스 이벤트 기획 및 호스팅 경험이 있는 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차    서류전형(리크루터 사전 인터뷰) - 1차면접 - 2차면접 - 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.     참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.       개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/       서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.  단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Leder PMCW (Ports, Marine, Coastal & Waterways)
description: Jobbeskrivelse   Vil du være med å forme fremtidens havner og kystinfrastruktur i Norge?  Ønsker du å lede prosjekter som gjør en reell forskjell for klima, miljø og samfunn?  Vil du bygge opp et ledende fagmiljø der dine ideer får direkte påvirkning på store og viktige prosjekter?   Bli drivkraften bak Rambølls satsing i Norge   Rambøll styrker nå satsingen innen Ports, Marine, Coastal & Waterways, og vi søker en avdelingsleder som vil utvikle markedet, drive faglig ledelse og forme fremtidens løsninger i skjæringspunktet mellom infrastruktur, klima og bærekraft. Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å kombinere faglig tyngde, strategisk innflytelse og reell samfunnseffekt.   Din nye rolle   Som leder får du et strategisk mandat: Du skal bygge Rambølls posisjon i et marked i vekst, identifisere nye muligheter og etablere sterke relasjoner til kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Samtidig vil du trekke på global kompetanse og internasjonale prosjekter for å løfte norske løsninger til neste nivå. Rollen har i første fase hovedfokus på faglig utvikling, markedsbygging og koordinering av teamet, og vil over tid kunne utvikles til en mer tradisjonell lederrolle dersom det er naturlig og ønskelig.  Du blir en sentral pådriver for et engasjert og tverrfaglig fagmiljø som jobber med alt fra havner og marine konstruksjoner til kystsoneløsninger og vannveier. Her vil du se resultatene av arbeidet ditt i prosjekter som påvirker byutvikling, transport og miljø.
