title: Implementation Lead
description: About Kernel   Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?     Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.     Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.     Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at  Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout  already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.     We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.      Your Role   As an  Implementation Lead , you're the bridge between customer needs and technical execution in enterprise deals. You translate complex requirements into practical, high-impact solutions, ensuring every proof of concept is accurate, scalable and positioned for success.     Working closely with Account Executives, Product and Engineering, you'll navigate technical questions, troubleshoot complex challenges and shape solutions that drive value for our clients. With new features shipping constantly at Kernel, you'll stay ahead of client requirements and the latest market innovation. description: Word het gezicht en de stem waar onze klanten op rekenen.     Jij wordt blij van mensen écht verder helpen. Niet met een standaardantwoord uit een script, maar met een oplossing waar de klant de volgende dag mee verder kan. Of nog liever over 10 minuten. In veel servicebanen ben je nummer zoveel aan de lijn en verdwijnt jouw werk in een ticketsysteem. Bij ons is het andersom: jij bent voor onze klanten dé persoon die ze bij naam kennen en bellen als het ertoe doet.     Onze klanten zijn bevrachtingskantoren in de binnenvaart. Ze gebruiken onze software elke dag om hun bedrijf te runnen — capaciteit plannen, ladingen koppelen, deals sluiten. Als er iets hapert, of als iemand niet weet hoe iets werkt, dan staat hun werkdag stil. Dan willen ze geen wachtrij en geen verwijzing naar een handleiding. Ze willen een mens die de sector snapt en het oplost.     Software wordt in een traditionele branche te vaak verkocht en daarna laat men de klant alleen. Wij geloven dat goede software pas waarde krijgt door uitstekende, menselijke service. Juist in een wereld die steeds digitaler wordt en waarin AI overal opduikt, is persoonlijk en menselijk contact belangrijker dan ooit. Daar zorg jij voor.     DIT GA JE DOEN     • Onboarding. Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten van de eerste login tot het moment dat ze zelfstandig en met plezier werken.  • Eerste aanspreekpunt. Vragen via telefoon, mail en app komen bij jou binnen. Je lost ze op, of je zet ze gericht door naar het team programmeurs.  • Inrichten en configureren. Je zet de software klaar zodat hij past bij hoe de klant werkt.  • Proactief contact. Je belt klanten uit jezelf: zo hou je feeling met hun situatie en hou je ze super tevreden.  • De brug naar het team. Je vertaalt wat je van klanten hoort naar concrete verbeteringen, zodat het product elke week beter wordt. En je test die verbeteringen voordat ze live gaan.     WAAROM 4SHIPPING     We weten dat service in veel bedrijven het ondergeschoven kindje is. Bij ons niet. Jij krijgt de ruimte én het mandaat om het goed te doen — en je bouwt de serviceaanpak mee op, want jij bent de eerste in deze rol. Je krijgt moderne tools tot je beschikking, waaronder onze eigen AI, om de wens van de klant goed te converteren naar tickets voor het team programmeurs, antwoorden te vinden, nieuwe omgevingen in te richten en om de klant nog beter en sneller te kunnen helpen — zodat jouw tijd naar de klant gaat en niet naar uitzoekwerk.     We zijn een scale-up die software bouwt voor de binnenvaart, met betalende klanten en een groeiend netwerk van bevrachters. Onze oprichter komt zelf uit de sector, dus de lijnen zijn kort en je weet altijd waaróm iets belangrijk is. Ons kantoor staat in Zwijndrecht, op loopafstand van het station.     En het werk dat je doet, telt: onze software en radarmodules zorgen er samen voor dat schepen efficiënter varen en dat onnodige leegvaart verdwijnt — minder brandstof, minder uitstoot, een duurzamere binnenvaart. title: Asiakaspäällikkö, Helsinki
description: Rakennamme yhdessä tulevaisuuden Fenniaa asiakasarvo edellä, jotta asiakkaamme, omistajamme, voivat yrittää ja elää. Visiomme on olla vetovoimaisin, vastuullinen toimija. Fenniassa työskentelee rohkeita edistäjiä eri aloilta, devaajista asiakaspalvelun rautaisiin ammattilaisiin. Tulet työskentelemään  Uudenmaan talousalueella . Työ edellyttää matkustamista ja auton käyttöä.   Sinulta odotamme   Olet tavoitteellinen, ahkera, kilpailuhenkinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen asiantuntijamyyjä. Omaat vahvat vuorovaikutustaidot ja kykenet keskustelemaan asiakkaiden kanssa luontevasti niin yrittäjyydestä kuin yrityksen liiketoiminnasta. Toimimme asiakkaidemme riskienhallinnan kumppanina, joten tehtävässä menestyminen vaatii vahvaa näkemystä yrittäjyyteen ja riskienhallintaan. Tiedät, että tarjoamalla asiakkaillemme alan parhaan asiakaskokemuksen edistät myös henkilökohtaisten, kunnianhimoisten myyntitavoitteidesi saavuttamista.  Tässä tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään jo aikaisemmin luomiasi verkostoja ja siksi tuntemus alueen yrittäjistä ja yrityksistä katsotaan eduksi. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus ja näyttöä menestyksellisestä myyntityöstä mielellään vakuutusalalta.   Miksi sinun kannattaa tarttua tilaisuuteen?   Fennia on vakavarainen ja vahvan perustan omaava vakuutusalan konserni, jossa vallitsee kehittämisen kulttuuri. Kattavan perehdytyksen lisäksi rohkaisemme työntekijöitämme jatkuvaan itsensä kehittämiseen ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia lisäkoulutukseen. Näin mahdollistamme sinulle kehittyvän tehtäväkentän, mielekkäät työtehtävät sekä onnistumisen työtehtävässäsi.  Koemme, että työhyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen on tärkeämpää kuin koskaan ennen, ja tuemme henkilöstömme hyvinvointia mm. liikunta- ja vakuutuseduin. Tavoitteenamme on, että jokainen fennialainen voi yhdistää työn ja vapaa-ajan iloa ja hyvinvointia maksimoivalla tavalla. Me uskomme, että osaavan, hyvinvoivan ja motivoituneen henkilöstön avulla varmistamme tulevaisuuden kilpailukykymme muuttuvassa maailmassa.   Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Hae nyt! Vi söker dig som:     Brinner för att skapa värde för kunder och alltid står på deras sida.   Har utmärkta kommunikativa och sociala färdigheter.   Är lyhörd, förstående och duktig på att identifiera lösningar.   Har kundfokus i ditt DNA.   Har förmåga att hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt.   Är proaktiv, samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att lösa problem.   Har intresse för IT och teknik samt vill använda din expertis för att förbättra kundens upplevelse.   Förstår våra produkter och hur de kan hjälpa olika kundsegment att lyckas online.      Mandat och befogenheter      Besvara kundfrågor och lösa ärenden inom givna riktlinjer.   Eskalera mer avancerade problem till relevanta team.   Bidra med feedback för att förbättra arbetssätt och processer.      Hur vi mäter framgång      Kvaliteten i rådgivning och support du ger.   Feedback från kunder och kollegor.   Resultat och prestation kopplat till din utveckling.   Tidsramar för svar och lösningar.   Engagemang i utbildning och onboarding.      Varför Loopia?   Vi fokuserar på resultat — men också på att hjälpa dig bli den bästa versionen av dig själv. title: Global Personnel Administration, HR Ops specialist
description: Hi, we’re Back Market.  We’re here to help  make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.  Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break.  Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.   Are you ready to join us?  Define, build and industrialise global personnel administration for Back Market — including the decision of what should be run in-house and what should not — while keeping the existing service running throughout the transformation.    BUILD     Diagnostic and upstream project work     Own the personnel administration workstream of the audit end-to-end: complete the diagnostic across all geographies and convert findings into a build roadmap.  Establish the baseline: as-is process map per country, volumes, cycle times, FTE load, cost, incidents. No sourcing decision and no automation case can be made without it.  Define the target perimeter and negotiate the handover of activities currently held by People Partners, HRIS, Finance, Legal and local contacts. Set the RACI.  Support the Phase 2 technical deep dive on the admin scope.     Sourcing strategy — in-house or not     Lead the make-or-buy analysis for personnel administration, activity by activity and country by country: global in-house, local in-house, outsourced, or EOR.  Build the decision framework: cost model, service model, risk and compliance criteria, scalability, dependency and reversibility.  Present the recommendation and business case to the HR Ops & HR Tech Director and the People Leadership Team; secure the arbitration. title: Business Solution Manager
description: BUSINESS SOLUTION MANAGER    Strategisk kundeansvar · SaaS · Forretningsudvikling · Aalborg - Onsite position       Er du stærk på kunder, forretning og relationer – og klar til at tage næste skridt fra klassisk SaaS-salg til strategisk forretningsudvikling?      Hos Homerunner søger vi en Business Solution Manager, der får en central rolle i udviklingen af vores største kunder.  Du skal kunne se længere end den eksisterende kundeaftale. Du skal forstå kundens forretning, være nysgerrig på deres udfordringer og kunne omsætte behov og muligheder til konkrete løsninger, der skaber værdi, både for kunden og for Homerunner. Det afgørende er ikke din titel.     Det afgørende er, at du har lyst til at tage det næste skridt ind i en moderne tænkende dynamisk virksomhed. Du arbejder grundigt og metodisk, er selvledende og har et naturligt drive. Du er god til mennesker, men samtidig skarp på forretning.  Og så er du nysgerrig på AI. description: Appierについて   Appier（エイピア）は、AIネイティブのAgentic AI as a Service（AaaS）企業です。  2012年に「AIの民主化」をビジョンに設立され、「Turn AI into ROI（AIをROIに変える）」をミッションとして掲げています。現在はアジア太平洋地域、ヨーロッパ、アメリカを含む17拠点を展開し、東京証券取引所（証券コード：4180）に上場しています。  Appierは、AI Agentを活用し、企業のマーケティングDX・データ活用・顧客体験（CX）の変革を支援する次世代AIプラットフォームを提供しています。   提供ソリューション    Appier AI Marketing Agent Platform   Appierは、AI Agentを中心としたオールインワンのマーケティングプラットフォームを提供しています。  企業が保有する顧客データをAIが理解・分析し、マーケティング施策の企画から実行、最適化までをAI Agentが支援します。  データ基盤、予測AI、マーケティングオートメーション、マルチチャネルコミュニケーション、生成AIによるクリエイティブ制作までを一つのプラットフォームで提供し、お客様のマーケティングROI最大化を実現します。   AIQUA（アイコア）   AI Agentを活用し、Web・アプリ・メール・LINE・Push通知など複数チャネルにおいて、一人ひとりに最適化された顧客体験を自動で実現するマーケティングオートメーションプラットフォームです。   BotBonnie（ボットボニー）   LINEをはじめとするSNSやWebチャットを活用し、AI Agentによる顧客コミュニケーションを実現するマルチチャネルマーケティングソリューションです。   AIRIS（アイリス）   AI Agentの意思決定を支えるPredictive Customer Data Platform（CDP）です。  顧客データを統合するだけでなく、AIによる予測分析を通じて顧客の将来行動やニーズを予測し、最適なマーケティング施策や顧客体験の実現を支援します。   AdCreative.ai（アドクリエイティブ・エーアイ）   生成AIを活用し、高品質な広告クリエイティブを自動生成・最適化するAIクリエイティブプラットフォームです。   ポジション概要   Customer Success Managerとして、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを導入いただいた日本国内の企業を担当し、お客様がプラットフォームから最大の成果を引き出せるよう、導入から定着、そして事業成果の創出までを伴走していただきます。  本ポジションは、問い合わせに対応するサポート業務ではありません。  お客様のマーケティング課題とKPIを深く理解した上で、AI Agentを活用した施策を「一緒に設計し、実行し、数字で振り返る」——お客様のマーケティングチームの一員として動く、実行力を伴うパートナーです。  担当アカウントの継続率とアカウント成長に責任を持ち、日々の施策運用からお客様とのQBR（四半期レビュー）までを一貫して担っていただきます。  また、プロダクト・エンジニアリングチームは台北を中心としたグローバル体制です。日本のお客様の声を製品開発に届け、機能改善の優先度を動かしていくことも、CSMの重要な役割です。   主な業務内容     担当アカウントのオンボーディングをリードし、初期の成果創出（Time to Value の最短化）を実現する  お客様のマーケティング課題・KPIを理解し、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを活用した施策を設計・実行・改善する  セグメント設計、シナリオ構築、配信設定、効果検証まで、プラットフォーム上で手を動かしながらお客様と伴走する  利用状況・成果データをモニタリングし、活用が進んでいない領域を能動的に特定して改善提案を行う  経営層・マーケティング部門・IT部門など多様なステークホルダーと信頼関係を構築し、QBRを主導する  担当アカウントの契約継続に責任を持ち、アップセル・クロスセルの機会を創出してアカウントを成長させる  タグ・SDK実装やデータ連携に関する技術的な論点を切り分け、お客様の技術担当者や社内テックチームと連携して解決に導く title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

What You'll Own

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

title: Operations Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Steuerberatung ist ein operatives Geschäft. Jede Buchung, jede Lohnabrechnung, jeder Abschluss folgt einem Ablauf – und die meisten dieser Abläufe wurden nie systematisch hinterfragt. Sie funktionieren, weil erfahrene Menschen ihre Workarounds kennen, nicht weil sie durchdacht sind. Genau das ist der Hebel, der in dieser Branche noch niemandem gehört.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und entwickelt sie weiter, statt sie einzuschmelzen. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Das funktioniert nur, wenn darunter etwas steht, das trägt: Prozesse, die an jedem Standort gleich laufen, Technologie, die im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt wird, und eine Integration, die bei der fünften Übernahme schneller geht als bei der ersten. Diese Schicht baust du. Sie existiert heute nicht.

Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem Aufbau operativer Systeme mit – aus einem B2B-Scaleup, einem Company Builder, einer Beratung mit eigener Umsetzungsverantwortung oder aus deiner eigenen Gründung. Du wechselst, weil dein Mandat kleiner geworden ist als deine Verarbeitungskraft: zu viel Abstimmung, zu wenig Hebel, zu viele Konzepte, die andere umsetzen. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil von beidem – Strukturen, die tragen, mit etablierten Mandanten und einer starken Wachstumsbasis, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest Operations bei Vogel in ganzer Breite: die Automatisierung der Abläufe im Kerngeschäft, die internen Werkzeuge und die Datenarchitektur, die IT- und Identitäts-Infrastruktur samt Endgeräten und Sicherheit, die technische Integration jeder übernommenen Einheit und die Abläufe rund um Eintritt, Vertrag, Systeme und Austritt unserer eigenen Leute. Du baust das Team, das diese Themen trägt, und verteilst die Schwerpunkte dari

title: Wirtschaftsprüfer / Accounting Lead Buy & Build (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Wer Beratungsunternehmen zukauft, kauft sich Konsolidierungskreise ein – und in den meisten mittelständischen Strukturen ist das Rechnungswesen dafür nie gebaut worden, sondern über Jahre gewachsen.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland – mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen organisch und durch Zukäufe und bauen daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand. Jeder Zukauf bringt eine neue Gesellschaft, eine Eröffnungsbilanz, eine Kaufpreisallokation und einen erweiterten Konsolidierungskreis mit. Damit das trägt, braucht es jemanden, bei dem niemand mehr nachrechnet, ob der Konzernabschluss steht.

Du bist bestellter Wirtschaftsprüfer oder stehst unmittelbar vor dem Examen, mit vier oder mehr Jahren Audit bei einer der großen oder der nächstgrößeren Prüfungsgesellschaften und echter Konzernabschluss-Tiefe. Du wechselst, weil die nächste Stufe in der Prüfungshierarchie mehr Review und weniger eigene Arbeit bedeutet – und weil du die Zahlen lieber verantwortest, als sie zu testieren. Bei Vogel findest du Strukturen, die tragen, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest das Rechnungswesen von Vogel – Konsolidierung und Konzernabschluss, das laufende Rechnungswesen über alle Gesellschaften, dessen Automatisierung und das externe Reporting an Banken und Stakeholder. Du berichtest direkt an Joachim und Moritz Vogel; am Standort München entsteht die Finance-Funktion gerade erst, und du bist ihr fachlicher Anker. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn – oder, wenn du das willst, in den Aufbau eines eigenen Teams.

title: Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development
description:
About the role

The Industrial Application team of Agile Robots is looking for a motivated Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development to support the development, testing, and commissioning of industrial vision systems for robotic and AGV applications. In this full-time internship, you will work hands-on across the entire lifecycle of our vision solutions — from software development and camera calibration at our Munich headquarters to on-site commissioning at customer production sites.


Your Responsibilities

  • Vision Software Development: Develop, test, and maintain software components for industrial 2D/3D vision systems, including API-based secondary development on top of vision vendor SDKs.
  • Camera Setup & Calibration: Configure and calibrate 2D area-scan/line-scan cameras and 3D sensors for robotic and AGV applications, performing nine-point, checkerboard, and 3D hand-eye calibrations.
  • Algorithm Debugging: Support the debugging and tuning of core vision algorithms, from QR-code and natural-contour (V-SLAM) AGV navigation to deep-learning-based detection models.
  • Testing & Automation: Write Python scripts for automated testing and data-log analysis, and validate vision system performance in the lab and in production-like environments.
  • System Integration: Configure and troubleshoot data exchange between vision industrial PCs (IPCs) and PLCs, supporting communication via TCP/IP sockets

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - AI Agents, Evals & Reliability

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

  • Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics,

description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 다른 플랫폼에서 비즈니스를 만들어온 고객사들이 아임웹을 사용하고 있습니다. Customer Onboarding Manager는 이전해오는 고객사의 오픈과 온보딩을 직접 책임지고, 고객사가 아임웹을 사업의 핵심 성장 도구로 사용하도록 돕는 역할입니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    신규 이전 고객사의 온보딩을 담당해, 오픈까지 걸리는 시간을 단축합니다.  킥오프에서 요구사항과 오픈 일정을 파악하고, 오픈까지 필요한 과제를 관리합니다.  데이터 이전, 도메인 연결, 결제 연동, 초기 세팅을 고객사와 함께 진행합니다.  도입 단계에서 반복되는 문의를 구조화해 유관 부서 및 AI 자동화를 통해 개선합니다.  도입 가이드와 온보딩 자료를 정비해 도입 방식을 표준화합니다.       [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 도입 지원, 온보딩, 영업 지원 등 2년 이상의 경력이 있으신 분  여러 고객사의 도입 건을 동시에 진행하며 일정과 과제를 관리해보신 분  제품의 기능을 고객의 업무 언어로 풀어 설명해보신 분  도메인, 결제, 데이터 이전 등 기술적인 설정을 고객과 함께 진행하는 데 거리감이 없으신 분  고객사 실무진, 사내 유관 부서와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  반복되는 문제를 가이드나 프로세스로 만들어 해결하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험  쇼핑몰 구축이나 플랫폼 이전을 직접 지원해본 경험  고객사 도입 프로젝트를 리딩해본 경험  도입 가이드나 교육 프로그램을 만들어 문의량이나 도입 속도를 개선해본 경험  반복되는 문제나 비효율을 AI 자동화를 통해 개선해본 경험       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: Private Bank Client Manager (Farming/ Service)
description: Job Description    As Private Bank Client Manager, you will take ownership of an established portfolio of private banking relationships, with a strong focus on client servicing, retention and organic growth.    You will act as a trusted point of contact for clients and intermediaries, ensuring a consistently high level of service across their day-to-day banking and investment needs. title: Customer Care Manager
description: About us:   The Bread Factory is the UK's leading artisan bakery. Founded by Gail Meija in 1993, The Bread Factory, originally known as Gail Force, began by supplying some of London's most prestigious restaurants, including many with Michelin stars. More than three decades later, we continue to work closely with the best chefs, alongside grocers, foodservice partners and our own neighbourhood bakery, GAIL's.  The Bread Factory is synonymous with quality. We have been awarded more than 100 Great Taste Awards and have held a Royal Warrant since 2016, when it was first granted by Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II. In 2024, the warrant was renewed by His Majesty The King.  We source our ingredients thoughtfully, partnering with farmers and millers who align with our values. The result: delicious, carefully made baked goods that support a more sustainable and nutritious food system; bringing great bread to more tables every day.  As Customer Care Manager, you’ll lead and develop a high-performing team that delivers a consistently brilliant service to our chefs, bakeries, grocers and buyers every day. You’ll be responsible for achieving service, quality and customer KPIs, while driving customer retention, reducing customer effort and building an empathetic but honest culture of continuous improvement. Using customer feedback, operational data and team insight, you’ll identify opportunities to make it easier for customers to do business with The Bread Factory and help strengthen the relationships that keep them coming back.   Every day is different at The Bread Factory, but here are some of the things you’ll be doing:    Leading a high-performing team that provides outstanding Customer Care   - Lead, coach and developing the team to deliver excellent service and customer experiences.  - Grow Team Leaders and Trading Systems Manager to achieve their goals, manage performance and develop a highly engaged team.  - Act as the go-to escalation point for complex customer escalations, making decisions that are right for both the customer and the business.   Delivering an excellent service our customers can consistently rely on   - Ensure we consistently achieve and exceed our service, quality and customer KPI’s.  - Plan resources effectively to ensure the team is set up to meet customer demand.  - Own the onboarding journey so that customers have the best experience with us from day one.   Turning customer insight into better experiences   - Analyse customer feedback, complaints, CSAT, and operational data to identify continuous improvement, performance management and deflection opportunities.  - Turn customer feedback into meaningful actions that improve satisfaction, loyalty and retention.   Helping the team grow and succeed   - Ensure training, coaching and quality frameworks offer the tools the team needs to thrive and deliver exceptional experiences.  - Spot capability gaps and create robust development plans.  - Encourage a culture of learning, feedback

title: Customer Team Manager - Billing Call Centre
description: About The Role     Billing Contact Centre - Customer Team Manager   Customer Team Manager (Billing)  Location, Pity Me, Durham/Hybrid  2 x Permanent position  Salary from £35,615 to £41,900   We’ve got a fantastic opportunity to join us as a Customer Team Manager in our Billing Contact Centre.     We’re looking for people who are passionate about providing the best possible levels of customer service and thrive on creating positive experiences for customers, whilst well as motivating people and driving performance improvements across the team and business. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!      About The Role    It's a fast-paced environment where no 2 days are the same. Open Mon – Fri 8am –7pm and Sat 8am – 1pm, you’d be expected to work shifts to cover this on a rota basis. There’s flexibility to work half of your time at home and half in the office, after an initial training period.  Your day will be spent managing a team of advisors, everything from coaching, motivation, performance management, quality checking and HR admin. You’ll be accountable for the overall performance of your team, ensuring colleagues deliver outstanding service with a key focus on first contact resolution across all channels.  To get the best out of your team, you’ll ensure that appropriate training, coaching and feedback is in place, so they’re in the best place possible to deliver unrivalled customer experience. You’ll also create a positive and open working environment where we welcome and celebrate difference, promoting equality and diversity, to allow people to feel valued and trusted.    About You    You’ll be an enthusiastic customer service professional, ideally with some people management experience. You’ll be used to working in a fast-paced environment, and confident to step-up and be a strong and visible leader.  You’ll need effective communication skills and empathy as well as the ability to build and cultivate strong and long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders. You’ll be able to manage customer expectations, handling escalated complaints sometimes.  Reviewing performance and insight data to drive the performance of your team and the department is something you’ll do as part of your day to day. So, it would be great if you have skills and experience or a passion for all things data.   Our Process   As part of the interview process successful applicants may be asked to complete an individual exercise. You’ll be given sufficient preparation time and will receive further details with your interview invitation should you be successful in your application.   Here at Northumbrian Water/Essex & Suffolk Water, we embrace and value Diversity, Inclusion and Equity, and encourage all colleagues to bring their most authentic self to work.    Our colleague network groups include our Rainbow Support Network (LGBTQIA+), REACH (Race, Ethnicity, and Cultural Heritage), WiSTEM (Women in STEM) and Thisability (disability and neurodiversity)

title: Tiiminvetäjä, Tampere Veska
description: Kiinnostaako työskentely modernissa vähittäiskauppaketjussa, innostavassa ja lämminhenkisessä työyhteisössä, jossa pyritään yhdessä löytämään käteviä ja käytännöllisiä ratkaisuja asiakkaillemme?   Haemme nyt Tiiminvetäjää uuteen myymäläämme Tampereen Veskaan!   Tärkein tehtäväsi on ohjata ja kannustaa tiimiäsi tekemään tehokasta myyntityötä ja palvelemaan asiakkaita tavallista paremmin. Johdat ja delegoit myymälän päivittäisten tehtävien suorittamista sekä osallistut niiden kehittämiseen. Koulutat tiimiäsi, jotta saavutatte yhdessä erinomaisen asiakaspalvelun ja loistavat myyntitulokset. Varmistat myymälän kaupallisuuden yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa. Teet aktiivista myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyötä näyttäen esimerkkiä tiimillesi omalla tarmokkaalla toiminnallasi.  Olet kannustava esihenkilö, jolla on hyvät yhteistyötaidot. Olet tottunut suunnittelemaan, toteuttamaan ja seuraamaan päivittäisiä myymälärutiineja sekä myynnin avainlukuja. Omaat palavan innostuksen myyntiin ja johdat myyntiä kannustavalla otteella. Toivomme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta esihenkilötehtävästä tai vastuullisen myyjän tehtävästä vähittäiskaupassa tai palvelualalla. Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea ja englantia. Myynnin ammattitutkinto tai muu kaupallinen koulutus on plussaa.   Mitä tarjoamme?   Tulet osaksi lämminhenkistä ja avointa työyhteisöä, jossa vaalimme yrityskulttuurimme perustaa, Clas Ohlson henkeä. Me Clas Ohlsonilla arvostamme työtekijöitämme juuri sellaisina kuin he ovat. Tarjoamme jokaiselle mahdollisuuden kehittyä omassa roolissaan osallistuttamalla koko henkilökuntaa myymälän päivittäiseen toimintaan ja työskentelemällä aina yhdessä tiiminä. Henkilöstön hyvinvointi on meille tärkeää ja tarjoamme laajan työterveyshuollon, sekä ePassi sportti-, kulttuuri-, ja hyvinvointiedun kaikille työntekijöillemme. You will lead the Customer Support team and work closely with the Head of Payments to develop and strengthen the Support function. Proven people-management experience, including performance management, team development, workload management, onboarding, and quality control.  Experience building, redesigning, or significantly improving Support processes rather than only maintaining existing operations. title: Customer Support Manager
description: The client   Buddy Advisory is proud to be partnering with PaySauce to find their next Customer Support Manager. PaySauce makes payroll simple for small businesses across New Zealand, Australia and the Pacific. Their customers run cafes, build houses, milk cows and run retail stores; they're not payroll experts, they're experts in their own business. Payroll is time-critical and people rely on it, so being there when things go wrong matters deeply to the PaySauce team.  PaySauce is investing deeply in its Customer Experience function, both the operational side (the tools, data and overall management of how it delivers its service) and the people side, growing team capacity and capability as it heads into a period of significant product change.      The role   PaySauce is looking for a support leader who builds great customer care through a strong team and the systems and operations behind them. This is a leadership role owning PaySauce's Customer Support function, the inbound, reactive care customers come to them for, which sits alongside Customer Success, their proactive, outbound function. Together they shape the experience customers feel every day.  You'll lead the Customer Support team, report to PaySauce's Head of Customer Operations, and work across the wider Customer Experience group including Customer Operations, Customer Success, Onboarding and their dedicated Australian team. It's a team in a period of real growth and change, heading into a multi-year transition as customers move onto PaySauce's new products, and leading it well through that transition is a critical part of landing it.      The responsibilities    Lead the Customer Support team and build a collaborative, customer-first culture grounded in curiosity, teamwork and continuous improvement  Recruit, onboard and develop the team, working with everyone on their professional development and growing their skills  Balance workloads sustainably and ensure we're meeting expected SLAs across all inbound channels  Own the service model and how we deliver it, including through the upcoming migration of customers to a new payroll experience  Build a detailed understanding of service load to plan rosters and coverage, resource the team sustainably, and improve cost to serve over time  Track a balanced set of measures, including customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, and response and resolution times  Own escalation and issue management: clear escalation paths, senior stakeholder management, coordination with Development on urgent fixes and outages, and crisis communications  Embed quality assurance into day-to-day support work       The requirements    A highly capable people leader with lived leadership and coaching experience, helping others grow through trust and empowerment.  Systems-led and improvement-minded, applying sound support principles through tooling, automation and customer enablement, not just effort and headcount; this isn't a traditional call-centre manag

title: Transaction Services Team Leader
description: Some Career Choices Have More Impact Than Others.   At HSBC our purpose is to Open up a World of Opportunity. We use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth and perspectives to provide opportunities for our customers and colleagues through global connectivity. We bring together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities and the planet we all share.  As an HSBC employee in New Zealand, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities, competitive pay, an embedded flexible working culture and a range of employee benefits. These include market-leading subsidised private health cover, enhanced parental pay and support when returning to work, subsidised banking products and services, bonus leave days and wellness programmes including discounted gym membership.  HSBC Global Trade Solutions (GTS) is one of the largest trade services organisations in the world, offering a comprehensive range of forward-thinking supply chain and traditional trade solutions. The Transaction Services Manager plays a key role in proactively ensuring an industry-leading customer experience across high-value GTS relationships.  You’ll drive a culture of outstanding operational performance and service quality, balancing exceptional customer service with HSBC policies, procedures and controls. You’ll also support the transformation agenda across simplification, streamlining and digitisation to enhance customer experience and deliver value to the bank.   Responsibilities      Drive outstanding operational performance and service quality to support growth and improve customer retention.    Process transactions in line with applicable procedures, including FIMs, GOPs and other internal requirements, protecting the integrity of operations.    Deliver transaction processing within agreed customer SLAs, with a focus on “right first-time” processing to reduce rework and improve turnaround times.    Identify and challenge bespoke processing and undocumented/ unapproved policy variations, supporting standardisation and control.    Understand customer needs through feedback, providing transparent service and solutions aligned to customer requirements and HSBC standards.    Support a customer-centric culture by recording dissatisfaction, using complaints as an opportunity to improve, and addressing root causes.    Collaborate with internal stakeholders (e.g., Client Services, Sales, Relationship Managers, GSC and local management) to resolve queries and improve performance and quality.    Prioritise activities effectively, manage service quality controls, and implement preventative measures to reduce errors and repeat issues.    Implement recommendations and best practices following audit findings and country visit reports, ensuring no repeat findings.    Support and inspire colleagues, mentoring junior team members and driving continuous improve

title: Night Manager - Sherwood
description: Night Manager – Sherwood Queenstown  Boutique Alpine Hotel   About EVT   Sherwood Queenstown is part of EVT, one of Australasia's market-leading experience creators offering careers that can take you wherever you want to go across entertainment, ventures, and travel. In a world of cookie cutter experiences, here at EVT we believe in changing the game. It's why we all call ourselves Daymakers, because each day is a chance to add the wow factor for our customers and continually grow in our own careers.  The Independent Collection is a curated selection of hotels, each of which lives up to an exacting standard to offer travellers the best of luxury, elevated, urban, comfort and social experiences. While every hotel celebrates its own unique brand and experience, together the Independent Collection shares a passion for one-of-a-kind experiences, service and quality.  EVT has an endless range of roles and career paths to explore across over 140 entertainment experiences like Event Cinemas and Moonlight Cinemas, 150 award winning restaurants and bars, and 80+ hotels, including QT, Rydges, Atura, LyLo, Independent Collection and Australia's most loved year round alpine resort, Thredbo. Our ventures include a ~$2.3B property portfolio and hotel management, just to name a few. Once you're in, there's no limits on where your career could take you.   Role Overview   Sherwood Queenstown is a sustainability-led, boutique hotel set on the hillside overlooking Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables, awarded a Michelin Star in the inaugural MICHELIN Guide New Zealand. Blending rustic charm with modern comfort, Sherwood offers a unique retreat focused on wellness, creativity, and community.  Reporting to the Front Office Manager, the Night Manager acts as the manager of the hotel overnight in the absence of the General Manager, Front Office Manager and Hotel Manager, anticipating and meeting guest needs, overseeing the night audit process, and maintaining hotel security and established service standards through the night shift. You'll supervise the Night Team, resolve guest requests with warmth and urgency, and help protect the seamless experience Sherwood is known for around the clock. This is a rare opportunity to be part of something special, taking genuine ownership of the hotel during the night shift.  This is a full-time, permanent role with a minimum guaranteed hours of 40 per week.   Key Responsibilities      Act as manager of the hotel overnight, anticipating and attending to guest needs and desires as they occur   Check guests in and out efficiently, and process daily guest transactions and accounts accurately   Complete the night audit process thoroughly, ensuring accommodation, food, beverage and miscellaneous revenue is properly posted and any discrepancies are identified   Ensure the hotel is secured overnight in line with established procedures   Supervise the Night Auditor, Night Porters and other non-managerial staff on shift   Liaise with Housek

Somos una compañía internacional, dinámica y en constante evolución, donde la experiencia del cliente ocupa un papel estratégico. Diseñar y evolucionar el customer journey end-to-end, identificando oportunidades de mejora en todas las etapas de la experiencia. Transformar el feedback de clientes en acciones concretas que impulsen mejoras estructurales en el modelo de servicio. Experiencia liderando proyectos transversales con impacto en negocio y experiencia de cliente.  Conocimiento de metodologías como Customer Journey Mapping, Design Thinking, Service Design o Lean. description: We are seeking a dynamic, experienced and strategic-thinking  Account Manager  to increase sales from existing clients and proactively develop new business opportunities across the medical sector. In this role you will own the inlife experience of a portfolio of accounts – these are YOUR customers and how they feel about our business will be down to you. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Intitulé du poste :  Customer Success Manager   Type de contrat :  CDI   Date de prise de fonction :  Septembre 2026   Lieu :  Paris   Rémunération :  43-45k + 30% variable      La puissance du Retail Media   Le Retail Media est passé du statut de canal émergent à celui de priorité stratégique pour les marques et les distributeurs. En 2025, les dépenses mondiales ont atteint 171 milliards de dollars — soit un dollar sur cinq dépensé dans la publicité à l'échelle globale. Mais la véritable compétition ne porte plus sur les budgets : il s'agit désormais de prouver systématiquement que chaque euro investi génère des ventes nouvelles et mesurables.      À propos d'Unlimitail    Notre ambition : devenir le réseau de Commerce Media numéro 1 mondial en connectant chaque moment du parcours client — de la découverte à l'achat — et en transformant les investissements média en ventes incrémentales mesurables.  Bâtie sur une décennie d'expertise de Carrefour dans le Retail Media, Unlimitail collabore aujourd'hui avec 35 distributeurs dans 21 pays, représentant 250 millions de consommateurs et plus de 3 000 marques — constituant déjà le premier réseau omnicanal de Commerce Media en Europe.  Rejoindre Unlimitail, c'est intégrer une entreprise à la croisée de la data, de la technologie et du marketing digital — au moment précis où le marché redéfinit les standards de la performance. title: Junior Account Manager Elisa Oyj (Oulu)
description: Rakennatko sinä seuraavan kasvutarinan asiakkaidesi kanssa?     Elisa on Suomen johtava tietoliikenne- ja digitaalisten palveluiden tarjoaja. Sen ratkaisut auttavat tuhansia yrityksiä kehittämään liiketoimintaansa, parantamaan tuottavuuttaan ja rakentamaan kilpailuetua nopeasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä.    Bookers on ollut osa tätä menestystarinaa jo yli kahden vuosikymmenen ajan. Yhteistyömme Elisan kanssa alkoi 2000-luvun alussa, ja tänä päivänä vastaamme noin 4 500 suomalaisen yrityksen asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä ratkaisumyynnistä osana Elisan yritysmyyntiä.    Nyt etsimme Junior Account Manageria Ouluun liittymään noin 20 hengen asiantuntevaan myyntitiimiimme.    Tässä roolissa et myy yksittäisiä tuotteita. Toimit asiakkaidesi pitkäaikaisena kumppanina, tunnistat heidän liiketoimintansa tarpeita ja rakennat ratkaisuja, jotka auttavat heitä kasvamaan ja menestymään.    Mitä työ sisältää?   Vastaat nimettyjen pienten ja keskisuurten yritysasiakkaiden asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä pääkaupunkiseudulla. Tehtäväsi on kasvattaa asiakkuuksien arvoa, löytää uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia sekä saavuttaa kunnianhimoiset myyntitavoitteet.  Käytössäsi on koko Elisan yritysliiketoiminnan palveluvalikoima, jonka avulla voit rakentaa asiakkaillesi aidosti liiketoimintaa kehittäviä ratkaisuja. Työssä yhdistyvät nykyasiakkuuksien kehittäminen, ratkaisumyynti sekä uusien mahdollisuuksien aktiivinen tunnistaminen.  Työtä tehdään joustavasti hybridimallilla sekä kotoa että Elisan moderneissa toimitiloissa Oulussa. Asiakastyö edellyttää myös liikkumista asiakkaiden luona, ja oman auton käytöstä maksetaan kilometrikorvaukset.   Kenelle tehtävä sopii?   Menestyt tehtävässä, jos nautit tavoitteellisesta tekemisestä, haluat oppia myynnistä ja motivoidut mahdollisuudesta vaikuttaa omaan onnistumiseesi. Et tarvitse vuosien kokemusta asiakkuuksien johtamisesta tai ratkaisumyynnistä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on halu kehittyä, rohkeutta kohdata asiakkaita ja motivaatio tehdä tulosta.  Aiempi kokemus tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä auttaa sinua pääsemään vauhtiin, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme henkilöä, jolla on oikea asenne oppia uutta ja rakentaa pitkäjänteisesti omaa osaamistaan.  Sanomattakin lienee selvää, että tavoitteet saavutetaan yhdessä. Työ edellyttää oma-aloitteisuutta ja aktiivista otetta, mutta et missään vaiheessa jää yksin. title: Renewal & Winback Manager (m/w/d)
description: Kundenbindung ist kein Support-Thema - es ist eine Wachstumsstrategie. Bei kununu bauen wir diese Funktion gerade neu auf und du gestaltest sie von Anfang an mit.  Als Renewal & Winback Manager (m/w/d) schützt du den Kern unseres Geschäfts. Du arbeitest eng mit Account Management und Customer Experience zusammen, trägst aber dein Ergebnis selbst. Dein Erfolg ist direkt in gesicherten Verträgen und zurückgewonnenen Kund:innen messbar.  Was dich erwartet: keine eingefahrenen Prozesse, kein fertiges Playbook, dafür echte Verantwortung, direkter Einfluss auf unsere Umsatzbasis und die Möglichkeit, etwas aufzubauen, das Bestand hat.      Deine Aufgaben    Umsatz sichern: Du erkennst Churn-Risiken früh, verstehst warum Kund:innen gehen und handelst, bevor der Vertrag verloren ist.  Kundenbeziehungen retten: Du führst schwierige Gespräche mit Entscheidungsträger:innen, findest individuelle Lösungen und bringst Verhandlungen zu einem Ergebnis.  Verlorene Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du baust das erste strukturierte Winback-Programm bei kununu auf und sorgst dafür, dass ehemalige Kund:innen den Weg zurück finden.  Das AM-Team stärken: Bei strategisch wichtigen Accounts, bei denen Churn droht, wirst du als Spezialist:in dazugeholt - du bringst die kommerzielle Expertise, die Retention braucht.  Marktanteile verteidigen: Du positionierst kununu überzeugend gegen Wettbewerber und Budget-Druck - mit Argumenten, die auf dem konkreten Wert für die Kund:innen basieren.  Retention messbar machen: Du etablierst die Grundlagen für eine datengetriebene Retention-Steuerung bei kununu und legst damit den Grundstein für ein wachsendes Team.       Das bringst du mit    Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im B2B-SaaS- oder Subscription-Geschäft - idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Renewals, Account Management oder Customer Success.  Du führst schwierige Gespräche konstruktiv und bleibst sachlich, auch wenn die Gegenseite Druck macht.  Die Zufriedenheit deiner Kund:innen hat für dich höchste Priorität. Bei einer Kündigung analysierst du die Gründe und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungspotenziale ab.  Du verstehst dich als Stimme der Kund:innen nach innen: Du nutzt das, was du im Kundenkontakt hörst, um intern Prozesse, Produkt und Zusammenarbeit weiterzuentwickeln.  Idealerweise bist du bereits mit Tools wie Gong, Salesloft oder Salesforce vertraut und setzt sie routiniert in deinem Arbeitsalltag ein.  Digitale Sales Rooms sind für dich ein selbstverständliches Arbeitsmittel, kein Pilotprojekt.  KI und Automatisierung setzt du pragmatisch ein.  Für die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen im DACH-Raum verfügst du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Da wir international zusammenarbeiten, kommunizierst du auch sicher auf Englisch.       Deine Benefits    Bürohunde  Bis zu12 Wochen Workation  6 Wochen Urlaub  Mobile devices auch zum privaten Gebrauch  Sommer- und Weihnachtsparty  Drinks, Food & Goodies  Flexibles Home-Office  Restauranttickets und Mitarbeiterrabatte  Marktkonfo

title: Account Manager
description: [아임웹 팀 소개]   아임웹 Brand Growth팀은 아임웹 위에서 비즈니스를 운영하는 고객사들의 매출 성장과 장기 파트너십을 책임지는 팀입니다.  연 매출 수십억 규모의 브랜드부터, D2C 쇼핑몰, 엔터프라이즈 브랜드까지, 이미 아임웹을 핵심 도구로 사용하고 있는 고객사들이 우리의 파트너입니다. Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다.    [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 Account Manager, Customer Success, 고객 컨설팅 등 고객 접점 직무에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  다수의 중, 대형 고객 포트폴리오를 운영하며 매출 성장과 리텐션, 업셀링에서 의미 있는 성과를 만들어내신 분  고객사의 비즈니스를 깊이 이해하고, 데이터를 기반으로 컨설팅에 가까운 제안을 해보신 분  Spreadsheet, BI 툴 등으로 직접 데이터를 분석하고, 협상과 제안의 근거로 활용하시는 분  고객사 의사결정자와 신뢰감 있게 소통하고, 다양한 이해관계자와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에 유연하게 적응하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM, 광고 솔루션 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험이 있으신 분  신규 영업의 협상과 계약부터 온보딩, 확장까지 풀 사이클을 경험해보신 분  CRM 또는 BI 툴을 적극적으로 활용해본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반의 업셀링, 크로스셀링 시나리오를 직접 설계해 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분  중형과 대형 고객사를 대상으로 한 정기 비즈니스 리뷰와 컨설팅 운영 경험  활용 데이터를 기반으로 이탈을 예측하거나 확장 기회를 발견해본 경험  D2C 브랜드, 쇼핑몰, 마켓플레이스 등 이커머스 생태계에 대한 깊은 이해       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.

title: Senior Specialist - Customer Experience
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Vil du være med til at forme oplevelsen for millioner af passagerer hvert år? Med ’Passenger First, Always’ som ledestjerne arbejder vi for at skabe en rejseoplevelse i verdensklasse. Vores ambition er at levere de oplevelser, der får passagererne til at vælge og huske CPH – vi vil ’delighte’. Det gør vi ved at kombinere effektive processer, god service og inspirerende oplevelser, så lufthavnen opleves som mere end blot et stop på rejsen.   Din nye rolle   I rollen som Senior Specialist i Customer Experience (CX) får du ansvaret for at udvikle og sikre en sammenhængende passageroplevelse på tværs af hele rejsen, både den fysiske og digitale. Rollen giver stor indflydelse, et bredt netværk på tværs af lufthavnen og mulighed for at omsætte strategi til synlige resultater i passagerrejsen.  Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:    Eje og videreudvikle CPH’s Master Passenger Journey på tværs af organisationen  Identificere, prioritere og konkretisere forbedringsmuligheder baseret på kundeindsigter, data og trends  Drive og prioritere en tværgående udviklings-roadmap på passagerrejsen på tværs af CPH  Definere og forankre CX-krav, standarder og designprincipper for fysiske og digitale touch points  Sikre at passagerernes behov tænkes ind gennem kravsætning og design/ambience i byggeprojekter. Vi bygger til fremtiden, og det stiller krav til indsigt i trends, fremtidige passagerbehov og udviklingen i rejsebehov  Benchmarke og omsætte best practice fra førende lufthavne og servicevirksomheder  Rådgive og udfordre organisationen inden for kundeoplevelser og passagerbehov     Din nye afdeling   I Commercial & Passenger Journey arbejder vi med at udvikle CPH’s kommercielle forretning. Vi har ansvaret for alt fra udvikling af ruter til udlejning af butikker og spisesteder, parkering, kommunikation og den samlede passagerrejse.  Du bliver en del af Passenger Journey Development. Vi er et team på 11 personer med forskellige faglige kompetencer inden for forretningsudvikling, service excellence, monitorering og kvalitetsopfølgning og CX, som deler en fælles passion for at udvikle og forbedre passagerrejsen.  Vi prioriterer et godt sammenhold i teamet og mødes til både faglige arrangementer, frokost eller en god kop kaffe, ligesom vi også mødes socialt med hele den kommercielle afdeling på 90 skønne kollegaer.   Om dig   Du arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem strategi, kundeindsigter og drift og får en unik mulighed for at sætte retning for, hvordan Københavns Lufthavn skal opleves i fremtiden. Det gør du med din strukturerede og metodiske evne til at omsætte strategi til konkrete planer – og til at eksekvere dem. Du anvender også din forståelse for sammenhængen af det fysiske og digitale rum.  Vi forestiller os, at du har:    Strategisk kunde- og forretningsforståelse  Arbejdet med Customer Experience fra andre større virksomheder  Erfaring med at arbejde i det fysiske rum og forståelse for, hvordan design og indretning påvirker passageroplevelsen  Erfar

title: Vikarierende senterleder SATS Storhaug
description: Vi søker vikarierende senterleder til SATS Storhaug   Brenner du for å inspirere mennesker til et sunnere og gladere liv?  🙌   Vil du lede et team som utgjør en forskjell hver eneste dag? SATS Storhaug jobber for å skape positiv forandring ved å motivere medlemmene våre og tilby en treningsopplevelse utenom det vanlige. Som senterleder går du foran med engasjement og retning, og har ansvaret for at ditt senter leverer sterke resultater - både driftsmessig og økonomisk. Du har spesielt fokus på enestående service, målrettet salgsinnsats og et høyt nivå på renhold - alt for å sikre de beste rammene og opplevelsene for medlemmene våre.   Vikariatet vil være frem til 31. august 2027, med mulighet for forlengelse.    Ønsket oppstart: snarest.   🌟 Dine ansvarsområder   Gå foran som leder!  Du får det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften i ditt senter og sørger for en livlig, imøtekommende og energifylt atmosfære for både medlemmer og ansatte.   Skap resultater!  Du tar eierskap for senteret ditt – inkludert resultater og utvikling – og har det fulle økonomiske ansvaret. Du jobber strategisk for å nå salgs- og inntektsmål, samtidig som du styrer kostnadene effektivt.   Bygg et fremragende team!  Du rekrutterer, onboarder, inspirerer og utvikler et dedikert team som konsekvent leverer service i verdensklasse og skaper ekstraordinære opplevelser for medlemmene våre.   Skap en kultur preget av kvalitet!  Gjennom synlig og involverende ledelse sørger du for at alle detaljer – fra kundeservice til renhold, sikkerhet og vedlikehold av utstyr – holder høyeste standard.   Sett trivsel i fokus!  Som leder har du ansvar for arbeidsmiljøet i senteret ditt, og du sikrer en trygg, positiv og motiverende atmosfære for både ansatte og medlemmer.   Sørg for et skinnende rent senter!  Sammen med teamet ditt bruker du tid daglig på å gjøre rent – slik at senteret alltid møter SATS’ høye standarder. Uansett når medlemmene trener, skal de bli møtt av et ryddig og innbydende senter.  🤩 Hvem er du?  Du er utadvendt, vennlig og karismatisk, og har en naturlig evne til å bygge sterke relasjoner – både med medlemmer og kollegaer. Du tar initiativ, er handlekraftig og trives med å ta ansvar, samtidig som du har et skarpt blikk for struktur og systematikk i hverdagen. Du engasjerer og motiverer andre med energien og arbeidsgleden din, og du leder ved å være et inspirerende forbilde.    Du har solid erfaring med salg og ledelse og motiveres av å skape gode resultater.  Det er et krav at du snakker og skriver flytende norsk og engelsk.  Du kan identifisere deg med våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional & Extraordinary.  Du trives med fleksible arbeidstider, da vaktene varierer – inkludert tidlige morgener, sene kvelder, helger og helligdager. Dette sikrer at det alltid er en leder til stede i de travleste periodene, samtidig som du får muligheten til å jobbe sammen med teamet ditt på ulike vakter. Du må også være forberedt på å være tilgjengelig uteno

title: Customer Service Coordinator
description: Job Summary    JOB DESCRIPTION – CUSTOMER SERVICE COORDINATOR     Location: Helsinki, Finland.    Division: Ticketmaster Finland    Line Manager: Fan Support Manager – Ticketmaster Finland    Contract Terms: Full time 37.5h/week, Fixed term (1 year maternity leave cover)    THE TEAM   The Fan Support Team guides our fans through the entire event journey – before, during, and after the show. We assist with everything from ticket‑purchasing questions to what fans need in order to access and enjoy the event. Our team handles a wide range of inquiries across all event types, including music, comedy, theatre, sports, and attractions.  At Ticketmaster, we love music, culture, and sports – and so do our customers. Fan Support serves as a dedicated link between our fans and our services, working continuously to ensure a smooth, supportive, and positive customer experience.   THE JOB    The role of Customer Service Coordinator will provide an efficient front-line service to fans by resolving problems and queries and utilizing appropriate communication methods to ensure new and existing fan loyalty and brand confidence.  In addition to handling direct inquiries, the role includes key back‑office tasks such as case management, processing payment issues, escalating technical issues internally, and ensuring accurate follow‑up across systems.  As part of a global company, you will collaborate with colleagues across markets to secure consistent quality in the fan experience. The role reports to the local Fan Support Manager.  Ticketmaster is part of Live Nation Entertainment which is the world’s leading live entertainment company comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, LN Media and Artist Nation Management.   What You Will Be Doing     Handling fan inquiries through written channels such as email (Zendesk), phone and social media, ensuring clear, professional, and well‑structured communication in line with company standards and agreed service levels.  Identify opportunities for service improvement and proactively act on agreed enhancements to optimise the fan experience.  Handle payment issues, disputes, troubleshooting, and perform a variety of back‑office administrative tasks.  Advise and support other members of the fan support team and external departments in relation to event and venue information and fan queries.   Contribute to projects and support the development of products, processes, and documentation, including guides and translations.  Liaise with other departments across the business to ensure adequate knowledge of the business to enhance the service provided to the fan.  Adhere to all company and departmental processes, policies and procedures.   Work at events as needed.  Undertake other duties as required by management.      What You Need To Know     Experience with written customer support, such as email, chat, or messaging platforms.  Solid written and verbal communication skills in both Finnish and English.

title: Service Manager
description: Job Description   Are you a people-focused leader with a passion for delivering excellent public service?  Then come join us at the Nelson District Court and help us deliver people-centred justice services that make a real difference in the lives of New Zealanders.   Te Haeata/The Opportunity    We are looking for a dynamic  Service Manager  to lead our our Family/Civil/Tribunals team at the  Nelson District & High Court .  This is a key leadership role within our  Operations and Service Delivery (OSD)  group, responsible for coaching and supporting staff, driving high performance, and ensuring consistent, quality service delivery across jurisdictions.  As a Service Manager, you will lead a team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. You will also oversee day-to-day court operations, ensuring customers receive consistent, high-quality service.  This role may include holding statutory appointments such as Deputy Registrar of the District Court, and other delegated authorities under relevant legislation.   Ō Pūkenga/Skills And Experience   To be successful in this role, you will bring:    Proven experience managing and developing staff capability through coaching and support.  Operational management experience, ideally in a court, tribunal, or customer service environment.  Strong leadership skills to motivate and lead teams to achieve targets and understand their contribution to the bigger picture.  A track record of supporting and implementing changes to business and work processes.  The ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders.  Resilience and confidence in leading in a public-facing role.  Excellent communication skills and sound judgement.     Mō Mātou/About Us   At Te Tāhū o te Ture - the Ministry of Justice, we're committed to strengthening people's trust in the law of Aotearoa, New Zealand.  The team in Nelson are a closeknit group who work together to support our judicial officers and provide a friendly service to court users. We place a strong emphasis on wellbeing, recognising the demands of our work and the importance of looking after one another.  Joining Te Tāhū o te Ture means you will become part of an organisation that welcomes and supports people of all gender identities, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, disabilities and religions.   Ngā painga o tēnei wāhi mahi/What's great about working here     Benefits   We offer you a range of benefits to support your wellbeing and help make the Ministry a great place to be. These include:    4.4 weeks holiday leave  flexible work hours where possible  an online professional development portal  access to a variety of inclusive and proactive networks.    See our full range of benefits here.  With a wide range of jobs, you also get the chance to gain a variety of skills and experience while developing your career.   Utu ā-tau/Salary   The appointing salary for this role will be between $99,208 and $127,683 base

title: Manager – Ecommerce CX Excellence
description: Role:  Manager – Ecommerce CX Excellence   Location:  Jeddah   Exp:  5+ years of experience in CX journey management or digital experience leadership. title: Front Office Manager

As a  Front Office Manager , you’re not just overseeing daily front office operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.   Responsibilities   Here's what you'll do during a typical day:    Manage daily front office operations: Oversee Front Office activities including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards  Monitor and elevate service: Track guest satisfaction, address service issues, and guide the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience  Implement revenue initiatives: Promote hotel services and execute up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth  Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions  Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards  Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment     Qualifications    What It Takes to Make the Stay   At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member  A passion for spreading the light and warmth of  Hospitality . About Us    Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture   At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.  Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.  Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager

We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our fast-growing team. We're looking for someone with a passion for building customer relationships, enjoys working in a fast-moving environment, and the ability to strategically identify growth opportunities across our customer set.     As a Customer Success Manager at Unwrap, you’ll own relationships across a wide range of customers—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—ensuring every team gets the most out of our platform. At the core, you'll work to understand each customer's objectives, design the path to success, and identify growth opportunities. Day-to-day, you'll oversee implementation, training, renewal, and expansion processes, as well as day-to-day customer support.     In addition to direct account management, you’ll create clear and helpful resources such as guides, FAQs, and best practices to empower users and enhance their experience. You’ll also collaborate closely with teams across Unwrap, relaying feedback, advocating for customer needs, and contributing to ongoing improvements to our platform and our processes. We’re helping companies like Lyft, Stripe, Oura, Microsoft, Perplexity, and Github collect and process feedback more effectively. We’re currently a team of 40, based in Santa Barbara, and growing quickly. We are venture-backed, and just raised our $12M Series A from world-leading VCs.     Our founders, two ex-Amazon Alexa Product Managers, were tired of manually sifting through customer reviews, support tickets, and bugs while working on Alexa. They understood the importance of listening to customers and prioritizing their requests effectively, but simply had too much feedback to parse through. So,  Unwrap.ai  was born to solve this problem. Specifically, at Unwrap we use Natural Language Processing to automatically cluster, tag, and analyze customer feedback to help product and engineering teams build what customers want. The ultimate goal is to better connect users and builders, so builders can fill the world with products people love.     Our small team is extremely motivated, hard-working, and simply gets stuff done. If this sounds exciting, we can't wait to read your application.      What You Bring    You have 3-5 years of experience in an Enterprise Customer Success or Account Management-related role—ideally in SaaS or AI-driven products. title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) | Hamburg | Frankfurt
description: Work＠everii    Du begeisterst dich für B2B SaaS-Software? Du liebst es, Kunden zu unterstützen und ihre Probleme zu lösen? Du hast Freude daran, Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und zu pflegen?   Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!    Zusammen die Arbeitswelt von morgen gestalten    everii mit seinen 120 Mitarbeitenden ist der führende Anbieter von Software-Lösungen fürs Projektbusiness. Im DACH-Raum arbeiten mehr als 13.000 Agenturen, Beratungen, IT-Services bis hin zu Ingenieuren und Architekten täglich mit diesen Profi-Tools. Als CSM hilfst du mit, diese Unternehmen verschiedener Größen effizienter und erfolgreicher zu machen.    Was dich erwartet   Im Angebot haben wir einen Job, der Spaß macht und dir die Möglichkeit gibt, eng mit unseren Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten. Unsere ausgezeichnete Beratung lebt davon, dass du individuell auf die Wünsche unserer Kunden eingehst. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Lösungen, die unsere Produkte optimal nutzen. Dabei erwarten dich immer wieder neue Herausforderungen.   Hast du Erfahrung mit  helloHQ  oder  MOCO ? Wenn du derzeit Nutzer dieser Systeme bist und eine neue Herausforderung suchst, zögere nicht, dich zu bewerben.   Du bist kommunikativ, technikaffin und liebst es, Menschen zu unterstützen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig! Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen, lösungsorientierten Menschen, der unsere Kunden begeistert. -  Perfect Match!   Aufgaben   Deine Aufgaben       Kundenkommunikation:  Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle und das Gesicht unserer Produkte im Austausch mit unseren Kunden und schaffst eine vertrauensvolle, langfristige Beziehung.    Onboarding:  Du führst neue Kunden selbstständig durch ihre Onboarding-Projekte und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Geschäftsprozesse optimal mit unseren Produkten abzubilden.    Kundenbetreuung:  Auch nach der Implementierung bleibst du ein verlässlicher Ansprechpartner und begleitest Kunden aktiv durch ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus.    Kundenbindung und Churn Prevention:  Du erkennst frühzeitig Signale für nachlassendes Engagement oder Abwanderungsrisiko, leitest gezielte Maßnahmen ein und sorgst dafür, dass Kunden dauerhaft erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten.    Retention und Renewals:  Du verantwortest die Vertragsverlängerungen deiner Kunden, bereitest Renewals strukturiert vor und führst Gespräche auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn es um kommerzielle Themen geht.    Weiterentwicklung und Expansion:  Du identifizierst Potenziale für eine tiefere Produktnutzung oder zusätzliche Module und bringst diese gezielt in den Dialog mit dem Kunden ein.    Schulung und Training:  Du führst Schulungen und Webinare durch, um Kunden neue Funktionen und Best Practices näherzubringen und den Produktnutzen kontinuierlich zu steigern.    Proaktive   Problemprävention:  Durch die regelmäßige Analyse der Produktnutzung erkennst du Probleme, bevor sie auftreten, und entwickelst proaktive Lösungen gemeinsam mit dem Kunden.    Produktentwicklung:  Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden und Produktteam

title: Partner Lifecycle Manager
description: About The Role   We help some of the world’s most recognized consumer brands—airlines, banks and card issuers, loyalty programs, retailers, fintechs, travel agencies, and large digital platforms—offer travel to their customers, powered by one of the world’s largest travel-commerce supply networks. Our portfolio spans affiliate and accommodation API integrations, private-label and white-label travel platforms, connected-trip experiences, and value-add layers including loyalty, travel media, trip protection, and payments.  This role leads the Lifecycle team responsible for growing value from live partners after launch. The Acquisition team wins the logo; Lifecycle drives activation, engagement, retention, and scalable expansion across the partner base.  You are a player-coach: leading a small team of Lifecycle Specialists while personally owning lifecycle strategy and execution for a defined set of high-potential growth partners and priority commercial initiatives. You will bring commercial discipline to lifecycle marketing—turning partner signals into programs that grow adoption, revenue, product usage, and retention.  This is not an account-management role. You will work closely with Partner Management, BD, Product, and Operations, but your ownership is the lifecycle growth engine: the strategy, programs, measurement, and operating rhythm that help partners realize more value over time.   What you’ll do:     Define and own lifecycle strategy for the live-partner portfolio: onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and scalable expansion motions. Set quarterly goals, measurement standards, and the team’s operating rhythm.  Lead and develop the Lifecycle team. Run regular 1:1s, set clear priorities, coach on program design and commercial thinking, and allocate work across the portfolio effectively.  Personally lead lifecycle growth for a defined group of selected, high-potential partners and priority opportunities. Design and run the programs that increase adoption, usage, retention, and commercial value.  Build repeatable growth programs across the portfolio, including onboarding journeys, engagement campaigns, product-adoption initiatives, retention interventions, and expansion triggers.  Drive commercial outcomes through lifecycle marketing. Translate portfolio and funnel signals into actions that improve activation, conversion, product adoption, retention, and revenue. Experience carrying or being directly accountable to commercial targets is strongly valued.  Own lifecycle reporting and measurement. Establish clear health, engagement, funnel, and growth metrics; create regular internal performance readouts; and ensure the team can identify what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus next.  Govern onboarding quality. Define the handoff and intake process for newly signed partners so Lifecycle receives the information needed to activate partners quickly and effectively.  Surface actionable intelligence to the wider organization.

Nyt etsimme monipuolista osaajaa  Avainasiakaspäällikön  rooliin vahvistamaan kotimaan myyntitiimiä!     Onko myynti sinulle intohimo ja digitaaliset työkalut luonnollinen osa arkipäivääsi? Haluatko päästä jättämään oman kädenjälkesi kasvavaan liiketoimintaamme? Olet valmis matkustamaan ja toimimaan monipuolisessa ympäristössä? Jos vastasit kyllä, saatat olla etsimämme dynaaminen myynnin ammattilainen!       Avainasiakaspäällikkönä  vastaat  kotimaan myyntimme vahvistamisesta . Työsi on yhdistelmä uusasiakashankintaa ja olemassa olevien avainasiakkuuksien strategista kehittämistä. Et tyydy vain ylläpitämään, vaan etsit aktiivisesti uusia tapoja kasvattaa markkinaosuuttamme ja luoda lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme. Olet kuin kotonasi tienpäällä ja matkustat sujuvasti asiakkaiden luona ympäri Suomea, painottaen Länsi-Suomea. Sijaintisi on neuvoteltavissa, sillä modernit digitaaliset työkalumme mahdollistavat tuloksellisen työskentelyn joustavasti eri paikkakunnilta.      Odotamme sinulta:   • Vahvaa myyntiorientoituneisuutta: Sinulla on paloa päästä tavoitteisiin ja nautit kaupan klousaamisesta.  • Aktiivista, yhteistyöhakuista ja tuloshakuista asennetta. Kykenet viemään asioita eteenpäin itsenäisesti, mutta arvostat tiimityötä.  • Digitaalista ymmärrystä: Hallitset nykyaikaiset myynnin ja markkinoinnin työkalut (CRM, sosiaalinen media, digitaaliset kanavat) ja ymmärrät, miten dataa hyödynnetään myyntiprosessissa.  •  Dynaamista työskentelytapaa: Olet itseohjautuva, energinen ja kykenet reagoimaan nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin.  • Sujuvia vuorovaikutustaitoja: Neuvottelet vakuuttavasti suomeksi ja rakennat luottamusta eri sidosryhmien välille. Pystyt toiminaan myös englannin kielellä pohjoismaisessa toimintaympäristössä. Saat asioita tapahtumaan yksin ja yhdessä.  Kokemus vastaavista työtehtävistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta lopulta etsimme oikeaa asennetta ja halua onnistua tehtävässä!      Tarjoamme sinulle:   • Kotimaisen huippubrändin ja tuotteet  • Laajan kontaktiverkoston ja alan johtavan jälleenmyyntiyhteisön  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa suoraan yrityksen kasvuun ja kannattavuuteen.  • Innostavan ja modernin työympäristön, jossa arvostetaan uusia ideoita ja toimintatapoja  • Työkalut ja kollegoiden tuen, jotta voit menestyä työssäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.      Innostuitko?    Työ alkaa  sopimuksen mukaan. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si  mahdollisimman pian , kuitenkin viimeistään  6.9.2026  sähköpostitse osoitteeseen jobs@stala.com.      Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myyntijohtaja Juhana Welling soittoaikoina. Juhanan tavoittaa puhelimitse numerosta +358 50 538 0681 ti 25.8 klo 10-12, to 27.8 klo 13-15 tai pe 28.8 klo 10-12.

title: Customer Success Lead - Western Europe
description: About ElevenLabs   ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.  We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.   We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms     ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.  ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.  ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.    Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.  How we work    High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.  Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.  AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.  Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.  Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.    What we offer    Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.  Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.  Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.  Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.  Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.  Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.     About The Role   As the Customer Success Lead you'll lead a team of experienced Customer Success team members across the Western Europe region. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value to customers and the business. Coordinate new employee orientation and onboarding programmes.    Conduct training on guest service, hotel standards, SOPs, grooming and communication skills.    Work closely with Department Heads to identify operational training requirements.    Organise leadership and supervisory development programmes. Founded to challenge Docusign by putting transparency, fairness, and genuine customer service first, we pioneered Pay as you go pricing in the digital signing space, so our customers only pay for what they use. Today we serve 8,000+ businesses and 120,000+ monthly active users across Australia, the UK, and the US, who've collectively signed more than 70 million envelopes together, spanning industries from legal and accounting to real estate, financial services, education, and NDIS.
