Grand nom français du transport sous température dirigée, nous intervenons sur l'ensemble du territoire en nous appuyant sur la performance de notre réseau. L'esprit d'innovation et l'engagement de nos collaborateurs nous ont permis, depuis la création de l'entreprise, de connaître une croissance soutenue et de nous adapter aux évolutions de notre marché. En interne comme en externe, nous plaçons l'humain au coeur du projet de l'entreprise. La proximité et la satisfaction client rythment notre quotidien.   	Rattaché(e) au Directeur d'Exploitation, le Responsable Relations Clients (H/F) pilote avec l'aide de son équipe, le bon traitement et la résolution des réclamations clients avec objectif constant de minimiser les coûts, d'assurer la satisfaction du client et la rapidité de traitement des dossiers.  Vos missions : - Traiter les dossiers clients conflictuels et sensibles - Rechercher la solution la plus adaptée pour satisfaire le client en tenant compte des contraintes d'organisation de l'exploitation et de l'optimisation des coûts pour l'entreprise - Veiller au bon traitement des réclamations clients et dossiers litiges par son équipe en assurant un support sur des dossiers complexes - Traiter et transfèrer les dossiers litiges au service contentieux selon l'importance des dossiers - Consolide les reporting suivant les indicateurs qualité, analyse les écarts de traitement des dossiers et met en place les plans d'actions correctifs - Propose et met en oeuvre des solutions SAV répondant aux besoins clients et respectant les engagements de délais et de qualité de service - Assure une fluidité des échanges et des actions avec l'exploitation - Assiste aux rendez-vous clients (à la demande du client), point qualité Communique les objectifs, responsabilise son équipe - Fait contribuer son équipe à l'amélioration du service client fourni - Garantit la cohésion de groupe - Coordonne et supervise le travail de son équipe - Participe à l'accompagnement et à la montée en compétences de son équipe    	Issu(e) d'une formation Bac+2/+3 Logistique et Transport, vous avez une expérience significative de 5 à 7 ans en management d'une équipe service clients.   Vous êtes dynamique, tenace et manager fait partie de votre ADN. Rigoureux, votre capacité à prendre du recul et à prioriser les actions vous permet de faire face à l'imprévu et d'élaborer spontanément des solutions concrètes et efficaces pour répondre aux besoins et aux contraintes des clients.  Vous connaissez les fondamentaux de la gestion et maîtrisez les outils informatiques indispensables à l'exercice de votre mission. 	Ref : 30633727

title: Advocacy & Communications Manager
description: About The Role   In this role, you will lead the PR, Advocacy & Events for our Consumer Products Division in New Zealand. You will be responsible for translating ANZ and international brand visions into local success stories through high-impact communication and advocacy.    Localise and execute PR & Advocacy communication strategies in consistency with international communication and ANZ business strategy.  Lead divisional PR relations, managing image and press requests while identifying proactive media opportunities.  Execute integrated communication campaigns and brand events in close collaboration with marketing and Category Activation teams.  Initiate and manage influencer relationships, driving both organic advocacy and supporting paid campaigns where required.  Oversee the end-to-end logistics of the PR division, including press sample management and mass send-outs.  Track media coverage and drive PR results, providing monthly reports to wider brand teams and internal stakeholders.  Manage event and campaign costs within allocated budgets, including PO management and vendor set-up.  Work closely with external agencies and ANZ marketing teams to ensure consistency and excellence in all local PR initiatives.     About You     Proven experience in PR, Advocacy, or Communications, ideally within the beauty or lifestyle industry.  An established network and a deep understanding of the New Zealand media and influencer landscape.  A strategic mindset with the ability to execute creative 360° campaigns from concept to completion.  Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage budgets, logistics, and vendor relationships.  A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively across local New Zealand teams and broader ANZ regional structures.  Resilience and agility, with the capacity to manage the fast-paced nature of a fixed-term contract.  Excellent communication skills, both for external storytelling and internal reporting of PR results.

title: Chef för kundrelationer och nya affärer – Fjärrvärme Stockholm
description: Om oss   Fjärrvärme spelar en viktig roll i energiomställningen och i utvecklingen av våra städer. Inom E.ONs fjärrvärmeverksamhet arbetar vi nära våra kunder för att tillsammans hitta långsiktiga och hållbara energilösningar. Våra kunder i Stockholmsregionen är framför allt fastighetsbolag, kommunala bolag och bostadsrättsföreningar, där långsiktiga relationer och förståelse för kundernas behov är centralt för vår affär. Nu söker vi en chef som vill leda vårt säljteam i Stockholm med ansvarar för kundrelationer och nyförsäljning och fortsätta utveckla vår affär i regionen.   Din roll   Du ansvarar för våra kundrelationer och fjärrvärmeförsäljning i Stockholmsregionen och leder ett team av key account managers, affärsingenjörer och en affärskoordinator. Tillsammans utvecklar ni våra kundrelationer, identifierar nya affärsmöjligheter och skapar långsiktigt värde för både våra kunder och E.ON.  I rollen kommer du bland annat att:    Leda, coacha och utveckla ditt team och skapa goda förutsättningar för engagemang och resultat.  Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer samt ha eget ansvar för några av våra större strategiska kunder.  Driva och utveckla affären i regionen med fokus på lönsamma och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar för både våra kunder och E.ON.  Representera E.ON i dialogen med kunder, kommuner och andra aktörer och aktivt bevaka stadsutvecklingen i regionen genom dialog, nätverk och att du förstår våra kunders behov.  Följa upp försäljning och resultat samt skapa struktur och framdrift i teamets arbete.  Arbeta för strategisk utveckling av verksamheten och vår affär.     Du ingår i både Commercials ledningsgrupp och ledningsgruppen för fjärrvärmeverksamheten i Stockholmsregionen, där du tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar till att utveckla vår verksamhet och driva affären framåt.   Vem är det vi hoppas vill bli vår nya ledare?   Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet från energi, fastighet, infrastruktur, stadsutveckling eller annan närliggande verksamhet och en god förståelse för komplexa affärer och kunders behov. Vi ser gärna att du har en god förståelse för samhällsbyggnadssektorn, dess aktörer, beslutsvägar och processer som påverkar energival och affärer vid ny- och ombyggnation. Vi ser också att du har erfarenhet av att leda andra, som chef eller i en annan ledande roll.  Som ledare är du trygg, lyhörd och har förmågan att möta, utmana och utveckla medarbetare med olika erfarenheter och behov. Du skapar struktur och framdrift och har förmågan att lyfta blicken och se affären ur ett större perspektiv. Vi ser också att du har ett starkt affärsmannaskap och förmågan att bygga förtroendefulla relationer. Med ett prestigelöst och samarbetsorienterat förhållningssätt söker du nya perspektiv och ser värdet av att lyckas tillsammans, både inom teamet och med andra delar av E.ON.   Hur är det hos oss?   Din närmsta chef, Jenny Rosander, värdesätter öppenhet, handlingskraft och ett nära samarbete. Hon ger dig stort förtroende och utrymm

title: Serviceleder - Greve
description: Bucher Municipal A/S er en del af schweiziske Bucher Industries, en global industrikoncern med ca. 14.000 medarbejdere. Til vores serviceværksted i Greve søger vi en erfaren serviceleder, som vil tage det overordnede ansvar for drift og udvikling af vores største serviceværksted i Danmark.  Som vores nye Serviceleder skal du kunne skabe motivation, trivsel og udvikling blandt medarbejderne. Du bliver ansvarlig for den daglige ledelse og skal som spillende træner være tæt på både medarbejderne og den daglige drift på værkstedet. Samtidig bliver du ansvarlig for, at afdelingen kontinuerligt udvikler måden at servicere og give gode kundeoplevelser på.  Afdelingerne varetager service og reparation af slamsugere, fejemaskiner og på sigt eventuelt flere lignende produkttyper. Ofte er anlæggene unikke, hvilket betyder, at kompetencerne hos personalet skal være høje ligesom det kræver stor forståelse for kundernes behov at levere den helt rigtige kundeoplevelse.  I værkstedet er der et højt aktivitetsniveau, men der er kolleger, som støtter i forhold til de administrative opgaver ligesom den tidligere Serviceleder vil hjælpe dig godt i gang med opgaven.  Dine opgaver    Være meget synlig på værkstedet, støtte medarbejderne og skabe retning i hverdagen  Planlægning og koordinering af værkstedets opgaver  Kundekontakt: modtagelse, tilbud, rådgivning og opfølgning - og sikre, at opgaver følges helt til dørs  Prioritering og sparring med mekanikerne for at sikre kvalitet og effektivitet  Have fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet og ordentligt håndværk  Økonomisk opfølgning på tilbud, fakturaer og nøgletal  Bidrage til en stærk holdånd og et godt samarbejde på værkstedet    Dine kvalifikationer  Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund og erfaring med ledelse af et serviceværksted. Du trives i rollen som en spillende træner, der går forrest, er synlig på værkstedet og motiverer medarbejderne gennem nærvær og faglig sparring. Du kan læse og forstå tekniske diagrammer og tegninger og har forståelse for komplekse tekniske løsninger.  Du er imødekommende, god til at lytte til både kunder og medarbejdere og evner at skabe tillid. Samtidig er du struktureret, følger opgaver helt til dørs, har økonomisk forståelse og bevarer overblikket - også når der er travlt. Du tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem en stærk holdånd og et godt samarbejde. IT indgår naturligt i dit daglige arbejde.  Vi tilbyder    En lederrolle, hvor du kombinerer faglighed og ansvar for mennesker og processer  Et værksted i rigtig god udvikling, hvor du kan sætte dit præg på retningen  En arbejdsdag tæt på både kunder og kolleger – du står ikke alene, men bliver en del af et engageret team  En arbejdsplads, hvor dine idéer og dit engagement gør en forskel  Et job, hvor vi fokuserer på, at der er tid til både arbejde og fritid    Interesseret?  Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Director Service & QHSE, Maibritt Kringel, på 27 77 40 56.  Send gerne din ansøg

title: Senior manager for GT IT Data Services Team, K Group
description: Do you want to work as a critical link between business and technology in one of the leading company in its field? K Group is looking for an experienced and technically strong data professional to join K IT and strengthen our Grocery Trade IT Data Services team as  Senior Manager working in IT Application Owner role.   We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K group!   About The Role   This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of developing, maintaining, and continuously improving business-critical data and analytics solutions as well as our strongly evolving AI capabilities. The role combines daily hands-on problem solving, application ownership, service management, and participation in development initiatives both as a subject matter expert and, when needed, as a project manager for smaller projects.   What does an IT Application Owner do?   The IT Application Owner is responsible for the end-to-end management, maintenance and development of their assigned service and application portfolio. The role includes both business functionality and technical lifecycle management, ensuring the continuity, stability, and evolution of the solutions under their ownership. In addition, IT Application Owner guides and collaborates with offshore partners and other service providers, while ensuring the continuous quality, availability, continuity and development of the services.  Our IT Application owners work closely with business stakeholders, architects, development and core IT teams, and external service partners. Success in this role requires the ability to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and drive solutions into practical implementation together with various stakeholders.  The role also requires a high-level understanding of the technical environment surrounding the applications, including capacity management, networking and connectivity solutions, as well as any service-related hardware and its operational principles.   What are we looking for?   Your responsibilities will focus on new and emerging data platforms and applications that we refer to as data kiosks. These solutions are primarily built on Snowflake technology utilizing dbt (data build tool), making strong practical experience with Snowflake and a solid understanding of modern data platform architectures and operating models essential for success in this role.  The position also requires strong SQL skills, including the ability to design, develop, and utilize SQL queries for data analysis, reporting, data model interpretation, and problem solving. Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Qlik Sense, Sigma, or similar technologies is also highly valued.   Your Skills And Background     Strong experience with Snowflake and modern data platform

You will play a key role in driving continuous improvement of O2D processes and strategic customer collaboration. You will identify opportunities to improve service, efficiency and process harmonization, and collaborate closely with our service hub teams and the business and implement best practices across the Nordic O2D organization. Represent Customer Operations towards customers and the business, leveraging expertise across the wider team when needed.   Leverage data and analytics to identify insights, assess the O2D performance, and drive improvement initiatives. We combine proprietary technology and data with the orchestration of physical assets, operating across credit, fraud, pricing, logistics, refurbishment, resale and customer care. With AI improving every cycle, our moat deepens with scale.  At Raylo, AI is woven into how we work every day. We don’t ration access or hedge our bets. Our people use the best models and tools, and we expect them to do things that weren’t possible a year ago. Processes that used to be good enough are being rebuilt. Teams are replacing spreadsheets with bespoke tooling, and anyone can query our data layer in plain English and get a real answer in seconds.  We give every team their own hackathon: a chance to step back, start with a blank sheet, and ask: if we were starting today, how would we do this? title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own     The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point. description:

Do you love turning messy behavioral data into the "aha" that changes a product roadmap? Do you want your dashboards to be the first thing product leaders open in the morning — and your analyses to inform what gets built next? If so, we want to talk to you!

About the Role

Updater operates at the intersection of embedded commerce, consumer marketplaces, and AI-powered buyflows. Millions of consumers use our products to find and purchase internet, utilities, insurance, moving services, and more — and every click, invite, and order tells a story. The story involves difficult consumer choices, understanding what product fits their needs. On the other side of the marketplace there’s also provider complexity about what consumers represent good credit risks. Your job is to find both sides of the story and make changes actionable.

As our Lead Data Analyst for Product Analytics, you'll own how we measure product performance across Updater's product lines — from our consumer Moving App and Pro Onboarding for multifamily residents, to PoweredBy embedded commerce and our Marketplace, to our newest AI agentic experiences. You'll build the reporting that tracks our most important KPIs — funnel conversion, order rate, claim rate, engagement — and go beyond the "what" to explain the "why," shaping experiments and roadmaps along the way.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership seat. You'll partner directly with multiple product teams, along with marketing, and customer success. Your insights will inform decisions from feature design to executive strategy. We're also aggressively leaning into AI: we've been developing LLM-based agentic experiences that help consumers purchase complex products with confidence, and our data teams use Claude Code and other LLM-based tools daily to move faster and dig deeper. If you're excited to practice analytics at the frontier, you'll be at home here.

What You'll Own

  • KPI reporting & dashboards — Define, build, and maintain the Looker dashboards that track funnel conversion and key product KPIs across product lines, so every team shares one trusted view of performance.
  • Product performance analysis — Investigate user behavior across the full journey (invite → onboarding → active usage → conversion) to explain why metrics move and where the biggest opportunities hide.
  • Experimentation — Design and analyze A/B tests that are statistically sound and trusted for business decisions, partnering with product and marketing to raise conversion across our buyflows.
  • Data modeling — Build and maintain dbt models in Snowflake that power self-serve analytics and keep metric definitions consistent and reliable.

We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. title: Senior Analytics Engineer - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to build and scale the analytical foundation that powers decision-making across Go-to-Market, Product, Finance, People, and Operations teams.

You will sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics: transforming raw product, marketing, financial, and operational data into clean, well-modeled, and trustworthy datasets. Your work will power everything from executive dashboards and cohort analyses to experimentation, billing operations, AI-powered outreach, and semantic layers that let AI agents answer stakeholder questions autonomously.

This is a highly cross-functional role — you'll partner closely with Product Management, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, People Ops, and Engineering to ensure our analytics stack is robust, scalable, and aligned with the business.

Responsibilities

Build & Own the Data Foundation

  • Own and evolve our dbt project — ensuring models are performant, well-tested, and documented.

  • Design and maintain the Snowflake data warehouse and ingestion processes.

  • Use modern data modeling best practices to create core entities and datasets that account for complex business processes and logic.

  • Build and maintain custom Python/Airflow pipelines to ingest data from third-party APIs into Snowflake.

  • Design and operate cross-system reconciliation models that compare data across source systems to surface discrepancies and protect revenue.

Drive Data Quality & Automation

  • Implement testing and observability for analytics pipelines.

  • Enforce CI/CD best practices, such as automation, linting, tests, code review and approvals.

  • Standardize metric definitions and ensure they are consistently computed across tools.

  • Investigate and document data incidents end-to-end — from root cause analysis through remediation tracking and stakeholder communication.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as data liaison between Engineering, GTM, and Finance — ensuring consistent metric definitions and proper system instrumentation.

  • Enable stakeholder self-service access to trusted insights.

  • Drive data literacy: evangelize best practices in querying, dashboarding, and interpreting metrics; coach stakeholders toward self-serve.

title: Client Retention Specialist
description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the Beyond Finance program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Educate Clients: Provide comprehensive information about the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.
  • Empathize and Deescalate: Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.
  • Navigate CRM System: Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.
  • Analyze Financial Situation: Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.
  • Retain Clients: Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Maps & Search. This team owns the home search experience across web and mobile. It's one of the most visible, highest-traffic surfaces–the search service alone handles a billion requests every month.

This is a role for a manager who leads from the front: someone who still lives in their terminal with AI, has strong opinions about how AI changes the SDLC, and wants to amplify what a small, senior, AI-augmented team can accomplish. You will set technical direction, stay close to the code, and help the team produce consistent impact.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow the Maps & Search team. Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft and build a healthy, high-performing team that ships impactful changes.

Stay hands-on. Contribute directly — code and design reviews, architecture, thorny debugging— and stay technical enough to make smart calls on trade-offs.

Own and scale a high-throughput search platform. Drive the architecture, relevance, latency, and reliability of a real estate search system handling ~1B monthly requests and hundreds of millions of listings.

Deliver a world-class home search experience. Own the core home discovery experience across web and mobile — improving engagement, lead conversion, and agent workflows while keeping interactions fast and responsive at scale.

Push forward AI-powered discovery. Partner across teams to bring LLMs and intelligent ranking into search and user workflows, improving how buyers and agents discover, filter, and engage with listings.

Shape the roadmap with product and design. Define what we build and why, not just focusing on the how. Translate user needs and business goals into a clear technical plan, and own delivery end to end — planning, quality, reliability, and incident response.

What We're Looking For

title: Data Analyst (all genders)
description:
Jede Entscheidung bei MUVN hängt an einer Zahl. Niemand soll sie suchen müssen.

MUVN verbindet Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Kein neuer Fuhrpark, keine neue Logistik. Bessere Nutzung von dem, was ohnehin unterwegs ist. Unser Marktplatz wächst über Korridore, also über einzelne Strecken, die dicht genug werden, um von selbst zu tragen. Ob eine Strecke trägt, ist keine Meinungsfrage, sondern eine Messung.

Dafür bauen wir das MUVN Brain: eine verbundene Schicht über unseren Systemen, in der Kennzahlen einmal definiert sind und Menschen wie AI-Agents dieselbe Antwort bekommen. Es wird immer mehr als ein System geben. Der Unterschied liegt darin, ob sie miteinander reden. Du baust das.

Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Datenstelle, berichtest an unseren CFO und arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, Marketing und Operations. Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh

description:
Raft is building the enterprise AI platform for supply chain - the industry that literally keeps the world moving.

We’ve built deep credibility in the supply chain sector, partnering with more than 60 global leaders to eliminate manual processes, unify fragmented systems, and unlock intelligence at scale. Along the way, we’ve raised $45M from Bessemer Venture Partners and Eight Roads to accelerate this mission.

With the launch of our next-generation agentic platform, we’re doubling down on our supply chain roots while laying the groundwork to expand into adjacent sectors. Designed to handle messy data, fragmented systems, and people-intensive workflows, our platform is already proving its versatility.

Design something that truly matters

At Raft, we’re building tools that power the global movement of goods — and we believe design has a critical role to play. Our platform helps those in the logistics industry work more efficiently, and our products are used for hours every single day by the people who keep supply chains running. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to design and shape our product. This is a rare opportunity to join early on. You’ll be joining a small but mighty team that genuinely loves helping each other grow. We believe deeply in craft, collaboration, and improving the status quo in an industry that's been overlooked for far too long.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a product area: you’ll take charge of designing key flows in Raft’s logistic platform.
